However, existing SC approaches for video largely focus on pixel-level reconstruction or rely on complex spatiotemporal pipelines, leading to excessive bandwidth usage and latency that are unsuitable for low-resource deployments. In this paper, we propose ChronoSC, a task-oriented semantic communication framework for Video Question Answering (VideoQA). ChronoSC introduces Chrono-Color Stacking, a lightweight and lossless projection scheme that encodes temporal video dynamics into a single static image, enabling extreme temporal compression before transmission. This compact semantic representation is transmitted using a lightweight Deep Joint Source-Channel Coding (DeepJSCC) transceiver and explicitly reconstructed at the receiver. Unlike latent-space methods, explicit visual reconstruction enables the direct reuse of pre-trained vision-language models; specifically, a pre-trained BLIP model is employed to infer answers from noisy, reconstructed chrono-images. Experiments on the CLEVRER dataset show that ChronoSC achieves up to 192 times bandwidth reduction compared to raw video transmission while maintaining high VideoQA accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChronoSC，一种面向视频问答的任务导向语义通信框架，通过Chrono-Color Stacking将视频时序信息压缩为单张静态图像，结合轻量级DeepJSCC编解码和预训练BLIP模型，在CLEVRER数据集上实现了高达192倍的带宽压缩，同时保持较高的VideoQA准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有视频语义通信方法多聚焦于像素级重建或依赖复杂的时空处理流水线，导致带宽占用高、延迟大，不适合低资源部署场景。
AI.method: 提出Chrono-Color Stacking无损投影方案，将视频时序动态编码为单张静态图像；采用轻量级DeepJSCC收发器进行传输；接收端通过显式重建直接复用预训练的BLIP视觉-语言模型进行答案推理。
AI.result: 在CLEVRER数据集上，相比原始视频传输，ChronoSC实现了高达192倍的带宽压缩，同时保持较高的VideoQA准确率。
AI.conclusion: ChronoSC通过极致的时序压缩和显式重建策略，有效平衡了带宽效率与任务性能，证明了任务导向语义通信在低资源视频问答场景中的可行性。

title: A Global-Local Graph Attention Network for Traffic Forecasting
summary: Traffic forecasting is a significant part of intelligent transportation systems. One of the critical challenges of traffic forecasting is to find spatio-temporal correlations. In recent years, graph convolutional networks and graph attention networks have replaced traditional statistical models to predict future traffic. However, it is complicated for both of them to allow vertices to have far different characters. To address this, we propose the Global-Local Graph Attention Network (GLGAT) with pairwise encoding and the event-based adjacency matrix. The GLGAT allows vertices to have a global attention matrix set for the whole graph and assigns local attention matrix sets to each vertex. Experiments on two real-world traffic datasets show that GLGAT can effectively capture spatio-temporal correlations and has competitive performance against other state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出全局-局部图注意力网络（GLGAT），通过成对编码和基于事件的邻接矩阵，让顶点拥有全局和局部两种注意力矩阵，有效捕捉时空相关性，在交通预测中取得竞争性表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的图卷积网络和图注意力网络难以处理顶点特征差异很大的情况，需要一种能够同时捕获全局和局部注意力信息的模型。
AI.method: 提出GLGAT模型，包含成对编码和基于事件的邻接矩阵，为整个图设置全局注意力矩阵集，并为每个顶点分配局部注意力矩阵集。
AI.result: 在两个真实交通数据集上的实验表明，GLGAT能有效捕获时空相关性，性能优于其他基线模型。
AI.conclusion: GLGAT是一种有效的交通预测方法，通过全局-局部注意力机制解决了顶点特征差异问题。

title: Inducing Spatial Locality in Vision Transformers through the Training Protocol
summary: We investigate whether the training protocol can induce spatial locality in the early layers of a Vision Transformer (ViT) trained from scratch, without large-scale pretraining. Keeping the architecture and optimization procedure fixed, we compare a Baseline protocol with a Modern protocol (AutoAugment/ColorJitter, CutMix, and Label Smoothing) on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and Tiny-ImageNet, characterizing each attention head via Mean Attention Distance (MAD) and normalized entropy. Across all three datasets, the Modern protocol produces more local and more concentrated attention in early layers; on CIFAR-100, the minimum MAD drops from 0.316 (Baseline) to 0.008 (Modern). To identify the source of this effect, we conduct an ablation study on CIFAR-100 by adding or removing each component individually. The results identify CutMix as the determining component within our experiments: all conditions with CutMix exhibit MAD 0.024, while all conditions without CutMix remain at MAD 0.210. AutoAugment and Label Smoothing show no independent effect on locality. Taken together, these findings suggest that the pressure to classify from partial image regions, induced by CutMix, can promote the emergence of local attention in Vision Transformers.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，CutMix增强策略能够促使Vision Transformer（ViT）早期层产生空间局部注意力，无需大规模预训练。在CIFAR-10/100和Tiny-ImageNet上，Modern协议（含CutMix）显著降低了注意力距离（CIFAR-100上最小MAD从0.316降至0.008），消融实验确认CutMix是决定性因素。
AI.motivation: 探究在不依赖大规模预训练的条件下，训练协议本身是否能够诱导Vision Transformer早期层产生空间局部注意力。
AI.method: 固定架构和优化过程，比较Baseline协议与Modern协议（含AutoAugment/ColorJitter、CutMix、Label Smoothing）在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和Tiny-ImageNet上的效果，通过Mean Attention Distance (MAD)和归一化熵表征每个注意力头，并在CIFAR-100上对各组件进行消融实验。
AI.result: Modern协议在所有三个数据集上都产生了更局部、更集中的早期层注意力。在CIFAR-100上，最小MAD从0.316（Baseline）降至0.008（Modern）。消融实验确定CutMix是决定性因素：含CutMix的所有条件MAD为0.024，不含CutMix的条件MAD为0.210。AutoAugment和Label Smoothing无独立效果。
AI.conclusion: CutMix通过迫使模型从局部图像区域进行分类的压力，能够促使Vision Transformer中局部注意力的涌现。

title: Full Attention Strikes Back: Transferring Full Attention into Sparse within Hundred Training Steps
summary: Long-context inference in large language models is bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of full attention. Existing efficient alternatives often rely either on native sparse training or on heuristic token eviction, creating an undesirable trade-off among efficiency, training cost, and accuracy. In this work, we show that full-attention LLMs are already intrinsically sparse and can be transformed into highly sparse models with only minimal adaptation. Our approach is built on three observations: (1) only a small subset of attention heads truly requires full long-context processing; (2) long-range retrieval is governed primarily by a low-dimensional subspace, allowing relevant tokens to be retrieved efficiently with a 16-dimensional indexer; and (3) the useful token budget is strongly query-dependent, making dynamic top-$p$ selection more suitable than fixed top-$k$ sparsification. Based on these insights, we propose RTPurbo, which retains the full KV cache only for retrieval heads and introduces a lightweight token indexer for sparse attention. By exploiting the model's intrinsic sparsity, RTPurbo achieves sparsification with only a few hundred training steps. Experiments on long-context benchmarks and reasoning tasks show that RTPurbo preserves near-lossless accuracy while delivering substantial efficiency gains, including up to a 9.36$\times$ prefill speedup at 1M context and about a 2.01$\times$ decode speedup. These results suggest that strong sparse inference can be obtained from standard full-attention training without expensive native sparse pretraining.

AI.tldr: RTPurbo通过利用大语言模型的内在稀疏性，仅需少量训练步骤即可将全注意力模型转化为高效稀疏模型，在保持近无损精度的同时实现了高达9.36倍的预填充加速和2.01倍的解码加速。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理中全注意力的二次复杂度成为性能瓶颈，现有方法（原生稀疏训练或启发式词元驱逐）在效率、训练成本和准确性之间存在难以取舍的权衡。
AI.method: 基于三个观察：（1）仅少数注意力头需要完整长上下文处理；（2）长程检索主要由低维子空间主导，可用16维索引器高效检索；（3）有用词元预算强依赖于查询，动态top-p选择优于固定top-k稀疏化。RTPurbo仅保留检索头的完整KV缓存，并引入轻量词元索引器实现稀疏注意力。
AI.result: 在长上下文基准和推理任务上，RTPurbo保持近无损精度，并实现显著效率提升：1M上下文时预填充加速高达9.36倍，解码加速约2.01倍。
AI.conclusion: 无需昂贵的原生稀疏预训练，标准全注意力训练即可获得强大的稀疏推理能力。

title: PopuLoRA: Co-Evolving LLM Populations for Reasoning Self-Play
summary: We introduce PopuLoRA, a population-based asymmetric self-play framework for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) post-training of LLMs. Teachers and students are specialised LoRA adapters on a shared frozen base: teachers propose problems, matched students solve them under a programmatic verifier, and cross-evaluation between sub-populations replaces the self-calibration that limits single-agent self-play. A family of LoRA weight-space evolution operators (mutations and crossovers that produce same-rank population members in seconds) serves as the replacement step of a population-based training loop at 7B scale. We instantiate PopuLoRA on top of Absolute Zero Reasoner and compare it against a per-adapter compute-matched single-agent baseline. Where the single agent self-calibrates to generating easy problems it can reliably solve, the population enters a co-evolutionary arms race: teachers produce increasingly complex problems, student solve rates oscillate, and problem-space coverage keeps expanding throughout training. Despite lower training-time reward, the population mean outperforms the baseline on three code benchmarks (HumanEval+, MBPP+, LiveCodeBench) and seven math benchmarks (AIME 24/25, AMC 23, MATH-500, Minerva, GSM8K, OlympiadBench), and even the weakest member of the population beats the baseline on aggregate.

AI.tldr: PopuLoRA是一种基于群体的非对称自博弈框架，用于LLM的RLVR后训练。教师和学生作为共享基座上的LoRA适配器，分别生成问题和解决问题，通过交叉评估和进化算子推动群体共同进化，在多个代码和数学基准上超越单智能体基线。
AI.motivation: 单智能体自博弈会自我校准到生成自己能可靠解决的简单问题，导致问题空间覆盖受限。作者希望引入群体进化机制，打破这种自我限制，实现教师与学生的共同进化军备竞赛。
AI.method: 在共享冻结基座模型上部署教师和学生两类LoRA适配器，教师生成问题，学生对问题求解并通过程序化验证器验证。采用群体交叉评估替代单智能体自我校准，并通过LoRA权重空间的变异和交叉算子实现群体进化，在7B规模下运行。
AI.result: 群体均值在三个代码基准（HumanEval+, MBPP+, LiveCodeBench）和七个数学基准（AIME 24/25, AMC 23, MATH-500, Minerva, GSM8K, OlympiadBench）上超越单智能体基线，且群体中最弱成员在总体上优于基线。训练中问题空间覆盖率持续扩大，但训练奖励低于基线。
AI.conclusion: 群体进化的非对称自博弈框架能有效避免单智能体的自我校准陷阱，通过师生共同进化实现更强的问题求解能力，尽管训练时奖励较低，但测试泛化性能显著更优。

title: Effort as Ceiling, Not Dial: Reasoning Budget Does Not Modulate Cognitive Cost Alignment Between Humans and Large Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) generate chain-of-thought traces whose length tracks human reaction times across cognitive tasks, but recent debate questions whether this alignment reflects genuine computational structure or surface verbosity. We test whether the alignment varies with inference-time reasoning effort. Across GPT-OSS-20B and GPT-OSS-120B, three effort levels, and six reasoning tasks, within-task and cross-task alignment remain invariant: Bayes Factors lean toward the null, and mean alignment is numerically near-identical across conditions. A manipulation check reveals that the effort parameter sets an upper budget on generation rather than driving real-time allocation, suggesting that the allocation policy is crystallized at training time. Arithmetic complexity contrasts further show that token allocation tracks fine-grained, format-dependent human difficulty patterns, with model scale improving the match. Cognitive cost alignment between LRMs and humans appears to be a training-time achievement, robust to inference-time perturbations, supporting a compiled rather than online account of LRM problem-solving.

AI.tldr: 大型推理模型(LRM)的链式思维长度与人类反应时对齐，但这种对齐源于训练时固化而非推理时动态调整，且不受推理努力程度影响。
AI.motivation: 近期研究显示LRM的思维链长度与人类认知反应时存在对齐，但学界对其背后机制存在争议：这种对齐究竟反映了真实的计算结构，还是仅仅是表面的冗长性？作者希望区分"训练时固化对齐"与"推理时动态对齐"两种假说。
AI.method: 实验采用GPT-OSS-20B和GPT-OSS-120B两个模型，设置三种推理努力程度，在六个推理任务上测试。使用贝叶斯因子评估零假设，并设计了算术复杂度对比实验来检验token分配与人类难度模式的匹配度。
AI.result: 任务内和跨任务的对齐程度在不同努力条件下保持不变，贝叶斯因子倾向于零假设。努力参数仅设定生成的上限预算，而非驱动实时资源分配。模型规模越大，token分配与人类难度模式的匹配度越高。
AI.conclusion: LRM与人类之间的认知成本对齐是训练时固化的产物，推断时扰动对其鲁棒，支持LRM问题解决是"编译式"而非"在线式"的账户。

title: Body-Grounded Perspective Formation and Conative Attunement in Artificial Agents
summary: This paper proposes a minimal architecture for body-grounded perspective formation in artificial agents. Extending prior work, the model introduces an interoceptive viability signal, a Fisher-style metric over fused exteroceptive-interoceptive states, and a conative alignment mechanism linking bodily tendency to action readiness. In a reward-free gridworld, conation converts learned bodily tendency into stable body-directed behavior, while body-to-perspective routing allows bodily perturbations to leave a recoverable geometric residue in the perspective latent. This study shows how minimal structural conditions for artificial subjectivity can be operationalized in the phenomenological sense, through the embodied organization of how a world is given to an agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于人工智能体身体基础视角形成的最小架构，通过引入内感受活力信号、费舍尔度量以及意动对齐机制，在无奖励网格世界中展示了身体扰动如何在视角潜变量中留下可恢复的几何痕迹，从而在现象学意义上实现人工主体性的操作化。
AI.motivation: 现有工作缺乏对人工智能体如何从身体基础出发形成主观视角的系统性研究，本文旨在探索实现人工主体性所需的最小结构条件。
AI.method: 提出包含三个核心模块的架构：内感受活力信号、融合外感受-内感受状态的费舍尔度量、以及连接身体倾向与行动准备状态的意动对齐机制。在无奖励网格世界中进行实验验证。
AI.result: 意动机制能将习得的身体倾向转化为稳定的身体导向行为；身体到视角的路由机制使得身体扰动在视角潜变量中留下可恢复的几何痕迹。
AI.conclusion: 人工主体性可以在现象学意义上通过身体组织的世界给予方式实现最小结构条件的操作化，为具身人工智能提供了理论基础。

title: Beyond MMSE: Enhancing PnP Restoration with ProxiMAP
summary: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods have become standard tools for solving imaging inverse problems by replacing the intractable maximum a posteriori (MAP) denoiser with the MMSE one. While this mismatch has been widely treated as unavoidable, recent works have sought to close this gap by targeting the MAP with diffusion-model scores. We show this is problematic in practice: learned scores do not match the true ones, so MAP-targeting iterations converge to cartoon-like images rather than realistic ones, and better results are obtained by stopping short of convergence. We turn this observation into a design principle and introduce ProxiMAP, an iterative MAP approximation whose noise schedule keeps the iterate's residual noise matched to the denoiser's training noise. This keeps the denoiser in-distribution where its score is reliable, and yields implicit early stopping that avoids the failure mode above. ProxiMAP is a modular drop-in replacement for MMSE denoisers in standard PnP algorithms and consistently sharpens reconstructions across deblurring, inpainting, super-resolution, and phase retrieval. Building on the same principle, we propose a hybrid variant that applies ProxiMAP only in the late iterations of PnP, where the denoiser is most reliable -- matching or exceeding the full-replacement variant at a fraction of the cost.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有的即插即用(PnP)方法中，使用MMSE去噪器替代MAP去噪器存在不匹配问题。作者发现直接使用扩散模型分数逼近MAP会导致收敛到卡通图像，因此提出ProxiMAP方法，通过保持残差噪声与去噪器训练噪声匹配，使去噪器处于分布内，实现隐式早停，从而获得更清晰的图像重建结果。
AI.motivation: 现有PnP方法用MMSE去噪器替代MAP去噪器存在不匹配问题；而直接使用扩散模型分数逼近MAP又会导致收敛到不真实的卡通图像。作者希望解决这一矛盾，设计一种更可靠、能生成真实图像的MAP近似方法。
AI.method: 提出ProxiMAP方法，迭代逼近MAP。其核心设计是保持迭代过程中的残差噪声与去噪器的训练噪声相匹配，确保去噪器在分布内运行（分数可靠），同时引入隐式早停机制避免过度收敛。此外还提出混合变体，仅在PnP后期迭代中应用ProxiMAP。
AI.result: 在去模糊、修复、超分辨率和相位恢复等多个逆成像任务上，ProxiMAP作为标准PnP算法的即插即用替代模块，一致地获得了更清晰的重建结果。混合变体以更低的计算成本达到了与完整替换相当或更优的效果。
AI.conclusion: 将"去噪器在分布外时分数不可靠"这一观察转化为设计原则，ProxiMAP通过噪声匹配和隐式早停有效解决了MAP逼近的失败模式，为PnP方法提供了一种实用且有效的改进方案。

title: Roll Out and Roll Back: Diffusion LLMs are Their Own Efficiency Teachers
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs) promise fast parallel generation, yet open-source DLLMs still face a severe quality-speed trade-off: accelerating decoding by revealing multiple tokens often causes substantial quality degradation. We attribute this dilemma to a train-inference mismatch amplified by irreversible decoding. While training reconstructs tokens from randomly corrupted states, efficient inference requires an adaptive denoising order, where easier tokens are revealed earlier and context-dependent ones are deferred. This view motivates two complementary methods: an inference-time method that makes parallel decoding revokable, and a training-time extension that distills the reliable order exposed by this revokable process. Accordingly, we first propose Wide-In, Narrow-Out (WINO), a training-free decoding algorithm that enables revokable parallel generation. WINO aggressively drafts multiple tokens, verifies generated tokens with enriched global context, and re-masks unreliable ones for later refinement. Building on this discovered order, we further introduce WINO+, which injects the verified denoising trajectories produced by WINO into model parameters, aligning training with efficient inference. Experiments on LLaDA and MMaDA show that WINO improves both quality and efficiency, while WINO+ further strengthens this progression. On GSM8K, WINO improves accuracy from 73.24% to 75.82% with a 6.10x step reduction, and WINO+ further achieves 76.58% with a 6.83x reduction. On Flickr30K, WINO+ reaches a 16.22x step reduction with improved CIDEr. These results demonstrate that DLLMs can serve as their own efficiency teachers by first discovering reliable denoising orders through revokable decoding and then learning to follow them for faster generation. Code is available at https://github.com/Feng-Hong/WINO-DLLM/tree/WINO-plus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WINO和WINO+方法，通过可撤销并行解码和蒸馏对齐训练，解决了扩散大语言模型的质量-速度权衡问题，在GSM8K和Flickr30K上实现了显著的质量提升和步骤减少。
AI.motivation: 开源扩散大语言模型面临严重质量-速度权衡：加速解码会导致质量严重下降，根本原因是训练与推理之间的不匹配被不可逆解码机制放大。
AI.method: 提出WINO（训练无关的宽进窄出解码算法）实现可撤销并行生成，以及WINO+（将WINO发现的可靠去噪轨迹蒸馏到模型参数中）对齐训练与高效推理。
AI.result: GSM8K上WINO准确率从73.24%提升至75.82%（步骤减少6.10倍），WINO+进一步达76.58%（步骤减少6.83倍）；Flickr30K上WINO+实现16.22倍步骤减少且CIDEr提升。
AI.conclusion: 扩散大语言模型可以充当自身的效率教师：先通过可撤销解码发现可靠去噪顺序，再学习遵循该顺序实现更快的生成。

title: State Contamination in Memory-Augmented LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent state, including transcripts, summaries, retrieved context, and memory buffers, to support long-horizon interaction. This makes safety depend not only on individual model outputs, but also on what an agent stores and later reuses. We study a failure mode we call memory laundering: toxic or adversarial context can be compressed into memory summaries that no longer appear toxic under standard detectors, while still preserving hostile framing or conflict structure that influences future generations. Using paired counterfactual multi-agent rollouts, we show that toxic-origin memory summaries can remain below common toxicity thresholds while nevertheless increasing downstream toxicity relative to matched neutral baselines. To measure this hidden influence, we introduce the sub-threshold propagation gap (SPG), which quantifies downstream behavioral differences conditioned on memory states that a deployed monitor would classify as safe. Our experiments show that toxicity propagates through distinct state channels: raw transcript reuse drives overt downstream toxicity, while compressed memory carries hidden sub-threshold influence. We further find that mitigation depends critically on intervention placement. Sanitizing toxic state before summarization substantially reduces the hidden propagation gap, whereas cleaning only the completed summary can leave laundered influence intact. These results suggest that safety in memory-augmented agents should be treated as a state-control problem over evolving context, with sanitization applied before unsafe information is compressed into persistent memory.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了LLM智能体中的"记忆洗白"现象：有毒或 adversarial 的上下文在压缩成记忆摘要后，能规避毒性检测器，但仍会潜移默化地影响后续生成。作者提出了亚阈值传播差距（SPG）指标来量化这种隐藏影响，并发现干预时机至关重要——在压缩前净化比完成后更有效。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越依赖持久化状态（如对话记录、摘要、检索上下文、记忆缓冲区）来支持长程交互，这使得安全性不仅取决于单个模型输出，还取决于智能体存储和后续重用的内容。研究者希望揭示这种"记忆洗白"的安全隐患。
AI.method: 使用配对反事实多智能体 rollout 实验，将有毒来源的记忆摘要与中性基线进行对比；提出亚阈值传播差距（SPG）指标，量化在监控器判定为安全的记忆状态下，下游行为的差异。
AI.result: 有毒来源的记忆摘要可保持在常见毒性阈值以下，但相比中性基线仍会增加下游毒性。毒性通过不同状态通道传播：原始对话记录复用导致显式下游毒性，压缩记忆则携带隐藏的亚阈值影响。在压缩前净化毒性状态能显著减少隐藏传播差距，而仅清理已完成摘要则效果有限。
AI.conclusion: 记忆增强型智能体的安全性应被视为一个对演化上下文的状态控制问题，安全净化应在不安全信息被压缩进持久记忆之前进行。

title: Closing the Gap at CRAC 2026: Two-Stage Adaptation for LLM-Based Multilingual Coreference Resolution
summary: We present our submission to the LLM track of the 2026 Computational Models of Reference, Anaphora and Coreference (CRAC 2026) shared task. With an average CoNLL F1 score of 74.32 on the official test set, our system ranked first in the LLM track, and third overall. Our system is based on the Gemma-3-27b model, fine-tuned using a two-stage strategy with a multilingual base adapter followed by dataset-specific adapters. We represent mention spans by their headword using an XML-inspired format with local reindexing and annotate documents iteratively. These design choices proved effective across languages, document lengths, and annotation guidelines.

AI.tldr: 基于Gemma-3-27b的两阶段微调系统，在CRAC 2026共享任务LLM赛道中获得第一（整体第三），CoNLL F1达74.32。
AI.motivation: 参与CRAC 2026共享任务的LLM赛道，旨在利用大语言模型提升指代消解性能。
AI.method: 采用Gemma-3-27b模型，两阶段微调策略：先训练多语言基础适配器，再训练数据集特定适配器。使用基于头词的XML格式表示提及跨度，局部重索引，迭代式文档标注。
AI.result: 在官方测试集上平均CoNLL F1得分为74.32，LLM赛道排名第一，整体排名第三。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的设计选择在跨语言、跨文档长度和跨标注规范下均有效，验证了两阶段微调策略和头词XML表示方法的优越性。

title: NeuroMAS: Multi-Agent Systems as Neural Networks with Joint Reinforcement Learning
summary: Multi-agent language systems are often built as hand-designed workflows, where agents are assigned semantic roles and communication protocols are specified in advance. We propose NeuroMAS, a method that first treats a multi-agent language system as a trainable and scalable neural-network-like architecture with LLM agents as nodes and intermediate textual signals as edges. In NeuroMAS, agent nodes are role-free but structure-aware: the topology only determines how information can flow in general, while reinforcement learning training determines how nodes communicate, specialize, and coordinate. This formulation shifts multi-agent design from workflow engineering toward architecture design, where depth, width, connectivity, and growth protocol become scalable sources of capability. Further, we provide a theoretical perspective showing why such modular textual computation is more parameter-efficient when tasks admit hierarchical decompositions. Experiments show that NeuroMAS improves significantly over both inference-time and trained multi-agent baselines. We further find that organizational scaling is path-dependent: larger systems can be challenging to train from scratch, but become feasible when grown progressively from smaller trained systems. These results suggest that learned neural multi-agent systems are a promising scaling axis for LLMs.

AI.tldr: NeuroMAS将多智能体语言系统构建为可训练的类神经网络架构，用强化学习训练智能体间的通信、专业化和协调，实验表明该方法显著优于基线，并发现渐进式组织扩展比从头训练大型系统更有效。
AI.motivation: 传统多智能体语言系统依赖手工设计的工作流，缺乏可训练性和可扩展性，限制了其能力提升。
AI.method: 将多智能体系统视为类神经网络架构，LLM智能体作为节点，中间文本信号作为边；智能体节点无固定角色但具有结构感知能力，通过强化学习训练节点间的通信、专业化和协调方式。
AI.result: NeuroMAS在推理时间和训练型多智能体基线上均取得显著提升；发现组织扩展具有路径依赖性，渐进式扩展比直接训练大型系统更可行。
AI.conclusion: 学习型神经多智能体系统是LLMs有前景的扩展轴，将多智能体设计从工作流工程转向架构设计。

title: Stable and Near-Reversible Diffusion ODE Solvers for Image Editing
summary: The inversion of diffusion models plays a central role in image editing. Algebraically reversible ODE solvers provide an appealing approach to diffusion inversion for text-guided image editing, by eliminating the inversion error inherent in DDIM-based editing pipelines. However, empirical results indicate that reversibility alone is insufficient. As edits require larger semantic or visual changes, reversible diffusion solvers often exhibit instabilities and suffer sharp drops in output quality. In this paper, we show that the trade-off between exact reversibility and numerical stability manifests empirically as a trade-off between background preservation and prompt alignment in image editing. We then investigate the use of near-reversible Runge-Kutta methods as a more stable alternative to exactly reversible diffusion schemes. When combined with a vector-field smoothing strategy, the resulting approach improves edit fidelity, remains stable under large edits, and largely retains the background-preservation benefits of reversible solvers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了扩散模型逆过程在图像编辑中的稳定性问题，发现精确可逆性会导致数值不稳定，提出使用近可逆龙格-库塔方法结合向量场平滑策略，在保持背景保留的同时提高编辑保真度和稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的可逆ODE求解器虽然能消除DDIM编辑管线中的逆过程误差，但在语义变化较大时表现出不稳定性和质量下降，需要在精确可逆性和数值稳定性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 使用近可逆龙格-库塔方法替代精确可逆扩散方案，并结合向量场平滑策略（vector-field smoothing strategy）来提升稳定性。
AI.result: 该方法在大型编辑下保持稳定，提高了编辑保真度，并很大程度上保留了可逆求解器的背景保留优势。
AI.conclusion: 精确可逆性与数值稳定性之间存在固有的权衡，表现为背景保留与提示对齐之间的权衡；近可逆方法提供了一个更优的折中方案。

title: Skills on the Fly: Test-Time Adaptive Skill Synthesis for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents benefit from reusable skills, yet test-time tasks often require guidance more specific than a static skill library can provide. We propose \emph{SkillTTA}, a Test-Time Adaptive Skill Synthesis method that retrieves a small set of training trajectories relevant to the current task and synthesizes them into a temporary, task-specific textual skill. The solver model is kept fixed, so adaptation happens entirely through generated context rather than parameter updates. We evaluate the method on SpreadsheetBench, ALFWorld, and BigCodeBench. Compared with static trajectory-to-skill synthesis using GPT-5.5, task-specific skills improve SpreadsheetBench Pass@1 from 0.397 to 0.505 and BigCodeBench Pass@1 from 0.517 to 0.651. On ALFWorld, the method matches a heavier memory-learning baseline within four points of success rate while producing the shortest successful trajectories among reported methods. Ablations on SpreadsheetBench further show that synthesized skills outperform raw trajectory prompting, that top-$k$ retrieval should stay small, and that failed trajectories are especially useful because they expose recurring evaluator-facing mistakes.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillTTA方法，在测试时检索少量相关训练轨迹并合成为临时、任务特定的文本技能，无需更新模型参数即可实现自适应，在多个基准测试中显著提升了性能。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体依赖可复用技能，但测试时任务往往需要比静态技能库所能提供的更具体的指导，现有方法无法在测试时灵活适应特定任务需求。
AI.method: SkillTTA方法：检索当前任务相关的少量训练轨迹，将其合成为临时的、任务特定的文本技能，保持求解器模型固定，通过生成的上下文而非参数更新实现自适应。
AI.result: SpreadsheetBench Pass@1从0.397提升至0.505；BigCodeBench Pass@1从0.517提升至0.651；ALFWorld达到与更强基线相差4个百分点的成功率，且轨迹最短。
AI.conclusion: 测试时自适应技能合成能有效提升LLM智能体性能，合成技能优于原始轨迹提示，检索数量应保持较小，失败轨迹因暴露常见错误而尤其有用。

title: Multi-Paradigm Agent Interaction in Practice:A Systematic Analysis of Generator-Evaluator, ReAct Loop,and Adversarial Evaluation in the buddyMe Framework
summary: The rapid evolution of Large Language Model (LLM) agents has produced diverse interaction paradigms, yet few production systems integrate multiple paradigms within a unified architecture. This paper presents a systematic analysis of three principal agent interaction paradigms, including Multi-Agent Orchestration (Generator-Evaluator), ReAct Tool-Use Loops, and Memory-Augmented Interaction, as implemented in buddyMe, an open-source multi-model agent programming framework. We formalize a five-stage processing pipeline: Requirement Pre-Review -> Task Decomposition -> ReAct Execution -> Real-Execution Verification -> Adversarial Evaluation Discussion, and establish a six-dimensional evaluation schema with weighted scoring. Through four empirical case studies drawn from real-world deployment logs covering museum guide generation, scheduled weather tasks, and comprehensive tour planning, we draw three key conclusions. First, Generator-Evaluator pre-review detects requirement omissions in 20 percent of complex tasks, with 80 percent tasks passing initial inspection. Second, the ReAct loop ensures stable subtask execution but leads to around 30 percent redundant tool invocations. Third, adversarial Evaluator-Defender discussions reach consensus within 2-3 rounds for nearly 70 percent of scenarios, functioning mainly for content refinement rather than logical reversal. We additionally provide three Mermaid-based architectural diagrams and conduct cross-paradigm comparisons with CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph, MemGPT and A-Mem across six system dimensions. The research outcomes offer practical design guidelines for constructing stable and reliable multi-paradigm agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了 buddyMe 框架中三种智能体交互范式（多智能体编排、ReAct 工具循环、记忆增强交互），通过五个阶段处理流水线和六维评估体系，基于四个真实案例得出三项关键结论，并提供了跨范式对比和实用设计指南。
AI.motivation: 当前 LLM 智能体产生了多种交互范式，但少有生产系统能在统一架构中集成多种范式，缺乏对多范式融合的系统性分析与设计指导。
AI.method: 提出五阶段流水线（需求预审→任务分解→ReAct执行→实执行验证→对抗评估讨论）和六维加权评估体系，并在 buddyMe 框架中通过四个真实案例进行实证分析。
AI.result: 1) 生成器-评估器预审在20%的复杂任务中检测到需求遗漏，80%通过初步检查；2) ReAct循环确保子任务稳定执行但导致约30%的冗余工具调用；3) 对抗性评估讨论在约70%场景中2-3轮达成共识，主要用于内容精炼而非逻辑反转。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果可为构建稳定可靠的多范式智能体系统提供实用的设计指南。

title: Response-free item difficulty modelling for multiple-choice items with fine-tuned transformers: Component-wise representation and multi-task learning
summary: Response-free item difficulty modelling promises to reduce reliance on response-based calibration but is intrinsically difficult on reading-comprehension multiple-choice items, where difficulty depends on inferential demands across wording components. Whereas most existing approaches extract item-text features and pass them to a separate statistical or machine-learning model, we fine-tune transformer encoders end-to-end on the item wording, eliminating the manual feature engineering and preprocessing that discards information. Moreover, two extensions to this joint-encoding approach are proposed: a component-wise variant that encodes wording components separately through a shared encoder, and a multi-task variant that retains joint encoding and adds an auxiliary multiple-choice question answering objective on the shared encoder. Each method is evaluated under a Monte Carlo subsampling design at three training-set sizes on a held-out test set. We find that joint encoding is a viable end-to-end alternative to feature-engineering pipelines; while the component-wise variant shows no detectable benefit, consistent with self-attention already harvesting the cross-component signal, the multi-task variant delivers significant paired improvements in the smallest-sample regime. Transformer fine-tuning, especially if regularised by a suitable auxiliary task, recovers a substantial share of the wording-derivable signal at training-set sizes typical of applied measurement. The framework provides a customisable interface for psychometrically motivated extensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需人工特征工程的端到端微调Transformer方法，用于阅读理解的试题难度建模，并验证了多任务变体在小样本场景下的有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统的试题难度建模依赖人工特征工程和单独的统计/机器学习模型，处理过程会丢失信息且成本高；现有方法难以捕捉阅读理解试题中跨成分的推理难度。
AI.method: 微调Transformer编码器对试题文本进行端到端联合编码；提出两种扩展：分量级变体（共享编码器分别编码各成分）和多任务变体（联合编码+辅助多选题问答目标）。在蒙特卡洛子采样设计下评估三种训练集规模。
AI.result: 联合编码可以作为特征工程管道的有效端到端替代方案；分量级变体无明显优势；多任务变体在小样本场景下表现出显著改进。Transformer微调在典型测试规模下能恢复大部分源于试题措辞的可推导信号。
AI.conclusion: 基于Transformer的端到端微调，特别是通过合适的辅助任务进行正则化，是可行的试题难度建模方法，并为心理测量学驱动的扩展提供了可定制化接口。

title: Voices in the Loop: Mapping Participatory AI
comment: Accepted to The 2026 ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT '26), June 25--28, 2026, Montreal, QC, Canada
summary: Participatory approaches to artificial intelligence are increasingly documented across public, civic, and humanitarian settings, but evidence about how participation is organized remains fragmented. This paper reports on the construction of an open repository and interactive atlas of participatory AI initiatives, using records harmonized from Maga~na and Shilton's Trustworthy AI corpus, and additional audited cases from research and practice. We contribute three elements. First, we specify a reproducible protocol for discovery, vetting, harmonization, geocoding, provenance tracking, and release-based publication of participatory AI records. Second, we report corpus-level patterns in geography, participation tiers, lifecycle loci, organizational form, verification status, and remaining documentation gaps. Documented initiatives remain concentrated in a small number of countries, while participation is most often coded at problem formulation, evaluation, and governance rather than model development or training. Third, we show how the atlas operationalizes a design and governance framework for participatory-by-default AI infrastructures through versioned releases, record-linked issue and annotation channels, schema feedback workflows, and redaction or restricted-disclosure requests. The atlas is intended to support comparative research, policy learning, and community scrutiny through a living inventory that can be updated, contested, and reused.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个参与式AI倡议的开放存储库与交互式图谱，通过可重复的协议对全球案例进行地理编码与分类，揭示了参与集中在问题制定、评估与治理环节，且地理分布不均，并提出了“默认参与式”AI基础设施的设计与治理框架。
AI.motivation: 参与式AI的方法在公共、公民和人道主义领域日益增多，但关于参与如何组织的证据仍然零散，缺乏系统性的整理与分析工具。
AI.method: 通过从Magaña和Shilton的可信AI语料库及额外审计案例中统一记录，构建开放存储库与交互式图谱；制定了可重复的发现、审核、统一、地理编码、溯源追踪与发布协议。
AI.result: 参与式AI倡议集中在少数国家；参与最常见于问题制定、评估与治理阶段，而非模型开发或训练；图谱通过版本化发布、记录链接的议题与注释通道、模式反馈工作流及隐去/限制披露请求，实现了“默认参与式”AI基础设施的设计与治理框架。
AI.conclusion: 该图谱旨在通过可更新、可争议、可复用的动态清单，支持比较研究、政策学习与社区监督。

title: WinDeskGround: A Benchmark for Robust GUI Grounding in Complex Multi-Window Desktop Environments
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have revolutionized GUI automation, yet their efficacy is largely established on idealized, single-layer interfaces. This paper identifies a critical reliability gap: state-of-the-art agents face distinct robustness challenges in real-world desktop environments characterized by multi-window stacking, occlusion, and visual clutter. To address this, we introduce WinDeskGround, a novel benchmark and synthesis framework tailored for evaluating GUI grounding robustness. Unlike static datasets, our framework parametrically generates complex desktop scenarios by controlling window occlusion, layout density, and semantic similarity, thereby simulating the distribution shifts of authentic workflows. We construct a diverse meta-dataset of 1,356 high-fidelity instruction-target pairs and conduct comprehensive evaluations of five leading MLLMs. Our results demonstrate that while top-tier agents excel in simplified settings, their accuracy declines under partial occlusion. WinDeskGround provides a valuable benchmark to facilitate the assessment and advancement of GUI agent robustness in realistic environments. The code is available at https://github.com/ZZZhr-1/WinDeskGround.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WinDeskGround基准，用于评估多模态大模型在多窗口、遮挡等复杂桌面环境中的GUI鲁棒性，发现现有顶级模型在部分遮挡下准确率显著下降。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在理想化单层界面表现良好，但在真实桌面环境（多窗口堆叠、遮挡、视觉杂乱）中鲁棒性不足，亟需相应评估基准。
AI.method: 构建参数化合成框架，通过控制窗口遮挡、布局密度和语义相似度生成复杂桌面场景，包含1,356个高保真指令-目标对，评估五种主流MLLM。
AI.result: 顶级模型在简化设置下表现优异，但在部分遮挡条件下准确率下降。
AI.conclusion: WinDeskGround可作为评估和推动GUI智能体在真实环境中鲁棒性的有效基准。

title: Evaluation Drift in LLM Personality Induction: Are We Moving the Goalpost?
comment: 14 pages, 8 main pages, 5 figures, 4 main page figures
summary: Can large language models reliably express a human-like personality, or are they merely mimicking surface cues without a stable underlying profile? To investigate this, we induce personality in LLMs by fine-tuning them on the long-form essays, where each essay is associated with a target Big Five personality profile. We then evaluate the stability and fidelity of the induced personality using the IPIP-NEO questionnaire. Specifically, we ask: (i) does post-training (SFT, DPO, ORPO) stabilize questionnaire scores under prompt rephrasings, and (ii) can it induce target Big Five profiles from unguided essays? Our results demonstrate that fine-tuning consistently reduces variance in questionnaire responses across five models, directly mitigating the evaluation fragility reported in pre-trained models. However, this newfound stability reveals a more fundamental limitation: accuracy on the full five-dimensional profile remains near chance, even when single-trait scores improve. This indicates that unguided essays lack the cues needed for faithful personality expression. We therefore argue for scenario-grounded datasets or interactive elicitation that accumulates test-aligned evidence over time.

AI.tldr: 本文通过微调大语言模型并使用大五人格问卷评估，发现微调能稳定人格表现，但仅靠非引导性文本无法准确表达完整人格轮廓，需依赖场景化数据或交互式方法。
AI.motivation: 探究大语言模型能否可靠地表达类人性格，还是仅仅模仿表面特征而缺乏稳定的内在人格轮廓。
AI.method: 通过微调（SFT、DPO、ORPO）在长文上诱导大语言模型的大五人格，使用IPIP-NEO问卷评估稳定性与准确性。
AI.result: 微调显著降低了问卷响应的方差，提升了稳定性；但在完整五维人格轮廓上的准确率仍接近随机水平。
AI.conclusion: 非引导性文本缺乏忠实表达人格所需的线索，建议采用场景化数据集或交互式方式来累积测试一致的证据。

title: Sketch Then Paint: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Diffusion Multi-Modal Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion Multi-Modal Large Language Models (dMLLMs) are powerful for image generation, but optimizing them through reinforcement learning (RL) remains a major challenge. One primary difficulty is that a single image can be generated through many different unmasking sequences, which makes calculating importance ratios often intractable. Additionally, existing methods tend to ignore the hierarchical generation process of dMLLMs, where early tokens define the global layout and later tokens focus on local details. By assigning uniform rewards to all tokens, these current methods fail to reflect the actual contribution of each token to the final image. To address these issues, we propose Hierarchical Token GRPO (HT-GRPO), which integrates this hierarchy directly into the policy optimization process. Our approach features a Sketch-Then-Paint training scheme that organizes updates into three distinct stages: global, structure, and refinement. We also use a prompt-conditioned estimator to calculate importance ratios starting from a fully masked state. Furthermore, we introduce a Hierarchical Credit Assignment mechanism that prioritizes key structural tokens to ensure accurate reward propagation. Experiments using two popular dMLLM backbones, MMaDA and Lumina-DiMOO, demonstrate that HT-GRPO achieves substantial gains on the GenEval and DPG benchmarks. Evaluations across six additional metrics confirm significant improvements in image quality, aesthetics, and human preference.

AI.tldr: 提出HT-GRPO方法，通过层次化强化学习优化扩散多模态大语言模型，实现图像生成质量显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有dMLLMs的RL优化面临两个问题：1）单个图像可通过多种去噪序列生成，重要性比率计算困难；2）忽略层次化生成过程（早期token定义全局布局，后期token关注局部细节），统一奖励分配无法反映每个token的实际贡献。
AI.method: 提出HT-GRPO，包含三个关键设计：1）Sketch-Then-Paint三阶段训练方案（全局、结构、细化）；2）从完全掩码状态开始、基于提示条件的估计器计算重要性比率；3）层次化信用分配机制，优先对关键结构token进行奖励传播。
AI.result: 在MMaDA和Lumina-DiMOO两个dMLLM骨干网络上，HT-GRPO在GenEval和DPG基准测试上取得显著提升，并在额外六项指标上展现出图像质量、美学和人类偏好的改进。
AI.conclusion: HT-GRPO有效解决了dMLLMs在RL优化中面临的序列多样性和层次化奖励分配问题，为扩散多模态大语言模型的高效优化提供了新范式。

title: When Vision Speaks for Sound
summary: Despite rapid progress in video-capable MLLMs, we find that their apparent audio understanding in videos is often vision-driven: models rely on visual cues to infer or hallucinate acoustic information, rather than verifying the audio stream. This issue appears across both state-of-the-art open-source omni models and leading closed-source models from providers such as Google and OpenAI. We characterize this failure mode as an audio-visual Clever Hans effect, in which models appear (falsely) audio-grounded, but actually exploit visual-acoustic correlations without verifying whether the audio and visual streams are truly aligned. To systematically study this behavior, we introduce Thud, an intervention-driven probing framework based on three counterfactual audio edits: Shift, which tests temporal synchronization; Mute, which tests sound existence; and Swap, which tests audio-visual consistency. Beyond diagnosis, we further study a two-stage alignment recipe: intervention-derived preference pairs teach audio verification, while event-level general video preferences regularize the model against over-specialization. Our best 10K-sample recipe improves average performance across the three intervention dimensions by 28 percentage points, while slightly improving performance on general video and audio-visual QA benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 现有视频多模态大模型看似具备音频理解能力，实则是利用视觉线索推断或幻觉音频信息，而非真正验证音频流。本文提出Thud干预框架（Shift/Mute/Swap三种反事实音频编辑）诊断此问题，并设计两阶段对齐方法，用干预偏好对训练音频验证能力，用事件级偏好防止过拟合，10K样本即可提升28个百分点。
AI.motivation: 视频多模态大模型在音频理解任务上存在"Clever Hans"效应——模型依赖视觉线索推断音频信息，而非真正验证音视频是否对齐。需要系统性诊断方法揭示该问题，并设计有效解决方案。
AI.method: 提出Thud干预探测框架，包含三种反事实音频编辑：Shift（时间同步）、Mute（声音存在性）、Swap（音视频一致性）。同时设计两阶段对齐训练：干预偏好对训练音频验证能力，事件级通用视频偏好防止过拟合。
AI.result: 10K样本训练后，在三种干预维度上平均提升28个百分点，同时通用视频和音视频问答基准性能也有小幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频模型存在"伪音频理解"问题，通过反事实干预训练可以有效提升模型的真实音频验证能力，且不会牺牲通用性能。

title: HalluScore: Large Language Model Hallucination Question Answering Benchmark
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in natural language generation, but remain susceptible to hallucination. In response to growing concerns about hallucinations, several benchmarks have been developed, primarily in English and Chinese. However, Arabic remains underrepresented, with limited benchmarks for LLMs hallucination due to scarce annotated resources and the language's morphological complexity. Consequently, existing benchmarks do not adequately reflect the linguistic, cultural, and reasoning characteristics of Arabic. To address this gap, we introduce HalluScore, a structured Arabic question answering benchmark designed to evaluate hallucination behavior in LLMs across different levels of reasoning difficulty, various knowledge domains, historical timelines, and culturally grounded Arabic scenarios. It contains 827 carefully curated questions for evaluating, detecting, and mitigating hallucination in LLMs. The dataset was constructed through a structured pipeline involving quality assurance, filtering for clarity and factual validity, and model-driven selection to retain questions that consistently trigger hallucinations. Each question is linked to verified ground-truth evidence, answer explanations, and multi-label annotations. Using the HalluScore benchmark, we conduct a comprehensive empirical analysis of hallucination patterns across 17 Arabic, multilingual, and reasoning LLMs. Moreover, we provide high-quality human annotations identifying hallucinated, non-hallucinated, and partially hallucinated responses of all evaluated LLMs. These results suggest that hallucination in Arabic LLMs extends beyond factual inaccuracies, encompassing challenges related to cultural understanding, linguistic reasoning, and logical consistency. We release HalluScore to support future research on improving the reliability and cultural competence of LLMs in Arabic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HalluScore，一个专门用于评估阿拉伯语大语言模型幻觉问题的结构化问答基准，包含827个精心设计的问题，覆盖不同推理难度、知识领域、历史时间和文化场景。通过对17个模型的实证分析，发现阿拉伯语LLM的幻觉不仅涉及事实错误，还包括文化理解、语言推理和逻辑一致性的挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有的幻觉评估基准主要针对英语和中文，阿拉伯语因其形态复杂性和标注资源稀缺而严重缺乏代表性基准，无法充分反映阿拉伯语的语言、文化和推理特征。
AI.method: 通过结构化流程构建HalluScore数据集：质量保证、清晰性和事实有效性过滤、模型驱动的困难问题筛选。包含827个问题，每个问题都配有经过验证的事实证据、答案解释和多标签注释。对17个阿拉伯语、多语言和推理LLM进行综合实证分析，并提供高质量人工标注。
AI.result: 阿拉伯语LLM的幻觉不仅限于事实不准确，还涉及文化理解、语言推理和逻辑一致性方面的挑战。
AI.conclusion: HalluScore为评估和改进阿拉伯语LLM的可靠性和文化能力提供了有效的基准工具。

title: Artificial Adaptive Intelligence: The Missing Stage Between Narrow and General Intelligence
summary: Between the narrow systems we deploy and the general intelligence we speculate about lies an entire regime of machine behavior that has never received its own name. This monograph argues that this regime is not empty: it is where meta-learning, neural architecture search, AutoML, continual learning, evolutionary computation, and physics-informed modeling have quietly converged on a common principle, namely the steady removal of the human from the loop of parameter specification. We name this regime Artificial Adaptive Intelligence (AAI) and define it operationally: a system exhibits AAI to the extent that it requires no human-specified tunable hyperparameters while maintaining competitive performance across a diverse distribution of tasks. To make the definition quantitative, we introduce an adaptivity index that measures progress along an axis orthogonal to scale, combining the fraction of hyperparameters absorbed by the system with the performance ratio against a task-specialized baseline. We develop the principle of parametric minimality and ground it in the minimum description length framework, showing that the appropriate hyperparameter count is data-determined rather than designer-determined. We then organize the field around three pathways to minimality: data- and task-aware configuration, structural and evolutionary morphing, and in-training self-adaptation. We analyze their stability, convergence, and governance implications, and illustrate them through case studies spanning aerospace design, financial regime detection, turbulence modeling, ecological dynamics, and vision-language systems. The thesis is that the path from ANI to AGI passes through AAI, and that naming this stage changes what we measure, what we build, and what we call a success.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“人工智能自适应智能（AAI）”概念，指无需人工指定超参数即可在多任务上保持竞争力的系统，介于狭义AI与通用AI之间，并给出量化指标与三条实现路径。
AI.motivation: 狭义AI与通用AI之间存在未被命名的机器行为区间，各种技术（元学习、神经架构搜索、AutoML、持续学习、进化计算、物理信息建模）已悄然收敛于“去人工化”的共同原则，亟需一个统一框架来命名和度量这一阶段。
AI.method: 定义适应性指数（adaptivity index），结合超参数吸收比例与任务专用基线的性能比；提出参数最小化原则，基于最小描述长度框架；归纳三条路径：数据/任务感知配置、结构与进化变形、训练内自适应。
AI.result: 通过航空航天设计、金融制度检测、湍流建模、生态动力学、视觉-语言系统等案例展示了AAI的适用性，分析了各路径的稳定性、收敛性和治理影响。
AI.conclusion: 从狭义AI到通用AI的路径必经AAI，命名为AAI将改变我们衡量、构建和定义成功的方式。

title: Hybrid Quantum-MambaVision: A Quantum-enhanced State Space Model for Calibrated Mixed-type Wafer Defect Detection
summary: Extracting actionable knowledge from industrial visual data is fundamentally bottlenecked by extreme class imbalance and the prohibitive computational complexity of modern foundation models. In semi-conductor manufacturing, identifying multi-label wafer defects is a complex spatial data mining task where overlapping patterns obscure critical root-cause signals. While Vision Transformers (ViTs) excel at global dependency extraction, their quadratic scaling renders them inefficient for high-throughput, real-time anomaly detection. To overcome these computational barriers, this paper introduces Hybrid Quantum-MambaVision, a highly efficient architecture tailored for spatial knowledge discovery. We integrate a linear-complexity State-Space Model (SSM) backbone with a Parameterized Quantum Context Adapter (QCA) and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). The Mamba backbone efficiently captures long-range spatial dependencies, while the quantum adapter maps compressed latent features into a high-dimensional Hilbert space to disentangle complex, overlapping signatures. On the highly imbalanced MixedWM38 dataset, Hybrid Quantum-MambaVision achieves exceptional multi-label classification performance, significantly reducing the error rate on complex multi-defect topologies compared to classical baselines. The quantum regularizer acts as a profound uncertainty calibrator, substantially reducing Maximum Calibration Error (MCE) and minimizing expected false-positive costs. This work establishes a scalable Quantum-Classical hybrid paradigm for efficient representation learning in industrial data mining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合量子-曼巴视觉架构（Hybrid Quantum-MambaVision），结合线性复杂度的状态空间模型和参数化量子上下文适配器，用于解决半导体制造中多标签晶圆缺陷检测的类别极度不平衡和高计算复杂度问题，在MixedWM38数据集上显著降低了多缺陷分类错误率和校准误差。
AI.motivation: 工业视觉数据存在极端的类别不平衡问题，且现代基础模型的计算复杂度过高。在半导体制造中，多标签晶圆缺陷检测是一项复杂的空间数据挖掘任务，重叠的缺陷模式掩盖了关键根因信号，而Vision Transformer（ViT）的二次方计算复杂度使其难以用于高吞吐量的实时异常检测。
AI.method: 提出了Hybrid Quantum-MambaVision架构：1）以线性复杂度的状态空间模型（SSM）Mamba作为骨干网络，高效捕获长程空间依赖；2）引入参数化量子上下文适配器（QCA），将压缩的潜在特征映射到高维希尔伯特空间，从而解缠复杂的重叠缺陷特征；3）结合低秩适配（LoRA）进行高效微调。
AI.result: 在高度不平衡的MixedWM38数据集上，Hybrid Quantum-MambaVision在多标签分类任务中显著降低了复杂多缺陷拓扑结构的错误率；量子正则化器作为不确定性校准器，大幅降低了最大校准误差（MCE）和预期假阳性成本。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一种可扩展的量子-经典混合范式，为工业数据挖掘中的高效表示学习提供了新方向。

title: Learning to Learn from Multimodal Experience
summary: Experience-driven learning has emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling agents to improve from interaction trajectories by accumulating and reusing past experience. However, existing approaches are predominantly developed in textual settings and rely on manually designed memory schemas, limiting their applicability to multimodal environments. In real-world scenarios, experience is inherently multimodal, involving heterogeneous signals across perception, reasoning, and action, which makes effective memory design significantly more challenging. In particular, the optimal way to structure and utilize multimodal experience is highly task-dependent and evolves over time, rendering fixed memory designs insufficient. In this work, we propose a new paradigm, learning to learn from multimodal experience, which shifts memory design from a predefined component to an adaptive and learnable process. Our framework enables agents to dynamically construct, organize, and utilize memory based on task requirements and interaction history, effectively learning how to structure experience for improved performance. Experiments demonstrate that adaptive memory design substantially enhances agent performance and generalization across multimodal tasks, highlighting the critical role of learning memory mechanisms in experience-driven learning.

AI.tldr: 提出"从多模态经验中学习去学习"的新范式，将记忆从预定义组件转变为自适应可学习过程，让智能体动态构建、组织和利用记忆，在多模态任务中提升性能与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有经验驱动学习方法主要基于文本环境且依赖人工设计的固定记忆模式，难以适应多模态环境中异构信号（感知、推理、行动）和任务依赖性强、随时间演变的经验组织需求。
AI.method: 提出"从多模态经验中学习去学习"范式，将记忆设计从预定义组件转变为自适应可学习过程，智能体根据任务需求和交互历史动态构建、组织和利用记忆。
AI.result: 自适应记忆设计显著提升了智能体在多模态任务中的性能和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 学习记忆机制在经验驱动学习中扮演关键角色，自适应记忆设计优于固定记忆方案。

title: Concepts Worth Having: Refining VLM-Guided Concept Bottleneck Models with Minimal Annotations
summary: Concept-bottleneck models (CBMs) are neural classifiers that compute predictions from high-level concepts extracted from the input. CBMs ensure stakeholders can understand the concepts -- and the predictions they entail -- by learning these from concept-level annotations, which are however seldom available. Recent CBM architectures work around this issue by obtaining annotations from Vision-Language Models (VLMs). While greatly broadening applicability, doing so can yield lower quality concepts and therefore less interpretable models. We strike for a middle ground by introducing Vision-plus-Human-guided CBM (VH-CBM), a hybrid approach that exploits both VLMs and a small amount of dense annotations. VH-CBM employs a Gaussian Process in the VLM's embedding space, which captures useful global information about the target domain, to propagate the expert's supervision to any target data point. Our empirical evaluation shows how VH-CBM predicts more accurate concepts than VLM-guided CBMs even when annotating as little as 1% of the data, while sporting better concept calibration and supporting active learning.

AI.tldr: VH-CBM是一种混合方法，结合视觉语言模型与少量人类密集标注，通过高斯过程传播专家监督，提升概念准确性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 传统概念瓶颈模型依赖昂贵的概念级标注，而纯VLM方法虽免标注但概念质量低、可解释性差，故需在两者间取得平衡。
AI.method: VH-CBM利用高斯过程在VLM嵌入空间中传播少量专家标注信息，实现对任意数据点的概念预测。
AI.result: 仅需1%数据标注即可比纯VLM方法预测更准确的概念，且概念校准更优，支持主动学习。
AI.conclusion: 混合人类与VLM监督的CBM能在大幅降低标注成本的同时提升可解释性与概念质量。

title: Agentic AI Translate: An Agentic Translator Prototype for Translation as Communication Design
comment: 14 pages. Conceptual and architectural paper; empirical validation in future work. Code: https://github.com/chuckmy/agentic-translator (v0.8.0). Live demo: https://agentic-translator-chuckmy.streamlit.app
summary: We present Agentic AI Translate, an agentic translator prototype that operationalises the thesis of Yamada (forthcoming) -- that the metalanguage of Translation Studies has become an instruction code for generative AI. The system replaces the dominant text-in / text-out paradigm of machine translation with a four-stage agentic cycle (Identify -> Prompt -> Generate -> Verify), preceded by an interactive specification phase in which the user composes -- through model-assisted dialogue -- a structured translation brief grounded in skopos theory, register, audience, and genre conventions. The verification stage adopts the GEMBA-MQM error-span protocol (Kocmi & Federmann, 2023) for evidence-grounded scoring, and document-level coherence is preserved through a DelTA-lite memory of proper nouns and a running bilingual summary, after Wang et al. (2025). We describe the philosophical motivation, the architectural commitments, the four reference-material categories the system consumes, and the principal design tensions the architecture makes explicit. Empirical validation is left for future work; the contribution here is conceptual and architectural -- an executable embodiment of the position that translation in the GenAI era is communication design, not text conversion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Agentic AI Translate——一个基于智能体循环（识别→提示→生成→验证）的翻译系统原型，将翻译重新定义为沟通设计而非文本转换，替代了传统的文本输入/输出机器翻译范式。
AI.motivation: 将Yamada（即将发表）的理论命题——翻译研究的元语言已成为生成式AI的指令代码——付诸实践，挑战机器翻译中主流的文本输入/输出范式，推动翻译在生成式AI时代向沟通设计转型。
AI.method: 采用四阶段智能体循环（Identify→Prompt→Generate→Verify），前置交互式规范阶段（基于目的论、语域、受众和体裁构建结构化翻译简报），验证阶段使用GEMBA-MQM错误跨度协议，通过DelTA-lite记忆模块和双语摘要维护文档级连贯性。
AI.result: 提出了一个概念性和架构性的贡献——一个可执行的系统原型，明确了四种参考材料类别及架构设计张力，但实证验证留待未来工作。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI时代的翻译应当被理解为沟通设计而非文本转换，该架构是对这一立场的可执行化体现。

title: Reasoning Can Be Restored by Correcting a Few Decision Tokens
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) substantially outperform their base LLM counterparts on challenging reasoning benchmarks, yet it remains poorly understood where base models go wrong during token-by-token generation and how to narrow this gap efficiently. We study the base-reasoning gap through quantifying token-level distributional disagreement between a base model and a stronger reasoning model using likelihood-based divergences. Across benchmarks, we find that the reasoning advantage is highly sparse and concentrates on a small set of early, planning-related decision tokens. For instance, on Qwen3-0.6B, only ~8% of generated tokens account for the salient disagreement, and these tokens concentrate early in the response, are strongly enriched in planning-related decisions (17x), and coincide with high base-model uncertainty -- suggesting that base models fail mainly at early planning points that steer the subsequent reasoning trajectory. Building on these findings, we propose disagreement-guided token intervention, a simple inference-time delegation scheme that performs a one-token takeover by the reasoning model only at high-disagreement positions and immediately switches back to the base model. With a small intervention budget, this sparse delegation substantially recovers and can even surpass the performance of a same-size reasoning model on challenging reasoning tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/AlphaLab-USTC/RRTokenIntervention.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基础模型与大型推理模型之间的生成差距，发现推理优势高度稀疏且集中在少量早期规划token上，并据此提出了一种稀疏干预方法，通过仅在关键位置进行单token接管即可显著提升基础模型性能。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在推理任务上显著优于基础模型，但两者在逐token生成过程中的具体差异及其缩小方法尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用基于似然的散度量化基础模型与推理模型在token级别的分布差异，并基于此提出分歧引导的token干预（disagreement-guided token intervention），仅在分歧高的位置进行单token接管。
AI.result: 推理优势集中在约8%的早期规划相关token上（富集程度达17倍）；所提出的稀疏干预方法在少量干预预算下即可达到甚至超越完整推理模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型的主要失败点在于早期的规划决策token，通过在关键位置进行稀疏干预即可高效弥合差距。

title: Contrastive-SDXL: Annotation-Preserving Night-Time Augmentation for Pedestrian Detection
summary: Night-time pedestrian detection remains challenging because labelled night-time data are limited and large illumination differences make daytime-only trained detectors unreliable. Latent diffusion models (LDMs) provide a powerful basis for image-to-image translation and cross-domain augmentation, but their effectiveness in safety-critical perception depends on whether detector-relevant objects and local semantic structure are preserved when translating between source and target domains. In this work, we present Contrastive-SDXL, a day-to-night augmentation framework for night-time pedestrian detection built on SDXL-Turbo and fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). To preserve semantic correspondence between daytime inputs and translated night-time images, we introduce a patch-wise semantic contrastive loss guided by a pretrained DINOv2 encoder rather than generator encoder features. Multi-level DINOv2 self-attention maps enforce both local and global semantic consistency, while an object consistency loss explicitly encourages pedestrian preservation. Contrastive-SDXL produces realistic night-time images, achieving a Frechet Inception Distance (FID) of 22.5. Detectors trained with our synthetic images obtain a 6-7% reduction in miss rate compared with a daytime-only baseline, approaching the performance of detectors trained on real night-time data. These results demonstrate that consistency-driven diffusion augmentation can effectively support safety-critical night-time pedestrian detection.Specific

AI.tldr: 本文提出Contrastive-SDXL，一种基于SDXL-Turbo和LoRA微调的昼夜图像转换框架，通过引入基于DINOv2编码器的补丁级语义对比损失和多层自注意力机制，保留语义和对象一致性，生成的夜间图像FID达22.5，使检测器误检率降低6-7%，接近真实夜间数据训练的性能。
AI.motivation: 夜间行人检测面临标注数据稀缺和昼夜光照差异大的挑战，使得仅用白天数据训练的检测器在夜间不可靠，需要有效的昼夜域迁移增强方法。
AI.method: 基于SDXL-Turbo和LoRA微调构建昼夜图像转换框架，引入基于预训练DINOv2编码器的补丁级语义对比损失，利用多层DINOv2自注意力图保持局部和全局语义一致性，并加入对象一致性损失显式保留行人目标。
AI.result: 生成的夜间图像FID为22.5，使用合成夜间图像训练的检测器误检率比仅用白天数据降低6-7%，性能接近使用真实夜间数据训练的检测器。
AI.conclusion: 一致性驱动的扩散增强方法能有效支持安全关键的夜间行人检测任务。

title: Can LLMs Think Like Consumers? Benchmarking Crowd-Level Reaction Reconstruction with ConsumerSimBench
summary: LLMs are increasingly used as ``digital consumers'' to simulate public opinion, pre-test marketing decisions, and anticipate audience response. However, existing evaluations rarely ask whether a model can reconstruct the concrete reaction patterns that real consumers surface in public discourse. We introduce ConsumerSimBench, a benchmark built from 1,553 real Chinese social-media topics and 23,122 atomic, rule-audited criteria spanning four reaction families. Rather than scoring open-ended generations with a holistic preference judge, ConsumerSimBench decomposes each task into auditable yes-no decisions over concrete reaction points, raising three-judge agreement from 65.8% to 92.1% with 98.4% agreement between pointwise judge decisions and human-majority labels. Across 13 frontier generators, the strongest model, Gemini-3.1-Pro, covers only 47.8% of real reaction criteria, while GPT-5.2 and Claude-4.6 trail far behind despite their strength on technical benchmarks. The failures reveal a sharp gap between technical-benchmark performance and socially grounded consumer intuition. A direct structured reasoning prompt decreases coverage, while a generate--reflect multi-agent pipeline improves MiMo-V2.5-Pro from 32.9% to 37.6% on a subset. ConsumerSimBench reframes consumer simulation as a forecasting problem over real public-discourse reactions, showing that frontier LLMs remain far from reliably predicting what consumers will actually care about in high-context Chinese consumer discourse.

AI.tldr: ConsumerSimBench是一个基于1,553个真实中文社交媒体话题和23,122条可审计规则的基准测试，用于评估LLM模拟消费者真实反应的能力。结果显示最强模型Gemini-3.1-Pro仅覆盖47.8%的真实反应标准，表明前沿LLM在预测消费者实际关注点方面仍存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM评估很少检验模型能否重建真实消费者在公共话语中表现出的具体反应模式，缺乏可审计、细粒度的消费者模拟评估基准。
AI.method: 构建了包含1,553个真实中文社交媒体话题和23,122条原子化、可规则审计的评估标准（涵盖四类反应家族）；采用分解式逐点判断而非整体评分，将三位评判者的一致性从65.8%提升至92.1%。
AI.result: 最强模型Gemini-3.1-Pro仅覆盖47.8%的真实反应标准；GPT-5.2和Claude-4.6尽管在技术基准上表现强劲，但在消费者模拟上远落后；直接的结构化推理提示反而降低覆盖率，而生成-反思多智能体流水线将MiMo-V2.5-Pro从32.9%提升至37.6%。
AI.conclusion: ConsumerSimBench将消费者模拟重新定义为对真实公共话语反应的预测问题，揭示了前沿LLM在预测高语境中文消费者话语中实际关注点方面仍远未达到可靠水平，技术基准表现与社会化消费者直觉之间存在巨大鸿沟。

title: Virtual Nodes Guided Dynamic Graph Neural Network for Brain Tumor Segmentation with Missing Modalities
comment: The IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition 2026
summary: Multimodal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is crucial for brain tumor segmentation, with many methods leveraging its four key modalities to capture complementary information for effective sub-region analysis. However, the absence of several modalities is very common in practice, leading to severe performance degradation in existing full-modality segmentation methods. Limited by the structured data model, recent works often adopt a multi-stage training strategy for full-modality and missing-modality scenarios, which increases training costs and inadequately addresses the interference of miss. In this work, we propose a graph-based one-stage framework for robust brain tumor segmentation with missing modalities. Specifically, we introduce modality-specific virtual nodes that serve as supplementary information sources to compensate for missing modalities. To enhance model robustness against arbitrary modality combinations, we leverage the inherent flexibility of graph networks to devise a dynamic connection strategy. This mechanism dynamically adjusts the adjacency matrix based on modality availability, preserving beneficial information flow while mitigating interference effects caused by missing modalities. Furthermore, we enhance the graph network through heterogeneous weight matrices, enhancing its adaptability to multimodal scenarios. Extensive experiments on the BRATS-2018 and BRATS-2020 datasets demonstrate that our method outperforms the state-of-the-art methods on almost all subsets of incomplete modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图的单阶段框架，通过引入模态特异性虚拟节点和动态连接策略，有效解决了脑肿瘤分割中因模态缺失导致的性能下降问题，在BRATS数据集上取得了最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态分割方法在模态缺失时性能严重下降，而多阶段训练策略成本高且难以有效处理缺失模态的干扰问题。
AI.method: 提出基于图的单阶段框架：1）引入模态特异性虚拟节点作为缺失模态的补充信息源；2）利用图网络的灵活性设计动态连接策略，根据模态可用性动态调整邻接矩阵；3）通过异构权重矩阵增强图网络对多模态场景的适应性。
AI.result: 在BRATS-2018和BRATS-2020数据集上，几乎所有不完整模态子集上的表现均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的图基单阶段框架能有效应对任意模态组合缺失的情况，在降低训练成本的同时提升了模型鲁棒性和分割性能。

title: ACIL: Auto Chain of Thoughts for In-Context Learning
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have shown that Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning can substantially improve performance on complex reasoning tasks. At the same time, In-Context Learning (ICL) has become an important mechanism for adapting LLMs to new tasks without updating model parameters, using only examples provided in the prompt. However, standard ICL often struggles on tasks that require multi-step reasoning, because the demonstrations usually contain only input-output pairs and lack explicit intermediate reasoning steps. This paper introduces an Automatic Chain-of-Thought (Auto-CoT) framework to improve ICL by automatically constructing reasoning-enhanced demonstrations. Auto-CoT generates reasoning chains for input-output examples, augments the prompt context with structured intermediate explanations, and removes irrelevant or low-quality demonstrations through a systematic selection process. By incorporating high-quality reasoning examples into the ICL prompt, Auto-CoT guides the model toward more reliable reasoning and improves prediction accuracy. Experiments across multiple reasoning tasks demonstrate that the proposed framework improves ICL performance by providing explicit intermediate reasoning guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Auto-CoT框架，通过自动生成推理链并将其融入上下文学习（ICL）的示例中，提升大语言模型在复杂推理任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 标准ICL在需要多步推理的任务上表现不佳，因为提供的示例通常仅包含输入-输出对，缺乏显式的中间推理步骤，难以引导模型进行有效推理。
AI.method: Auto-CoT框架自动为输入-输出示例生成推理链，通过结构化中间解释增强提示上下文，并采用系统化选择过程去除无关或低质量的示例，最终将高质量推理示例融入ICL提示中。
AI.result: 在多个推理任务上的实验表明，Auto-CoT通过提供显式的中间推理指导，有效提升了ICL的性能和预测准确性。
AI.conclusion: 自动构建推理增强示例能够显著改善上下文学习在多步推理任务上的表现，为LLM提供更可靠的推理引导。

title: NGM: A Plug-and-Play Training-Free Memory Module for LLMs
summary: Recent studies introduce conditional memory modules that decouple knowledge storage from neural computation, enabling more direct knowledge access. Compared to MoE, which relies on dynamic computation paths, explicit lookup provides a more efficient knowledge retrieval mechanism. However, these approaches still depend on learned memory embeddings, requiring additional training and limiting flexibility. To address this, we propose N-gram Memory (NGM), a training-free, plug-and-play module composed of a Causal N-Gram Encoder and a Cosine-Gated Memory Injector. The Causal N-Gram Encoder directly averages the pretrained token embeddings of the backbone model to construct N-gram representations, thereby eliminating the need to train separate N-gram embeddings from scratch. This design requires neither an additional memory table nor a retrieval pipeline. The Cosine-Gated Memory Injector then uses a non-parametric cosine gate with ReLU to modulate the retrieved embeddings into the contextual representations. We evaluate NGM on the Qwen3 series from 0.6B to 14B across eight benchmarks. NGM improves average performance by 0.5 to 1.2 points, with particularly clear gains on code generation and knowledge-intensive tasks (e.g., +3.0 on LiveCodeBench and +3.03 on GPQA for Qwen3-14B). Moreover, NGM also improves performance in multimodal benchmarks (e.g., MMStar +1.53 on Qwen3-VL-2B).

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练、即插即用的N-gram记忆模块（NGM），通过因果N-gram编码器和余弦门控注入器，在不增加额外训练的情况下提升大模型在代码生成和知识密集型任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有条件记忆模块仍依赖学习得到的记忆嵌入，需要额外训练且灵活性受限。为了解决这一问题，作者希望设计一种无需训练、可直接插拔的记忆增强模块。
AI.method: NGM由两个组件构成：1）因果N-gram编码器，直接对预训练token嵌入求平均来构建N-gram表示，无需额外训练或检索管道；2）余弦门控记忆注入器，通过非参数的余弦门控+ReLU将检索到的嵌入调制到上下文表示中。
AI.result: 在Qwen3系列（0.6B~14B）的8个基准上，NGM平均提升0.5~1.2个点。代码生成任务（LiveCodeBench +3.0）和知识密集型任务（GPQA +3.03 on 14B）提升显著，在多模态基准（MMStar +1.53 on 2B VL模型）中也有改善。
AI.conclusion: NGM是一种有效的训练免费记忆增强方法，在多种规模模型和多类任务上均能稳定提升性能，特别适合代码和知识密集型场景。

title: Multilingual OCR-Aware Fine-Tuning and Prompt-Guided Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary:
Optical character recognition (OCR) and multilingual text understanding remain major failure modes of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), particularly in real-world images containing cluttered layouts, small fonts, blur, occlusion, and complex typography.
  We present an OCR-aware multilingual multimodal training framework that combines (i) large-scale synthetic OCR-to-translation data generation, (ii) OCR-aware supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with LoRA adaptation, and (iii) structured visual chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting for reasoning under uncertain visual conditions. Using a LLaMA-based multimodal architecture, the proposed framework substantially improves OCR completeness, multilingual translation accuracy, and robustness under degraded visual conditions.
  Experimental results on multilingual receipts, menus, posters, signs, handwritten text, and document images demonstrate significantly improved visual-text grounding compared with the baseline model. In particular, the proposed OCR-aware post-training framework improves extraction of small, blurred, spatially scattered, and partially occluded text while reducing reliance on language priors under uncertain OCR conditions. Qualitative comparisons with frontier multimodal systems, including GPT-5-class and Gemini-family models, further suggest improved OCR grounding and reduced hallucination under noisy and visually ambiguous OCR scenarios.
  Overall, the results indicate that data-centric OCR-aware multimodal post-training provides an effective and scalable direction for improving multilingual OCR and OCR-based visual question answering systems.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种OCR感知的多语言多模态训练框架，通过大规模合成OCR-翻译数据、LoRA微调和结构化视觉思维链提示，显著提升了MLLM在多语言OCR和视觉文本理解中的鲁棒性和准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型在真实场景的OCR任务中表现不佳，尤其是在杂乱布局、小字体、模糊、遮挡和复杂排版的图像中，多语言文本理解仍是主要失败模式。
AI.method: 1) 大规模合成OCR-翻译数据生成；2) 基于LoRA的OCR感知监督微调；3) 结构化视觉思维链提示推理。基于LLaMA多模态架构实现。
AI.result: 在多语言收据、菜单、海报、标志、手写文本和文档图像上显著提升了视觉-文本对齐，尤其在提取小字、模糊、空间分散和部分遮挡文本方面，幻觉现象减少。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的OCR感知多模态后训练是提升多语言OCR和基于OCR的视觉问答系统的有效且可扩展的方向。

title: TOBench: A Task-Oriented Omni-Modal Benchmark for Real-World Tool-Using Agents
summary: Tool-using agents are increasingly expected to operate across realistic professional workflows, where they must interpret multimodal inputs, coordinate external tools, inspect intermediate artifacts, and revise their actions before producing a final result. Existing benchmarks, however, often evaluate tool use, computer use, and multimodal reasoning in isolation, leaving a gap between benchmark settings and end-to-end omni-modal tool use in the real world. To address this gap, we introduce MM-ToolBench, a benchmark and evaluation harness for task-oriented omni-modal tool use. MM-ToolBench contains 100 executable tasks from two macro task families, Customer Service and Intelligent Creation, covering 20 subcategory slices and supported by 27 MCP servers with 324 tools. The central design of MM-ToolBench is closed-loop multimodal verification: agents must execute tools, inspect rendered or transformed artifacts, and self-correct when outputs fail task-specific requirements. To make such evaluation scalable and verifiable, MM-ToolBench couples MCP-based execution with task-specific grounded evaluators and a semi-automated construction pipeline for scenario discovery, task instantiation, evaluator synthesis, and human audit. Experiments on 15 contemporary agentic models show that MM-ToolBench remains highly challenging: Claude Opus 4.6, commonly regarded as one of the strongest coding-agent models, achieves only 32.0% task success, far below the 94.0% human benchmark. We envision MM-ToolBench as a practical foundation for evaluating and advancing next-generation omni-modal tool-using agents through closed-loop multimodal verification.

AI.tldr: MM-ToolBench 是一个面向全模态工具使用代理的基准测试，包含100个可执行任务、27个MCP服务器和324个工具，通过闭环多模态验证评估代理能力。实验表明最强模型Claude Opus 4.6仅达32.0%成功率，远低于人类94.0%的水平。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试将工具使用、计算机使用和多模态推理孤立评估，缺乏现实世界中端到端全模态工具使用的评估环境。
AI.method: 构建了包含客户服务和智能创作两大任务族、100个可执行任务的基准测试；采用闭环多模态验证设计，要求代理执行工具、检查中间结果并自我修正；结合MCP执行、任务特定评估器和半自动构建管道。
AI.result: 在15个当代代理模型上测试，Claude Opus 4.6仅达32.0%任务成功率，人类基准为94.0%。
AI.conclusion: MM-ToolBench可作为评估和推动下一代全模态工具使用代理的实用基础。

title: Test-Time Hinting for Black-Box Vision-Language Models
summary: Test-time scaling (TTS) methods have proven highly effective for LLMs, yet their application to vision-language models (VLMs) remains relatively underexplored. Existing VLM TTS methods largely require open-weight model access or expensive repeated sampling, and are evaluated primarily on multimodal mathematical and scientific reasoning benchmarks rather than general visual understanding tasks. In this paper, we propose Test-Time Hinting, a method that improves VLM performance via a single VLM call and requiring only black-box API access, which makes it broadly applicable to frontier closed-weight models. Our method is motivated by the observation that VLM errors tend to cluster around recurring failure patterns. We therefore train a lightweight hint generator model to predict, for a given test input, which "hint" should be prepended to the prompt, providing targeted contextual or procedural guidance that steers the VLM away from its characteristic failure modes. We show that Test-Time Hinting improves the accuracy of multiple closed-weight VLMs on natural-image VQA benchmarks and that these gains generalize to unseen benchmarks and VLMs without retraining the hint generator.

AI.tldr: 提出测试时提示方法，通过轻量级提示生成器为VLM生成前置提示，仅需单次黑盒API调用即可提升性能，适用于闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM的测试时扩展方法要么需要开放权重模型，要么需要昂贵的重复采样，且主要在数学和科学推理基准上评估，而非通用视觉理解任务。
AI.method: 训练一个轻量级提示生成器，针对给定测试输入预测应前置到提示中的"提示"内容，提供针对性的上下文或过程指导，使VLM避开其典型失败模式。
AI.result: 在自然图像VQA基准上提升了多个闭源VLM的准确率，且这些增益可泛化到未见过的基准和VLM上，无需重新训练提示生成器。
AI.conclusion: 测试时提示方法是一种高效、通用的VLM性能提升方案，仅需单次调用和黑盒API访问，适用于前沿闭源模型。

title: HyDRA: Hybrid Dynamic Routing Architecture for Heterogeneous LLM Pools
comment: 26 pages, preprint v1. Production-telemetry tables and per-language breakdown deferred to v2
summary: Production LLM deployments increasingly maintain heterogeneous model pools spanning order-of-magnitude cost differences. Existing routers make binary strong-vs-weak decisions and couple learned parameters to specific model identities, requiring retraining whenever the catalog changes. We present HyDRA (Hybrid Dynamic Routing Architecture), a framework that predicts fine-grained, multi-dimensional capability requirements per query and matches them against configuration-defined model profiles via shortfall matching. A ModernBERT encoder with K=4 independent sigmoid heads scores each query along reasoning, code generation, debugging, and tool use; a shortfall-matching algorithm then selects the cheapest model whose capabilities meet the predicted requirements. The deployed predictor runs at 86 ms median CPU inference latency in production, and is fully decoupled from the model catalog -- adding or removing models requires only a configuration change, with zero retraining. On SWE-Bench Verified (5-model pool: GPT-5.4-mini, Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.3 Codex, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4), HyDRA's tunable shortfall threshold spans three regimes: peak-quality exceeds the always-strong Claude Sonnet 4.6 baseline (75.4% vs. 74.2% resolution) at 12.9% cost savings; iso-quality matches Sonnet at 54.1% cost savings, a 6x improvement over our prior in-house binary router at 9.1%; aggressive pushes savings to 72.5% for a 3.2-point quality trade. Results generalize across LiveCodeBench, BigCodeBench, and tau-bench. HyDRA is deployed to all users in GitHub Copilot's VS Code Chat auto-mode and -- to our knowledge for the first time in the LLM routing literature -- demonstrates language-invariant routing across CJK, European, and other script families.

AI.tldr: HyDRA 是一个基于现代 BERT 编码器的多维度能力评分与短额匹配（shortfall-matching）的 LLM 路由框架，能根据查询需求动态选择最便宜的模型，无需在模型目录变更时重新训练，在 SWE-Bench Verified 上达到 54.1% 成本节省的同时保持与最强模型相同的质量，并首次证明了语言无关的路由能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的 LLM 路由器仅做二元强-弱决策，且将学习参数与特定模型身份耦合，模型目录一变更就需要重新训练，无法适应异构模型池中成本差异达数量级的现实生产环境。
AI.method: 使用 ModernBERT 编码器（4 个独立 sigmoid 头）对查询在推理、代码生成、调试和工具使用四个维度进行评分，然后通过短额匹配算法选择满足能力需求的最便宜模型。预测器与模型目录完全解耦，增减模型仅需配置文件变更。
AI.result: 在 5 模型池（SWE-Bench Verified）上，HyDRA 的峰值质量超越始终使用最强模型的基线（75.4% vs 74.2%），成本节省 12.9%；等质量时成本节省 54.1%（对比先前二元路由器的 9.1%）；激进模式成本节省 72.5%，质量仅下降 3.2 个点。结果在 LiveCodeBench、BigCodeBench、tau-bench 上泛化良好。生产环境 CPU 推理延迟中位数 86 ms。
AI.conclusion: HyDRA 提出了一种解耦、多维度、可配置的 LLM 路由方法，在成本与质量之间取得了显著优于现有方案的平衡，且首次在 LLM 路由文献中展示了跨 CJK、欧洲及其他语系的与语言无关的路由能力，已部署到 GitHub Copilot VS Code Chat 的 auto-mode 中。

title: Reducing Hallucination in Vision-Language Models via Stage-wise Preference Optimization under Distribution Shift
summary:
Hallucination remains a fundamental challenge in vision-language models (VLMs), where autoregressive generation may produce linguistically plausible yet physically inconsistent or visually ungrounded responses due to likelihood maximization under joint probabilistic modeling.
  We propose a stage-wise preference optimization framework for hallucination reduction through targeted multimodal data construction. Rather than directly optimizing on generic instruction-following data, our approach progressively constructs hallucination-focused preference pairs near known failure boundaries. The framework emphasizes ambiguous spatial orientation, object relationships, OCR uncertainty, and adversarial false-premise training. Hallucinated negatives are generated through minimally perturbed yet visually inconsistent alternatives, enabling Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to better separate grounded reasoning from plausible hallucination.
  Experiments on open-source benchmarks and real-world multimodal evaluation scenarios demonstrate improved grounding consistency, reduced hallucination, and more informative grounded responses. Cross-model qualitative evaluation further shows that the proposed multimodal LLM DPO framework produces more visually grounded responses than several frontier proprietary VLMs, such as in ambiguous spatial reasoning and adversarial false-premise settings. The results suggest that hallucination may arise not only from limited model capacity, but also from inherent tendencies of autoregressive probabilistic generation to favor linguistically plausible continuations under weak visual grounding. Future work may explore physical consistency modeling, uncertainty-aware multimodal reasoning, and architectural alternatives beyond standard autoregressive decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种阶段式偏好优化框架，通过构建特定幻觉偏好数据对（空间关系、OCR不确定性等），利用DPO减少VLM中的幻觉问题，实验证明该方法能提升视觉基础一致性，超越多个前沿闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 当前VLM在自回归生成中因最大化联合概率而易产生语言合理但视觉不一致的幻觉，现有方法缺乏针对幻觉边界附近的定向优化。
AI.method: 构建阶段式偏好优化框架：1）在失败边界附近构造幻觉偏好数据对（空间方位、目标关系、OCR不确定性、对抗性虚假前提）；2）通过最小扰动生成负样本；3）使用DPO区分有根据推理与看似合理的幻觉。
AI.result: 在开源基准和真实多模态评估中显著提升基础一致性、减少幻觉；在模糊空间推理和对抗性虚假前提设置中超越多个前沿闭源VLM。
AI.conclusion: 幻觉不仅源于模型容量限制，还与自回归生成的固有倾向（偏好语言合理延续而弱视觉基础）有关；未来可探索物理一致性建模、不确定性感知推理及非自回归架构。

title: The Point of No Return: Counterfactual Localization of Deceptive Commitment in Language-Model Reasoning
summary: Existing deception datasets label completed outputs as honest or deceptive, treating deception as a property of the final response rather than a function of the model's reasoning trace. This obscures a more fundamental question: when does a language model become committed to deception? We introduce counterfactual localization: for each sentence prefix in a reasoning trace, we fix the prefix, resample continuations, and estimate the probability of a deceptive outcome. To scale this, we construct five environments (spanning strategic bluffing, maze guidance, financial advice, used-car sales, and offer negotiation) in which deception is never prompted but emerges from strategic incentives and labels follow mechanically from environment state rather than subjective human judgment. The resulting corpus localizes $\sim$1.46M sentences across four reasoning models, drawn from over 94.1M sampled continuations, 91.5B generated tokens, and over 100K scenarios. Sentence-level human evaluation confirms that detected commitment points correspond to interpretable shifts in decision state. Using this resource, we show that lexical cues for commitment prediction transfer poorly across environments, whereas attention-based transition features generalize out of distribution, suggesting that deceptive commitment is reflected in reusable changes in reasoning dynamics rather than surface form. We further identify compact attention-head sets (under 10% of heads) that, selected on one environment, causally suppress deceptive commitment across held-out environments. We release the corpus as a substrate for studying deception, and more broadly commitment, in language-model reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反事实定位方法，构建了包含五个场景的推理轨迹数据集，用于研究语言模型何时在推理过程中产生欺骗性承诺。通过分析注意力机制，发现基于注意力转换的特征可以跨环境泛化，且仅需不到10%的注意力头即可抑制欺骗。
AI.motivation: 现有欺骗数据集将欺骗视为最终输出的属性，忽略了模型在推理轨迹中何时开始产生欺骗这一更根本的问题。
AI.method: 提出反事实定位：固定推理轨迹中的每个句子前缀，重采样后续内容并估计欺骗概率。构建五个战略环境（包括策略性虚张声势、迷宫导航、财务建议、二手车销售和报价谈判），在无提示欺骗的情况下通过环境激励机制诱导欺骗行为。
AI.result: 生成了包含约146万句子、超过9410万次采样延续、915亿生成token和10万+场景的数据集。发现基于词汇特征的承诺预测跨环境迁移性差，而基于注意力转换的特征具有良好的分布外泛化能力。识别出不到10%的注意力头可以跨环境因果性地抑制欺骗承诺。
AI.conclusion: 欺骗性承诺反映了可跨环境复用的推理动态变化，而非表层形式。释放的数据集可作为研究语言模型推理中欺骗与承诺行为的资源。

title: How do Humans Process AI-generated Hallucination Contents: a Neuroimaging Study
summary: While AI-generated hallucinations pose considerable risks, the underlying cognitive mechanisms by which humans can successfully recognize or be misled by these hallucinations remain unclear. To address this problem, this paper explores humans' neural dynamics to characterize how the brain processes hallucinated content. We record EEG signals from 27 participants while they are performing a verification task to judge the correctness of image descriptions generated by a multi-modal large language model (MLLM). Based on an averaged event-related potential (ERP) study, we reveal that multiple cognitive processes, e.g., semantic integration, inferential processing, memory retrieval, and cognitive load, exhibit distinct patterns when humans process hallucinated versus non-hallucinated content. Notably, neural responses to hallucinations that were misjudged versus correctly judged by human participants showed significant differences. This indicates that misjudged AI-generated hallucinations failed to trigger the standard neurocognitive fact verification pathway.

AI.tldr: 通过EEG实验发现，人类处理AI生成的幻觉内容与非幻觉内容时表现出不同的神经认知模式，而被误判的幻觉未能触发标准的事实验证神经通路。
AI.motivation: AI幻觉带来风险，但人类识别或被误导的认知机制尚不清楚，因此需要从神经层面探索大脑如何处理幻觉内容。
AI.method: 记录27名参与者在验证多模态大语言模型生成的图像描述正确性时的EEG信号，进行平均事件相关电位（ERP）分析。
AI.result: 语义整合、推理处理、记忆检索和认知负荷等多种认知过程在处理幻觉与非幻觉内容时表现出不同模式；被误判的幻觉与正确判断的幻觉在神经反应上存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 被误判的AI生成幻觉未能激活人类正常的事实验证神经认知通路。

title: NERVE: A Neuromorphic Vision and Radar Ensemble for Multi-Sensor Fusion Research
comment: To be published in ICJNN 2026 Maastricht
summary: We present NERVE (Neuromorphic Vision and Radar Ensemble), a multi-sensor dataset comprising 257 minutes of synchronized recordings from five sensors: two Dynamic Vision Sensors (DVS), an RGB-D camera, and two Radar units (24GHz and 77GHz). Captured across 12 measurement days in office environments, NERVE contains around 600GB of uncompressed temporally aligned data with around 914,000 frames and around 9.6 million RGB COCO-formatted annotations covering 16 relevant object categories. To evaluate multi-modal fusion, we construct a DVS+Radar subset for human detection and distance estimation.
