Baseline experiments using feed-forward and recurrent detectors show that combining DVS with 77GHz Radar consistently improves detection, with recurrent models achieving up to 47.5% mAP and mean absolute Radar distance errors below 1.8m against LiDAR ground truth.

AI.tldr: NERVE是一个多传感器数据集，包含DVS、RGB-D相机和双波段雷达的同步记录，用于多模态融合研究，实验表明DVS+77GHz雷达组合可提升人类检测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集缺少事件相机与雷达的同步多模态数据，难以支持动态场景下的多传感器融合研究。
AI.method: 采集了257分钟的五传感器同步数据（两个DVS、RGB-D相机、24GHz和77GHz雷达），构建DVS+Radar子集，使用前馈和循环检测器进行基线实验。
AI.result: 循环模型在DVS+77GHz雷达融合下达到47.5% mAP，雷达距离误差低于1.8米（以LiDAR为真值）。
AI.conclusion: DVS与77GHz雷达融合可有效提升人类检测和距离估计性能，NERVE数据集为多模态感知研究提供了有价值的基准。

title: Diffusion Models, Denoiser Architecture and Creativity
summary: The creativity of diffusion models refers to their ability to generate highly realistic images that are different from their training data. Creativity is somewhat surprising since it is known that if the denoiser used in the diffusion model is the Bayes optimal denoiser for a given training set, then the model will simply copy the training samples. In this paper we present empirical and theoretical results that suggest that creativity in diffusion models is due to an interaction between the denoiser architecture and the target distribution. Theoretically, we give explicit forms for the distribution of generated samples as a function of the target distribution and the denoiser architecture for three different denoiser architectures (linear, polynomial, bottleneck). Empirically, we show that small changes in the popular UNET denoiser architecture leads to very different forms of creativity, and these small changes often yield samples that are highly nonrealistic. Taken together, our results show that diffusion models will only be successful if the inductive bias of the denoiser architecture is in strong alignment with the true target distribution.

AI.tldr: 扩散模型之所以能生成与训练数据不同的逼真图像（即“创造力”），是由于去噪器架构与目标分布之间的相互作用，而非单纯的记忆训练样本。理论给出了线性、多项式、瓶颈三类架构的生成分布显式形式，实验发现UNET架构的微小改动会显著影响创造力甚至导致非真实样本。结论强调去噪器的归纳偏差必须与真实目标分布高度对齐才能成功。
AI.motivation: 解释扩散模型为何能生成不同于训练数据的高质量图像（即“创造力”），因为理论上最优贝叶斯去噪器只会复制训练样本，但实际模型却能创造新样本。
AI.method: 理论分析：推导线性、多项式、瓶颈三种去噪器架构下生成样本分布的显式形式；实证分析：修改UNET架构的细节，观察对创造力及图像真实性的影响。
AI.result: 生成样本的分布由目标分布和去噪器架构共同决定；UNET的小改动会导致截然不同的创造力形式，且往往产生非真实样本；去噪器的归纳偏差与目标分布的有力对齐是模型成功的关键。
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型的创造力源于去噪器架构的归纳偏差与目标分布的交互作用，为保证生成真实样本，去噪器架构必须与真实数据分布高度一致。

title: Why Do Safety Guardrails Degrade Across Languages?
summary: Large language models exhibit safety degradation in non-English languages. Standard evaluation relies on Jailbreak Success Rate (JSR), which confounds several safety-driving factors into one, obscuring the specific cause(s) of safety failure. We introduce a latent variable model, a Multi-Group Item Response Theory (IRT) framework, that decouples safety-driving factors such as language-agnostic safety robustness ($θ$), intrinsic prompt hardness ($β$), global language processing difficulty ($γ$), and a prompt-specific cross-lingual safety gap ($τ$). Using the MultiJail dataset, we evaluate the safety robustness of 61 model configurations across 5 closed-model families and 10 languages of varying resource, aggregating a dataset of 1.9 million rows. Exploratory Factor Analysis shows safety is primarily unidimensional: models refuse different harm types mainly through a shared mechanism. Contrary to the expected trend that safety degrades largely in low-resource languages, 22 model configurations are more vulnerable in English than in low-resource languages. Low-resource languages produce more uncertain responses (high entropy) than high-resource languages. Also, high-$τ$ prompts cluster in physical harm categories like Theft and Weapons and lower-resource languages, trends validated through cross-dataset generalization. While global translation quality shows low correlation with $τ$, severe mistranslations drive high-bias outliers, as validated by native speakers. Cultural and conceptual grounding mismatches also contribute to $τ$. In predictive validation, the IRT framework achieves $\mathrm{AUC} = 0.940$, outperforming simpler baselines in predicting safe refusal of unsafe prompts. Our framework reveals concept-language vulnerabilities that aggregate metrics obscure, enabling fairer cross-lingual safety evaluation and targeted improvements in dataset construction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多群体项目反应理论（IRT）框架，将安全退化因素解耦为语言无关的稳健性、提示固有难度、语言处理难度和跨语言安全差距，在61个模型配置、10种语言、190万行数据上验证，AUC达0.940，揭示低资源语言并非最脆弱，物理危害类别和高资源语言也可能存在更大安全差距。
AI.motivation: 标准 Jailbreak Success Rate (JSR) 指标混淆了多个安全驱动因素，无法识别安全失败的具体原因，因此需要一种解耦框架来公平评估跨语言安全。
AI.method: 提出 Multi-Group Item Response Theory (IRT) 潜变量模型，解耦四个安全驱动因素（θ、β、γ、τ）。使用 MultiJail 数据集，评估61个模型配置、5个闭源模型家族、10种语言，共190万行数据。采用探索性因子分析、跨数据集泛化验证、母语者验证等方法。
AI.result: 安全主要是一维的；22个模型配置在英语中比低资源语言更脆弱；低资源语言产生高熵不确定性响应；高τ提示集中在盗窃、武器等物理危害类别；翻译质量与τ相关性低，但严重误译导致高偏差异常；IRT框架AUC=0.940，优于基线。
AI.conclusion: IRT框架揭示了聚合指标掩盖的概念-语言漏洞，为更公平的跨语言安全评估和针对性数据集改进提供了工具。

title: Brain Vascular Age Prediction Using Cerebral Blood Flow Velocity and Machine Learning Algorithms
summary: Defining vascular age in terms of physiological function has become one focal point of the extensive studies to categorize and track chronological age. Transcranial Doppler (TCD) is a method by which cerebral blood flow velocity is measured along the major arteries feeding the human brain. This study aims to use features extracted from TCD to estimate chronological age and assess accelerated aging in subjects with various brain diseases. We predict subjects with various brain diseases to present with accelerated cerebrovascular aging when tested on various regression models trained by healthy subjects. 168 healthy subjects and 277 diseased subjects with bilateral TCD recordings of the middle cerebral artery were analyzed using the Morphological Analysis and Clustering of Intracranial Pressure (MOCAIP) algorithm. MOCAIP-generated features and heart rate variability features were used as input features for regression models to predict the brain vascular age. 66 subjects with acute stroke, 27 subjects with post stroke, 26 subjects with Alzheimer's disease, 23 subjects with mild cognitive impairment, and 135 established subjects were tested against the machine learning model to assess for accelerated cerebrovascular age. The trained model, on average, predicted healthy subjects' cerebrovascular age to be 3.69 years above their chronological age. Subjects with different disease conditions exhibited varying levels of age acceleration. The differences in healthy and diseased subjects' performances suggest that features generated using TCD may be relevant when evaluating accelerated cerebrovascular aging. Moreover, imbalanced datasets have been observed to affect the performance of machine-learning-based brain age prediction models.

AI.tldr: 本文利用经颅多普勒超声（TCD）提取的特征，结合MOCAIP算法和心率变异性特征，构建回归模型预测大脑血管年龄。研究发现，健康被试的预测年龄平均比实际年龄大3.69岁，而不同脑疾病患者表现出不同程度的加速血管老化，表明TCD特征可用于评估脑血管衰老加速情况，同时数据不平衡会影响模型性能。
AI.motivation: 研究者希望利用TCD这一无创技术测量脑血流速度，从中提取特征来估算生理年龄，并评估不同脑疾病患者是否存在加速的脑血管老化现象，从而为脑血管健康评估提供新的生物指标。
AI.method: 研究分析了168名健康被试和277名疾病被试的双侧大脑中动脉TCD记录数据；使用MOCAIP算法提取特征，结合心率变异性特征作为输入；基于健康被试数据训练多种回归模型，然后用于预测疾病被试的脑血管年龄。
AI.result: 健康被试预测的脑血管年龄平均比实际年龄高3.69岁；不同疾病组（急性卒中66例、卒中后27例、阿尔茨海默病26例、轻度认知障碍23例、已确诊患者135例）表现出不同程度的加速老化；数据不平衡影响了模型的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: TCD提取的特征在评估加速脑血管老化方面具有潜在价值，可用于区分不同脑疾病患者的血管老化程度。同时研究提示，在构建基于机器学习的脑年龄预测模型时需注意数据不平衡问题。

title: CAVE: A Structured Credit Assignment Approach for Fragmented Visual Evidence Reasoning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance on general multimodal reasoning, yet remain challenged in integrating nonlocal visual information to support semantically underdetermined visual reasoning. We describe this challenge as Fragmented Visual Reasoning. To this end, we propose Credit Assignment for Visual Evidence (CAVE), a structured process-reward method based on GRPO for interleaved visual reasoning. Specifically, CAVE evaluates the contribution of intermediate steps at the action level via three complementary reasoning process signals: belief update, evidence acquisition, and adaptive focus control, thereby guiding the model to optimize each reasoning action and learn more reliable visual reasoning strategies. Meanwhile, we construct TRACER-Bench, which covers four nonlocal and semantically confusable reasoning dimensions and provides key intermediate evidence to supervise reasoning paths. Experiments demonstrate that CAVE substantially improves performance on tasks requiring fragmented visual evidence integration, covering both public benchmarks and our newly introduced TRACER-Bench, while retaining competitive performance on general multimodal evaluations. Further analyses reveal that CAVE effectively improves the visual reasoning capacity and exhibits stronger robustness under longer-range and deeper cross-region dependencies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAVE方法，基于GRPO的结构化过程奖励机制，解决视觉语言模型在非局部视觉信息整合上的碎片化视觉推理难题，并构建了TRACER-Bench基准，实验表明CAVE显著提升了碎片化视觉证据整合能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在通用多模态推理上表现良好，但面对需要整合非局部视觉信息、语义欠定的视觉推理任务时存在明显不足，这种挑战被称为"碎片化视觉推理"问题。
AI.method: 提出Credit Assignment for Visual Evidence (CAVE)方法，基于GRPO的强化学习框架，通过三种互补的推理过程信号（信念更新、证据获取、自适应焦点控制）在动作层面对中间步骤进行贡献评估，引导模型优化每一步推理动作。
AI.result: CAVE在需要碎片化视觉证据整合的任务上显著提升性能，覆盖公共基准和TRACER-Bench，同时在通用多模态评估上保持竞争力；进一步分析表明CAVE有效提升了视觉推理能力，在更长范围、更深跨区域依赖下表现出更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CAVE通过细粒度的过程奖励机制成功改善了VLM在碎片化视觉推理上的局限性，为视觉语言模型的结构化推理优化提供了有效路径。

title: PluRule: A Benchmark for Moderating Pluralistic Communities on Social Media
summary: Social media are shifting towards pluralism -- community-governed platforms where groups define their own norms. What violates rules in one community may be perfectly acceptable in another. Can AI models help moderate such pluralistic communities? We formalize the task as a multiple-choice problem, mirroring how human moderators operate in the real world: given a comment and its surrounding context, identify which specific rule, if any, is violated. We introduce PluRule, a multimodal, multilingual benchmark for detecting 13,371 rule violations across 1,989 Reddit communities spanning 2,885 rules in 9 languages. Using this benchmark, we show that state-of-the-art vision-language models struggle significantly: even GPT-5.2 with high reasoning performs only slightly better than a trivial baseline. We also find that bigger models and increased context provide marginal gains, and universal rules like civility and self-promotion are easier to detect. Our results show that moderation of pluralistic communities on social media is a fundamental challenge for language models. Our code and benchmark are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PluRule基准，用于评估AI模型在多元社区中检测规则违反的能力，发现即使最先进的视觉语言模型表现也很差。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体正转向多元社区治理模式，不同社区有不同规则，现有AI模型难以适应这种多元化的内容审核需求。
AI.method: 将任务形式化为多项选择问题，构建PluRule基准，包含13,371条规则违反案例，覆盖1,989个Reddit社区、2,885条规则和9种语言。
AI.result: 最先进的视觉语言模型（如GPT-5.2）表现仅略优于简单基线；更大模型和更多上下文带来的提升有限；文明和自推等通用规则更容易检测。
AI.conclusion: 多元社区的内容审核对当前语言模型而言是一个根本性挑战，现有AI远未达到实用水平。

title: A Conflict-aware Evidential Framework for Reliable Sleep Stage Classification
summary: Multi-view learning has been widely applied for sleep stage classification using multi-modal data. However, existing methods typically assume that different modalities are well-aligned, which is often unattainable in real-world scenarios, thereby compromising the reliability of the staging results. In this paper, we propose ConfSleepNet, a conflict-aware evidential framework that dynamically resolves inter-view conflicts. The framework consists of multi-view evidence extraction and conflict-aware aggregation. In the first phase, it learns category-related evidence from different modalities, which represents the degree of support for individual sleep stages. Considering the inherent characteristics of varying modalities, we propose hybrid category structures for different modalities to promote more reasonable evidence learning. In the second phase, view-specific opinions, including prediction results and uncertainty, are constructed from the learned evidence. Notably, we propose a novel conflict-aware aggregation method that integrates these view-specific opinions into a reliable joint decision. This mechanism can effectively resolve conflicts among opinions and synthesize them into a reliable joint decision. Both theoretical analysis and experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of ConfSleepNet in sleep staging tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/By4te/ConfSleepNet_ICML2026/.

AI.tldr: ConfSleepNet是一个冲突感知的认知框架，通过多视角证据提取和冲突感知聚合，动态解决多模态睡眠分期中不同模态间的观点冲突，提升分期结果的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有多视角学习方法通常假设不同模态数据是对齐的，但在真实场景中这一假设难以满足，导致分期结果可靠性下降。
AI.method: 提出ConfSleepNet框架，包含两个阶段：1) 多视角证据提取阶段，针对不同模态设计混合类别结构以学习合理的类别证据；2) 冲突感知聚合阶段，将各视角的预测结果和不确定性构建为观点，通过冲突感知方法融合成可靠的联合决策。
AI.result: 理论分析和实验结果表明ConfSleepNet在睡眠分期任务中有效。
AI.conclusion: ConfSleepNet通过冲突感知机制有效解决了多模态睡眠分期中的视角冲突问题，提升了分期可靠性。

title: Neural Visual Decoding via Cognitive guided Adaptive Blurring and Information Constrained Alignment
summary: EEG-based visual decoding aims to establish a mapping between neural signals and visual semantics. However, it remains constrained by the dual challenges of severe information granularity mismatch and the low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of EEG signals. Existing approaches typically treat static visual features, ignoring the dynamic selectivity of human vision and the frequency specificity of neural oscillations. To bridge this gap, we propose CAIA, a Cognitive-guided Adaptive blurring with Information-Constrained Alignment framework for Neural-Visual decoding. On the visual side, it simulates selective attention to adaptively reduce redundancy. Meanwhile, on the EEG side, it leverages neural oscillation priors and the information bottleneck mechanism to enhance SNR. Specifically, we devise a cognitive-dynamics-based adaptive blurring mechanism that dynamically integrates center-biased and saliency-guided visual cues via cross-modal attention. Furthermore, we introduce a distribution-aware boundary calibration loss to robustly rectify alignment bias caused by outlier samples. Moreover, a cognitively-guided information-screening method is proposed to select task-relevant EEG oscillations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAIA improves both subject-dependent and subject-independent average Top-1 and Top-5 accuracy in zero-shot brain-to-image retrieval, significantly outperforming prior methods. Our work validates that optimizing visual information density to match neural granularity offers a more interpretable and robust pathway for neural decoding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAIA框架，通过在视觉端模拟选择性注意进行自适应模糊降冗余，在EEG端利用神经振荡先验和信息瓶颈机制提升信噪比，实现了更优的零样本脑-图像检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG视觉解码方法存在信息粒度不匹配和信噪比低两大挑战，且通常将视觉特征视为静态，忽略了视觉的动态选择性和神经振荡的频率特异性。
AI.method: CAIA框架包含三部分：(1) 基于认知动态的自适应模糊机制，通过跨模态注意力动态融合中心偏置和显著性引导的视觉线索；(2) 分布感知边界校准损失，用于修正异常样本导致的对齐偏差；(3) 认知引导的信息筛选方法，选择与任务相关的EEG振荡。
AI.result: 在零样本脑-图像检索任务中，CAIA在subject-dependent和subject-independent设置下的平均Top-1和Top-5准确率均显著优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过优化视觉信息密度使其匹配神经粒度，为神经解码提供了一条更可解释且更鲁棒的路径。

title: Reliability and Effectiveness of Autonomous AI Agents in Supply Chain Management
summary: This paper studies autonomous generative AI agents in multi-echelon supply chains using the MIT Beer Game. We identify four inference-time levers that shape performance: model selection, policies and guardrails, centralized data sharing, and prompt engineering. Model capability is the dominant factor: an out-of-the-box reasoning model exceeds human-level performance, and optimized reasoning models reduce costs by up to 67% relative to human teams. However, strong average performance masks substantial reliability risks. We introduce the agent bullwhip effect, the amplification of decision unreliability across echelons, manifesting along two dimensions: decision variance increases both across facilities at the same point in time and within the same facility across time. We develop a mathematical framework showing that this phenomenon is inherent to multi-agent systems that involve coordination and information delays, and we demonstrate that repeated sampling fails to meaningfully reduce it. To address this limitation, we propose a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)-based reinforcement-learning post-training framework that trains a shared base LLM using system-level supply-chain rewards. GRPO post-training substantially reduces tail events, curtails agent bullwhip, and improves the reliability of autonomous supply-chain agents.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在MIT啤酒游戏的多级供应链中，使用生成式AI智能体的效果。发现模型能力是主导因素，推理模型可超越人类水平并降低成本67%，但存在可靠性风险。提出了“智能体牛鞭效应”，并开发了基于GRPO的强化学习后训练框架来提升可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏对生成式AI智能体在多级供应链中系统性表现的全面分析，特别是其可靠性问题和潜在风险未被充分认识。
AI.method: 在MIT啤酒游戏环境中，通过四个推理时杠杆（模型选择、策略与护栏、集中数据共享、提示工程）评估AI智能体表现；提出数学框架解释智能体牛鞭效应；采用GRPO强化学习后训练方法优化共享基础大语言模型。
AI.result: 1）推理模型开箱即可超越人类水平；2）优化后成本降低67%；3）发现并定义了智能体牛鞭效应（决策不可靠性在供应链各层级间放大）；4）GRPO后训练显著减少尾部事件并提升可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 尽管AI智能体在供应链中平均表现优异，但存在严重可靠性隐患。GRPO强化学习后训练是缓解智能体牛鞭效应、提升多级供应链智能体系统可靠性的有效方法。

title: Evidential Information Fusion on Possibilistic Structure
summary: Dempster's rule is a fundamental tool for combining belief functions from distinct and reliable sources. However, its intersection-based semantics imposes strong structural restrictions, which limits its flexibility in handling complex source states and diverse information fusion scenarios. To overcome this limitation, we propose a reversible transformation, derived from the isopignistic principle, between belief functions and a possibilistic structure defined on the power set. In this transformation, the relationships among subsets are explicitly characterized by a belief evolution network, which provides a more flexible representation of evidential information beyond the conventional mass function structure. On this basis, we further introduce the triangular norm family to develop a general and adaptive evidential information fusion framework. Unlike fusion methods rooted in Dempster semantics, the proposed framework supports more flexible combination behaviors and exhibits advantages in non-distinct source fusion, conflict management, parametric combination design, and heterogeneous information fusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于可逆变换和三角范数的广义证据融合框架，克服了Dempster规则在信息融合中的结构限制，支持更灵活的组合行为。
AI.motivation: Dempster规则虽然是将不同可靠来源的信念函数进行组合的基本工具，但其基于交集的语义存在严格的结构限制，难以灵活处理复杂来源状态和多样化的信息融合场景。
AI.method: 提出一种基于isopignistic原理的可逆变换，将信念函数转化为幂集上的可能性结构；通过信念演化网络显式刻画子集间关系；引入三角范数族构建通用且自适应的证据融合框架。
AI.result: 所提框架支持更灵活的组合行为，在非不同来源融合、冲突管理、参数化组合设计和异构信息融合方面具有优势。
AI.conclusion: 与基于Dempster语义的融合方法相比，该框架更具灵活性和适应性，能够应对更广泛的信息融合场景。

title: Video Reconstruction using Diffusion-based Image-to-Video Generation with Trajectory Guidance
comment: Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Multi-Sensor Trajectory Knowledge Discovery and Extraction (MuseKDE 2026), co-located with the 27th IEEE International Conference on Mobile Data Management (IEEE MDM 2026)
summary: This paper addresses the problem of reconstructing missing or dropped frames in top-down drone video of autonomous surface vehicles performing structured maritime manoeuvres. We propose a pipeline that converts raw GPS telemetry and a single reference frame into a trajectory-guided video sequence using a pre-trained image-to-video diffusion model, requiring no domain-specific fine-tuning. GPS coordinates from onboard telemetry logs are projected into image space via an equirectangular mapping, producing per-vessel motion cues that condition the SG-I2V diffusion model. The generated frames are evaluated against ground-truth video using perceptual, temporal and trajectory-based metrics, and benchmarked against optical flow extrapolation and RIFE interpolation baselines. SG-I2V produces the most naturally appearing frames among all methods (BRISQUE 25.52, closest to ground-truth 23.64), the most realistic motion magnitude (temporal smoothness 1.14 vs. ground truth 1.42), and the strongest GPS trajectory adherence (9.31px vs. 28.70px for ground-truth, the latter reflecting approximate temporal alignment between footage and GPS logs rather than generation error), demonstrating that trajectory-guided diffusion synthesis is a viable approach to maritime video reconstruction under challenging low-texture, small-object conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用GPS遥测数据和单张参考帧，通过预训练图像到视频扩散模型重建无人机航拍中缺失水面无人艇视频帧的方法，无需领域微调，在低纹理、小目标条件下表现优于光流外推和RIFE插值基线。
AI.motivation: 解决在结构化海上机动场景中，自上而下无人机视频中缺失或丢弃帧的重建问题，现有方法在低纹理、小目标的海洋环境下效果不佳。
AI.method: 将GPS坐标通过等距柱状投影映射到图像空间生成运动线索，输入SG-I2V扩散模型生成视频帧；使用感知、时序和轨迹指标评估，并与光流外推和RIFE插值方法对比。
AI.result: SG-I2V在感知质量（BRISQUE 25.52）、时序平滑度（1.14）和轨迹一致性（9.31像素）上均优于基线方法，最接近真实视频表现。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹引导的扩散合成是海上视频重建的有效方法，在低纹理、小目标条件下具有优势。

title: OProver: A Unified Framework for Agentic Formal Theorem Proving
summary: Recent progress in formal theorem proving has benefited from large-scale proof generation and verifier-aware training, but agentic proving is rarely integrated into prover training, appearing only at inference time. We present OProver, a unified framework for agentic formal theorem proving in Lean 4, in which failed proof attempts are iteratively revised using retrieved compiler verified proofs and Lean compiler feedback. OProver is trained through continued pretraining followed by iterative post-training: each iteration runs agentic proving, indexes newly verified proofs into OProofs and the retrieval memory, uses repair trajectories as SFT data, and uses unresolved hard cases for RL. OProofs is built from public Lean resources, large-scale proof synthesis, and agentic proving traces, containing 1.77M Lean statements, 6.86M compiler-verified proofs, and serialized trajectories with retrieved context, failed attempts, feedback, and repairs. Across five benchmarks, OProver-32B attains the best Pass@32 on MiniF2F (93.3%), ProverBench (58.2%), and PutnamBench (11.3%), and ranks second on MathOlympiad (22.8%) and ProofNet (33.2%) more top placements than any prior open-weight whole-proof prover.

AI.tldr: OProver 是一个统一框架，将智能体定理证明集成到训练中，通过持续预训练和迭代后训练（结合检索、编译器反馈、SFT 和 RL），在 Lean 4 上达到 SOTA 性能，构建了包含 1.77M 语句和 6.86M 验证证明的数据集 OProofs。
AI.motivation: 现有形式化定理证明受益于大规模证明生成和验证器感知训练，但智能体证明很少被集成到证明器训练中，仅在推理时使用，缺乏统一的训练框架。
AI.method: 提出 OProver，包含持续预训练和迭代后训练：每轮迭代执行智能体证明、将新验证的证明索引到 OProofs 和检索记忆、使用修复轨迹作为 SFT 数据、使用未解决的困难案例进行 RL。基于公开 Lean 资源、大规模证明合成和智能体证明轨迹构建 OProofs 数据集。
AI.result: 在五个基准测试中，OProver-32B 在 MiniF2F (93.3%)、ProverBench (58.2%) 和 PutnamBench (11.3%) 上取得最佳 Pass@32，在 MathOlympiad (22.8%) 和 ProofNet (33.2%) 上排名第二。
AI.conclusion: 将智能体证明集成到训练循环中可以显著提升定理证明性能，OProver 证明了统一训练框架的有效性，且性能超越之前的所有开源全证明证明器。

title: PersonaArena: Dynamic Simulation for Evaluating and Enhancing Persona-Level Role-Playing in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly serve as interactive social agents, yet their ability to maintain coherent and authentic persona-level role-playing remains limited, particularly in realistic social scenarios. Existing research predominantly focuses on character-level settings and relies on static evaluation formats, failing to capture the complexity of everyday social interactions. In this work, we present PersonaArena, a dynamic simulation framework for evaluating and improving persona-level role-playing in LLMs. PersonaArena leverages a large, filtered corpus of user-generated social content to construct a nuanced persona bank, and elicits multi-turn, context-rich interactions within simulated social environments. Our framework features a multi-agent debating judge for holistic and unbiased assessment. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that PersonaArena enables rigorous evaluation and enhancement of LLMs' role-playing capabilities, advancing the development of more authentic and socially adept AI agents.

AI.tldr: 提出了PersonaArena动态仿真框架，用于评估和提升LLM在真实社交场景中的个性化角色扮演能力，通过大规模用户内容构建角色库、多轮交互模拟和多方辩论评估机制，实验证明了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM角色扮演研究主要集中在角色设定层面，依赖静态评估方式，无法捕捉日常社交互动的复杂性，缺乏对真实社交场景中个性一致性角色扮演能力的评估手段。
AI.method: 构建PersonaArena框架：(1)利用大规模过滤后的用户生成社交内容构建细致的角色库；(2)在模拟社交环境中引发多轮、上下文丰富的交互；(3)采用多智能体辩论裁判机制进行整体且无偏的评估。
AI.result: 实验表明PersonaArena能够对LLM的角色扮演能力进行严格评估和提升，推动开发更真实、更善于社交的AI智能体。
AI.conclusion: PersonaArena为LLM在真实社交场景中的个性角色扮演提供了有效的评估与改进框架，有助于开发更具社交真实性的AI智能体。

title: Nonlinear Bipolar Compensation: Handling Outliers in Post-Training Quantization
summary: Network quantization has emerged as one of the most practical model compression techniques, which significantly reduces a model's memory and compute consumption by mapping floating-point numbers to low-bit representations. However, existing quantization methods typically suffer from the speed-accuracy tradeoff and limited generalization. To address these issues, recent compensation-based methods offer an efficient yet general solution by introducing additional lightweight linear layers into the quantized network. However, the accuracy of these methods suffers from their limited compensation capability and high sensitivity to outliers. In this paper, we propose Nonlinear Bipolar Compensation (NBC), a post-training quantization approach that introduces nonlinear compensation to reduce the effect of outliers. We further design Bipolar Logarithmic Transformation (BLT), which compresses outliers by mapping both the quantized input and the quantization error into a transformed space. A simple linear layer is then applied for compensation in the transformed space, preserving the efficiency of our method. Extensive experiments across various tasks, models, and quantization methods confirm the effectiveness, efficiency, robustness, and generality of our NBC approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出非线性双极补偿（NBC）方法，通过双极对数变换（BLT）在变换空间中进行非线性补偿，有效减少离群值影响，提升量化网络精度，且保持高效性。
AI.motivation: 现有量化方法存在速度-精度权衡和泛化能力有限的问题，而补偿类方法虽高效但补偿能力不足且对离群值敏感，亟需一种既能有效处理离群值又能保持高效率的量化方法。
AI.method: 提出非线性双极补偿（NBC）方法，核心是双极对数变换（BLT），将量化输入和量化误差映射到变换空间，再在该空间中应用简单线性层进行补偿，从而压缩离群值影响。
AI.result: 在多种任务、模型和量化方法上的大量实验验证了NBC在有效性、效率、鲁棒性和泛化性方面的优越表现。
AI.conclusion: NBC通过非线性补偿有效解决了离群值敏感问题，在保持高效的同时显著提升了量化网络的精度，是一种通用且鲁棒的量化后训练方法。

title: ConflictRAG: Detecting and Resolving Knowledge Conflicts in Retrieval Augmented Generation
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures, submitted to IEEE SMC 2026
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems implicitly assume mutual consistency among retrieved documents -- an assumption that frequently fails in practice. We present ConflictRAG, a conflict-aware RAG framework that detects, classifies, and resolves knowledge conflicts prior to answer generation. The framework introduces three contributions: (1) a two-stage conflict detection module combining a lightweight embedding-based MLP classifier with selective LLM refinement, reducing API costs by 62% while maintaining 90.8% detection accuracy; (2) an Entropy-TOPSIS framework for data-driven source credibility assessment, improving selection accuracy by 7.1% over manual heuristics; and (3) a Conflict-Aware RAG Score (CARS) for diagnostic evaluation of conflict-handling capabilities. Experiments on three benchmarks against six baselines demonstrate 88.7% conflict-detection F1 and consistent 5.3--6.1% correctness gains over the strongest conflict-aware baseline, with the pipeline transferring effectively across backbone LLMs.

AI.tldr: ConflictRAG是一个冲突感知的RAG框架，通过两阶段冲突检测、Entropy-TOPSIS可信度评估和CARS评分，有效解决检索文档间的知识冲突问题，在三个基准测试上取得88.7%的冲突检测F1值和5.3-6.1%的正确率提升。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统隐式假设检索文档间相互一致，但实际应用中文档常存在知识冲突，导致生成结果不可靠，亟需一个能主动检测和解决冲突的框架。
AI.method: 提出三部分方法：(1)两阶段冲突检测：轻量级嵌入MLP分类器+选择性LLM精炼，减少62%API成本；(2)Entropy-TOPSIS框架：数据驱动的信源可信度评估；(3)CARS评分：用于诊断性评估冲突处理能力。
AI.result: 冲突检测F1达88.7%，在三个基准测试上比最强基线提升5.3-6.1%正确率，API成本降低62%，且能有效迁移至不同骨干LLM。
AI.conclusion: ConflictRAG通过主动检测和解决文档冲突显著提升了RAG系统的可靠性，其模块化设计具有良好的跨模型迁移能力，为构建更鲁棒的RAG系统提供了有效方案。

title: Towards Human-Level Book-Writing Capability
summary: Large language models optimized for instruction following and agentic tasks remain poorly aligned with the requirements of high-quality creative writing. Fiction frequently depends on behaviors that assistant-tuned models are explicitly trained to avoid, particularly deception, moral ambiguity, and unreliable narration. As a result, generated stories often appear structurally correct while remaining stylistically generic, overly explanatory, or weakly grounded in human literary behavior. We present a dataset construction and training framework for book-scale creative writing that reframes supervised fine-tuning as a prompt-to-book generation task grounded in human-authored fiction. Starting from public-domain novels, we derive a multi-resolution planning scaffold by summarizing each book at progressively finer levels, from a high-level premise to chapter- and scene-level structure. We then invert this hierarchy during training: the model learns to expand a prompt into increasingly detailed plans and finally into the original human-authored book text. This formulation preserves human prose as the final supervised target while using intermediate summaries to make book-scale generation learnable. We train a long-context language model on these prompt-to-book trajectories and study whether this objective shifts generation away from assistant-style prose and toward human literary writing.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于多分辨率规划框架的提示词到书籍生成方法，通过将人类创作的小说重构为层级化的生成轨迹，使大语言模型能够学习书级别的文学创作，从而摆脱助手指令风格，生成更接近人类文学写作的文本。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型经过指令跟随和智能体任务优化后，生成的创意写作文本虽然结构正确，但风格上过于通用、解释性过强，缺乏人类文学行为中的欺骗、道德模糊和不可靠叙述等关键特征，无法满足高质量创意写作的需求。
AI.method: 从公共领域小说出发，构建多分辨率规划支架：对每本书从高层面梗概到章节、场景结构逐层总结；在训练时反转这一层级结构，让模型学习将提示词依次扩展为更详细的计划，最终生成原始的人类作者文本。在长上下文语言模型上训练这些提示词到书籍的生成轨迹。
AI.result: 论文提出了该方法并进行了实验验证，结果表明该框架使模型生成风格从助理式散文转向更接近人类文学写作，但具体定量和定性结果需进一步查看论文细节。
AI.conclusion: 通过将监督微调重构为基于人类创作小说的提示词到书籍生成任务，模型能够更好地学习书级别的文学创作，为提升大语言模型在创意写作领域的能力提供了有效路径。

title: EAGT: Echocardiography Augmentation for Generalisability and Transferability
summary: Deep learning models for echocardiography segmentation often struggle to generalise across institutions, scanners, and patient populations, where collecting large, consistently annotated datasets is infeasible. Data augmentation is widely used to improve the robustness of deep learning models; however, its role in enhancing cross-dataset generalisability in echocardiography remains insufficiently understood. This study presents a large-scale multi-dataset evaluation of 29 data augmentation techniques and their pairwise combinations for 2D left ventricular segmentation using a U-Net trained on Unity, CAMUS, and EchoNet Dynamic datasets. Each augmentation was explored under several hyperparameter settings and assessed through repeated runs using Dice and IoU in both in-domain and cross-dataset scenarios, with statistical significance quantified via independent t-tests. Results show that anatomically plausible geometric transformations, particularly affine, shift-scale-rotate, perspective, and random horizontal flip, substantially improve cross-dataset performance, whereas aggressive intensity- or artefact-based augmentations often degrade generalisability. Pairwise augmentation combinations outperform individual augmentations and show that moderate flip-centric combinations, especially random horizontal flip with affine, yield consistent gains across most transfer scenarios. These findings provide empirically grounded guidance for designing augmentation policies that enhance the robustness and transferability of echocardiography segmentation models.

AI.tldr: 本研究对29种数据增强技术及其组合进行了大规模多数据集评估，发现解剖学合理的几何变换（尤其是仿射、平移-缩放-旋转、透视和随机水平翻转）能显著提升超声心动图分割模型的跨数据集泛化能力，而激进强度或伪影增强则会损害泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图分割的深度学习模型在不同机构、扫描仪和患者群体间的泛化能力不足，而收集大规模一致标注的数据集不可行。数据增强虽被广泛使用，但其在提升跨数据集泛化性方面的作用尚未被充分理解。
AI.method: 在Unity、CAMUS和EchoNet Dynamic三个数据集上，使用U-Net进行2D左心室分割，评估了29种数据增强技术及其两两组合，每种增强在多个超参数设置下重复运行，通过Dice和IoU指标在域内和跨数据集场景中评估，并用独立t检验量化统计显著性。
AI.result: 解剖学合理的几何变换（仿射、平移-缩放-旋转、透视、随机水平翻转）显著提升跨数据集性能；激进强度或伪影增强常损害泛化性；两两组合优于单一增强，其中随机水平翻转与仿射的组合在多数迁移场景中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 研究为设计增强策略提供了经验依据，可提升超声心动图分割模型的鲁棒性和可迁移性。

title: Weak-to-Strong Elicitation via Mismatched Wrong Drafts
summary: We consider whether off-policy experience from a smaller, weaker model can elicit capability in a stronger learner that on-policy RL fine-tuning (e.g., GRPO) does not reach. We find that injecting mathematically wrong drafts from a smaller but more domain-trained model -- mismatched to the current problem -- into a stronger learner's GRPO context consistently outperforms standard on-policy GRPO on held-out MATH-500 and out-of-distribution AIME 2025/2026. Concretely, we use Mathstral-7B as the learner, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B as the draft model, 8.8K Level 3--5 MATH problems (with MATH-500 held out), and train with Dr. GRPO. Mismatch is an active ingredient: shuffling drafts to mismatched problems while holding everything else constant yields $+1.62$pp on MATH-500 (greedy pass@1) over the matched-wrong variant ($n=10$ seeds, $p=0.0015$, Welch's $t$). In fact, the mismatched-wrong variant leads all other variants we tested on MATH-500 across both greedy pass@1 and sampling pass@$k$. On out-of-distribution AIME 2025 and 2026, the mismatched-wrong variant uniquely lifts pass@$k$ above both Mathstral-7B (in its native [INST] format) and the Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B draft model at every sample budget from $k=1$ to $k=1024$ across 2 seeds ($+14.2$pp on 2025 and $+9.0$pp on 2026 at pass@1024 over Mathstral-7B), and at pass@1024 also leads no-draft, matched-wrong, and mismatched-correct variants on both years. All variants use the same prompt with no draft injection at test time. The recipe -- trained on a single GPU with no SFT, no reward models, no synthesized data, and no produce-critique-revise inner loop -- reaches 71.98% MATH-500 on Mathstral-7B-v0.1, the highest published result on this model to our knowledge, surpassing the heavier WizardMath pipeline at 70.9% on full MATH (SFT + PPO with process/instruction reward models).

AI.tldr: 在GRPO训练中，向强模型注入来自弱模型但**问题错配**的错误数学草稿，能显著提升强模型的数学推理能力，超越标准on-policy GRPO，仅用单GPU即取得SOTA结果。
AI.motivation: 探索是否可以通过来自更小、更弱模型的**off-policy经验**，诱导强学习者在on-policy RL微调（如GRPO）无法达到的能力。核心假设：错配（mismatch）的弱模型草稿反而比匹配的草稿更有效。
AI.method: 使用Mathstral-7B作为学习者，Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B作为草稿模型，在GRPO上下文中注入与当前问题不匹配的错误数学草稿（Dr. GRPO）。训练8.8K个MATH Level 3-5问题，无SFT、无奖励模型、无合成数据、无生产-批评-修改内循环，单GPU训练。
AI.result: 错配错误变体在MATH-500上greedy pass@1比匹配错误变体高1.62pp（p=0.0015）；在AIME 2025/2026上，从k=1到1024全面超越基线，AIME 2025 pass@1024提升14.2pp、2026提升9.0pp；Mathstral-7B上达到71.98% MATH-500，为已知最高结果。
AI.conclusion: 错配（mismatch）是有效成分；弱模型错配草稿能激发强模型更强能力；该方法极简高效，单GPU即可超越复杂pipeline（如WizardMath）。

title: Transitivity Meets Cyclicity: Explicit Preference Decomposition for Dynamic Large Language Model Alignment
summary: Standard RLHF relies on transitive scalar rewards, failing to capture the cyclic nature of human preferences. While some approaches like the General Preference Model (GPM) address this, we identify a theoretical limitation: their implicit formulation entangles hierarchy with cyclicity, failing to guarantee dominant solutions. To address this, we propose the Hybrid Reward-Cyclic (HRC) model, which utilizes game-theoretic decomposition to explicitly disentangle preferences into orthogonal transitive (scalar) and cyclic (vector) components. Complementing this, we introduce Dynamic Self-Play Preference Optimization (DSPPO), which treats alignment as a time-varying game to progressively guide the policy toward the Nash equilibrium. Synthetic data experiments further validate HRC's structural superiority in mixed transitive--cyclic settings, where HRC converges faster and achieves higher accuracy than GPM. Experiments on RewardBench 2 demonstrate that HRC consistently improves over both BT and GPM baselines (e.g., +1.23% on Gemma-2B-it). In particular, its superior performance in the Ties domain empirically validates the model's robustness in handling complex, non-strict preferences. Extensive downstream evaluations on AlpacaEval 2.0, Arena-Hard-v0.1, and MT-Bench confirm the efficacy of our framework. Notably, when using Gemma-2B-it as the base preference model, HRC+DSPPO achieves a peak length-controlled win-rate of 44.75% on AlpacaEval 2.0 and 46.8% on Arena-Hard-v0.1, significantly outperforming SPPO baselines trained with BT or GPM. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/lab-klc/Hybrid-Reward-Cyclic.

AI.tldr: 针对标准RLHF中基于传递性标量奖励无法捕捉人类偏好循环性的问题，本文提出混合奖励-循环（HRC）模型和动态自对弈偏好优化（DSPPO）框架，显式解耦偏好为传递性和循环性成分，并通过博弈论方法引导策略向纳什均衡收敛，在多项基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 标准RLHF依赖传递性标量奖励，无法捕捉人类偏好的循环性（如A>B, B>C, C>A）。现有方法（如GPM）虽尝试解决但存在理论缺陷：其隐式公式将层次性与循环性纠缠在一起，无法保证主导解的存在。
AI.method: 1) 提出混合奖励-循环（HRC）模型，利用博弈论分解将偏好显式解耦为正交的传递性（标量）和循环性（向量）成分。2) 提出动态自对弈偏好优化（DSPPO），将对齐视为时变博弈，逐步引导策略向纳什均衡收敛。
AI.result: 合成数据实验：HRC在混合传递-循环场景下收敛更快、精度更高。RewardBench 2：HRC一致优于BT和GPM基线（Gemma-2B-it上+1.23%），在Ties领域表现突出。下游评估：Gemma-2B-it作为基座时，HRC+DSPPO在AlpacaEval 2.0上达到44.75% LC胜率，Arena-Hard-v0.1上达46.8%，显著优于基于BT或GPM的SPPO基线。
AI.conclusion: HRC模型从理论上解决了循环偏好建模的困境，DSPPO提供了有效的优化框架。实验充分证明了该方法在复杂、非严格偏好场景下的鲁棒性和有效性，为对齐研究提供了新的博弈论视角。

title: RAGA: Reading-And-Graph-building-Agent for Autonomous Knowledge Graph Construction and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary:
Existing LLM-driven knowledge graph (KG) construction methods predominantly employ stateless batch processing pipelines, exhibiting structural deficiencies in cross-chunk semantic relation capture, entity disambiguation, and construction process interpretability. These limitations undermine KG quality, retrieval precision, and deployment trust in high-stakes domains.
  We propose RAGA (Reading And Graph-building Agent), an LLM-based autonomous KG construction and retrieval fusion framework. RAGA provides an atomic toolset supporting full KG lifecycle CRUD operations and embeds a Read-Search-Verify-Construct cognitive constraint into a ReAct tool loop. A KG-vector synchronization mechanism enables hybrid symbolic-vector retrieval, while evidence-anchored verification links every knowledge entry to its source text for auditable provenance.
  Preliminary experiments on a subset of the QASPER scientific QA dataset indicate that RAGA's fusion retrieval outperforms zero-shot baselines, with KG integration providing measurable gains in both answer and evidence quality. The framework design and experimental baseline serve as a reference for agent-driven autonomous KG construction.

AI.tldr: 提出RAGA框架，结合LLM驱动的知识图谱自主构建与检索融合，通过原子化工具集、认知约束循环和混合检索机制，提升KG质量与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的KG构建方法采用无状态批处理流程，在跨块语义关系捕获、实体消歧和构建过程可解释性方面存在结构性缺陷，影响KG质量、检索精度和部署可信度。
AI.method: 提出RAGA框架，提供支持KG全生命周期CRUD操作的原子化工具集，将Read-Search-Verify-Construct认知约束嵌入ReAct工具循环，设计KG-向量同步机制实现混合检索，并通过证据锚定验证将知识条目链接到源文本。
AI.result: 在QASPER科学QA数据集的子集上，RAGA的融合检索优于零样本基线，KG集成在答案质量和证据质量上均有可测量的提升。
AI.conclusion: RAGA框架为智能体驱动的自主KG构建提供了参考基线，其设计能够提升跨块语义捕获、实体消歧和构建过程可解释性，适用于高风险领域。

title: KVCapsule: Efficient Sequential KV Cache Compression for Vision-Language Models with Asymmetric Redundancy
summary:
Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have emerged as a critical and fast-growing extension of Large Language Models (LLMs) that enable multimodal reasoning through both text and image inputs. Although VLMs enrich the capabilities of language models, they also inherit and amplify key computational bottlenecks: the memory overhead caused by the large key-value (KV) cache during autoregressive decoding. This challenge is particularly severe in VLMs, where images produce longer token sequences and denser feature representations compared to text. Moreover, the spatial and information-rich nature of vision tokens introduces structured attention patterns that make many LLM-oriented KV cache compression techniques ineffective when applied directly to VLMs.
  In this work, we conduct a detailed empirical analysis of the behavior of vision tokens, highlighting the critical differences from purely text-based models. Based on these insights, we propose KVCapsule, a novel KV cache compression framework for vision tokens. KVCapsule keeps the pretrained VLM backbone frozen, requires no modification to the attention computation modules, and can be integrated into existing VLMs through lightweight compression and reconstruction components. We evaluate KVCapsule on multiple VLMs and benchmark tasks, demonstrating up to 2x improvement in TPS and 2.4x reduction in KV cache memory at a 60% compression ratio, with negligible degradation in accuracy or response quality. Our findings offer practical pathways to scale VLM inference under constrained memory budgets and inspire further research into structure-aware cache compression for multimodal models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KVCapsule，一种针对视觉语言模型中视觉token的KV缓存压缩框架，在保持模型冻结且不影响注意力计算的前提下，实现了2倍吞吐量提升和2.4倍内存减少，精度几乎无损。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在自回归解码时，视觉token产生的KV缓存比文本token更长、特征更密集，导致严重的内存瓶颈。现有的LLM导向的KV缓存压缩技术由于视觉token的结构化注意力模式而效果不佳。
AI.method: 首先对视觉token的行为进行详细的实证分析，揭示其与纯文本模型的差异；然后提出KVCapsule框架，包含轻量级的压缩与重构组件，无需修改预训练VLM的骨干网络和注意力计算模块。
AI.result: 在多个VLM和基准任务上，60%压缩比下，TPS提升最多2倍，KV缓存内存减少最多2.4倍，精度和响应质量下降可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: KVCapsule为在内存受限条件下扩展VLM推理提供了实用方案，并启发了多模态模型中结构感知缓存压缩的进一步研究。

title: Taming "Zombie'' Agents: A Markov State-Aware Framework for Resilient Multi-Agent Evolution
summary: Recent advancements in LLM-based multi-agent systems have demonstrated remarkable collaborative capabilities across complex tasks. To improve overall efficiency, existing methods often rely on aggressive graph evolution among agents (e.g., node or edge pruning), which risks prematurely discarding valuable agents due to transient issues such as hallucinations or temporary knowledge gaps. However, such hard pruning overlooks the potential for ``zombie'' agents to recover and contribute in subsequent discussion rounds. In this paper, we propose AgentRevive, a Markov state-aware framework for resilient multi-agent evolution. Our approach dynamically manages agent collaboration through soft state transitions, implemented via two key components: (1) State-Aware Policy Learning: Agent states are divided into ``Active'', ``Standby'', and ``Terminated'' states, selectively propagating messages based on agent memory. The policy employs a risk estimator to optimize agent state transitions by assessing hallucination risk, minimizing the influence of unreliable nodes while safeguarding valuable ones. (2) State-Aware Edge Optimization: Subgraph edges are pruned according to states learned from the policy, permanently removing ``Terminated'' nodes and retaining ``Standby'' nodes for subsequent rounds to assess their potential future contributions. Extensive experiments on general reasoning, domain-specific, and hallucination challenge tasks show that our method consistently outperforms strong baselines and significantly reduces token consumption through state-aware agent scheduling.

AI.tldr: 提出AgentRevive框架，通过软状态转换（Active/Standby/Terminated）替代硬剪枝，解决多智能体系统中因幻觉或知识缺口导致有价值智能体被过早丢弃的问题，提升协作效率并降低token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体系统采用激进的图剪枝策略（如节点或边修剪），会因暂时性幻觉或知识缺口而永久丢弃有价值的智能体，忽略了"僵尸"智能体在后续轮次中恢复并贡献的潜力。
AI.method: 提出AgentRevive框架：1) 状态感知策略学习——将智能体状态分为Active、Standby、Terminated，通过风险估计器优化状态转换；2) 状态感知边优化——根据策略学习的状态对子图边进行剪枝，永久移除Terminated节点，保留Standby节点以评估其未来贡献。
AI.result: 在通用推理、领域特定和幻觉挑战任务上的大量实验表明，该方法持续优于强基线，并通过状态感知智能体调度显著降低token消耗。
AI.conclusion: AgentRevive通过软状态转换机制有效解决了多智能体系统中智能体过早丢弃的问题，在保持协作效率的同时提升了系统鲁棒性和资源利用率。

title: Scientific Logicality Enriched Methodology for LLM Reasoning: A Practice in Physics
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: With the continuous advancement of reasoning abilities in Large Language Models (LLMs), their application to scientific reasoning tasks has gained significant research attention. Current research primarily emphasizes boosting LLMs' performance on scientific QA benchmarks by training on larger, more comprehensive datasets with extended reasoning chains. However, these approaches neglect the essence of the scientific reasoning process -- logicality, which is the rational foundation to ensure the validity of reasoning steps leading to reliable conclusions. In this work, we make the first systematic investigation into the internal logicality underlying LLM scientific reasoning, and develop a scientific logicality-enriched methodology, including a set of assessment criteria and data sampling methods for logicality-guided training, to improve the logical faithfulness as well as task performance. Further, we take physics, characterized by its diverse logical structures and formalisms, as an exemplar discipline to practise the above methodology. For data construction, we extract scientific problems from academic literature and sample a high-quality dataset exhibiting strong logicality. Experiments based on three different backbone LLMs reveal that: 1) the training data we constructed can effectively improve the scientific logicality in LLM reasoning; and 2) the enriched scientific logicality plays a critical role in solving scientific problems. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/ScienceOne-AI/PhysLogic}{https://github.com/ScienceOne-AI/PhysLogic}.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究大语言模型科学推理中的逻辑性，提出了一套包含评估标准和数据采样方法的科学逻辑性增强方法，并以物理学为例进行实践，实验证明该方法能有效提升模型的逻辑忠实性和任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注通过更大数据集和更长推理链提升LLM在科学QA基准上的表现，但忽视了科学推理的本质——逻辑性，即确保推理步骤有效性并导向可靠结论的理性基础。
AI.method: 提出科学逻辑性增强方法论，包括一套评估标准和用于逻辑性引导训练的数据采样方法；以物理学为示例学科，从学术文献中提取科学问题，采样具有强逻辑性的高质量数据集。
AI.result: 基于三种不同骨干LLM的实验表明：1) 构建的训练数据能有效提升LLM推理中的科学逻辑性；2) 增强的科学逻辑性在解决科学问题中起关键作用。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的逻辑性增强方法能有效提升大语言模型的科学推理逻辑忠实性和任务性能，逻辑性是科学推理不可或缺的核心要素。

title: Semantic Smoothing via Novel View Synthesis for Robust SAR Image Classification
summary: Deep neural networks are vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, limiting deployment in safety-critical applications such as synthetic aperture radar (SAR) automatic target recognition (ATR). Randomized smoothing improves robustness by averaging predictions over noisy inputs, but isotropic noise often fails to preserve the semantic structure of SAR imagery. We propose semantic smoothing, a defense that replaces noised-based perturbations with structured randomized transformations generated by a novel view synthesis model. For SAR, we condition on acquisition geometry to synthesize multiple plausible radar views. Predictions across generated randomized views are aggregated to form a robust classifier. Experiments show that semantic smoothing improves robustness against standard attacks, such as FGSM and PGD, and SAR-specific attacks, such as OTSA and SMGAA, while also increasing clean classification accuracy. These results demonstrate that randomized smoothing via semantically preserving geometric transformations is a promising alternative to isotropic noise for adversarial defense in structured sensing domains.

AI.tldr: 提出语义平滑方法，用结构化随机变换代替各向同性噪声，通过视图合成模型生成多个合理雷达视角聚合预测，在SAR目标识别中提升对抗鲁棒性和干净分类准确率。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络易受对抗扰动影响，限制了在SAR自动目标识别等安全关键场景的部署。现有随机平滑方法使用各向同性噪声，但难以保留SAR图像的语义结构信息。
AI.method: 提出语义平滑防御方法，用基于新型视图合成模型生成的结构化随机变换替代基于噪声的扰动。针对SAR，根据采集几何条件合成多个合理的雷达视图，聚合各生成视图的预测结果形成鲁棒分类器。
AI.result: 在标准攻击（FGSM、PGD）和SAR专用攻击（OTSA、SMGAA）上均提升了鲁棒性，同时提高了干净样本的分类准确率。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义保持的几何变换进行随机平滑，是结构化感知领域中各向同性噪声对抗防御的一种有前景的替代方案。

title: AMATA: Adaptive Multi-Agent Trajectory Alignment for Knowledge-Intensive Question Answering
summary: Despite substantial advances in large language models (LLMs), generating factually consistent responses for knowledge-intensive question answering remains challenging. These difficulties are primarily due to hallucinations and the limitations of LLMs in bridging long-tail knowledge gaps. To address this, we propose AMATA, an Adaptive Multi-Agent Trajectory Alignment framework that dynamically integrates external knowledge to improve response interpretability and factual grounding. Our architecture leverages six specialized agents that collaboratively perform structured actions for complex question reasoning. We formalize multi-agent collaboration with external tools as a trajectory preference alignment problem, incorporating question-aware agent customization and inter-agent preference harmonization. AMATA introduces two principal innovations: (1) Intra-Trajectory Preference Learning, which learns objective-oriented preferences to prioritize critical agents, and (2) Inter-Agent Dependency Learning, which captures cross-agent tool dependencies through a novel dependency-aware direct preference optimization technique. Empirical results show that AMATA consistently outperforms baseline approaches, knowledge-augmented frameworks, and LLM-based trajectory systems on five established knowledge-intensive QA benchmarks. Further analysis demonstrates the efficiency of our method in reducing token consumption.

AI.tldr: AMATA是一个自适应多智能体轨迹对齐框架，通过六个专业智能体协作和轨迹偏好学习，提升知识密集型问答的准确性和可解释性，在五个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在知识密集型问答中常出现幻觉和长尾知识缺口问题，现有方法难以保证事实一致性。
AI.method: 提出AMATA框架，包含六个专业智能体协作推理，将多智能体协作形式化为轨迹偏好对齐问题，引入智能体间偏好协调、轨迹内偏好学习和依赖感知的直接偏好优化。
AI.result: 在五个知识密集型QA基准上持续优于基线方法、知识增强框架和基于LLM的轨迹系统，并有效降低token消耗。
AI.conclusion: AMATA通过多智能体协作和偏好对齐有效提升了问答的事实一致性，同时提高了推理效率。

title: Capturing LLM Capabilities via Evidence-Calibrated Query Clustering
summary: Query clustering organizes queries into groups that reflect shared latent capability demands, enabling capability-aware LLM evaluation. Existing clustering methods, which primarily rely on semantic taxonomies or embeddings, often fail to capture such latent capability requirements due to a misalignment between surface-level semantics and actual model performance. We propose ECC, an algorithm that calibrates prior semantic embeddings using limited posterior model comparisons to bridge the gap between surface-level semantics and latent capability requirements. ECC characterizes each cluster through a capability profile parameterized by a Bradley-Terry model and uses trainable mixture weights to accommodate queries with mixed capability demands, jointly learning a flexible, capability-aware clustering structure that supports query-specific inference of LLM capabilities. Extensive quantitative and qualitative evaluations demonstrate that ECC significantly improves LLM capability ranking quality, outperforming human-labeled and embedding-based baselines by an average of 17.64 and 18.02 percentage points, respectively, and proves effective in downstream tasks such as query routing.

AI.tldr: 提出ECC算法，通过有限的后验模型比较校准先验语义嵌入，将查询聚类为反映潜在能力需求的组，实现能力感知的LLM评估，性能显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于语义分类或嵌入的查询聚类方法无法捕捉表面语义与真实模型性能之间的潜在能力需求，导致能力感知的LLM评估存在偏差。
AI.method: ECC算法利用有限的后验模型比较校准先验语义嵌入，通过Bradley-Terry模型参数化每个簇的能力画像，并采用可训练的混合权重处理混合能力需求的查询，联合学习灵活的能力感知聚类结构。
AI.result: ECC在LLM能力排序质量上平均比人工标注和基于嵌入的基线方法分别提升17.64和18.02个百分点，在查询路由等下游任务中表现有效。
AI.conclusion: 通过校准语义嵌入与模型比较，ECC能够有效桥接表面语义与潜在能力需求之间的差距，显著提升能力感知的LLM评估和下游任务效果。

title: Learning Transferable Topology Priors for Multi-Agent LLM Collaboration Across Domains
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems have shown strong potential for complex reasoning by coordinating specialized agents through structured communication. However, existing topology-evolution methods typically construct or optimize a collaboration topology for each query from scratch, leading to substantial online search overhead, high inference-time token consumption, and limited scalability in multi-domain settings. We propose TopoPrior, a framework for learning transferable topology priors for multi-agent LLM collaboration across domains. Rather than repeatedly searching for effective collaboration structures online, TopoPrior learns reusable topology priors from reference collaboration graphs collected offline from multiple domains and uses them to generate query-conditioned initial collaboration graphs for downstream refinement. By shifting part of topology search from per-query online optimization to offline prior learning, TopoPrior amortizes search cost while remaining compatible with existing topology-evolution backbones. Technically, TopoPrior contains two key components. First, a transferable topology prior learning module employs a conditional variational graph framework to capture reusable structural regularities across domains in a latent space. Second, a query-conditioned latent adaptation module introduces adversarial alignment to reduce unnecessary domain discrepancy while preserving query-relevant structural variation. Experiments on multi-domain reasoning benchmarks show that TopoPrior consistently improves several heterogeneous topology-evolution backbones while reducing online inference-time token usage, with only modest additional trainable parameters. These results suggest that transferable topology initialization is an effective and lightweight mechanism for improving the efficiency of multi-agent LLM collaboration across domains.

AI.tldr: TopoPrior通过离线学习跨领域的可迁移拓扑先验，为多智能体LLM协作生成查询条件化的初始协作图，从而减少在线搜索开销和推理时token消耗，提升多领域协作效率。
AI.motivation: 现有拓扑演化方法为每个查询从头构建协作拓扑，导致在线搜索开销大、推理时token消耗高，且在跨领域场景下可扩展性有限。
AI.method: 提出TopoPrior框架，包含两个核心模块：1）可迁移拓扑先验学习模块，使用条件变分图框架在潜在空间中捕获跨领域的可复用结构规律；2）查询条件化潜在适配模块，通过对抗对齐减少领域差异并保留查询相关的结构变化。
AI.result: 在多领域推理基准上，TopoPrior一致提升多种异构拓扑演化骨干的性能，同时减少在线推理token使用量，仅增加少量可训练参数。
AI.conclusion: 可迁移拓扑初始化是一种有效且轻量的机制，能够提升多智能体LLM协作在跨领域场景下的效率。

title: F2IND-IT! -- Multimodal Fuzzy Fake Indian News Detection using Images and Text
summary: Biased manipulation of facts across regional and national media outlets complicates misinformation detection in diverse landscapes like India. This paper introduces a novel multimodal framework combining visual and textual modalities for enhanced fake news detection on Indian media. The architecture utilizes a ResNet-50 Convolutional Neural Network to extract visual features from news images, a DistilBERT encoder to obtain textual semantic embeddings, and an Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) to generate a fuzzy reliability score. A lightweight attention-based fusion module assigns learnable weights to each modality prior to classification. Evaluated on the IFND dataset, the proposed model is validated through an in-depth comparative analysis against previous research. Experimental results demonstrate superior performance across accuracy, precision, recall, and $F_1$-scores, confirming the efficacy of the architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合视觉特征（ResNet-50）、文本语义（DistilBERT）和模糊推理（ANFIS）的多模态假新闻检测框架，在印度媒体数据集IFND上取得了优于以往方法的检测效果。
AI.motivation: 印度地区区域与全国媒体之间存在事实的偏见性操纵，使得假新闻检测变得复杂，现有方法难以有效应对这种多模态、多语言的虚假信息环境。
AI.method: 采用ResNet-50提取新闻图片视觉特征，DistilBERT编码文本语义嵌入，ANFIS生成模糊可靠性评分，并通过轻量级注意力融合模块为每种模态分配可学习权重，最终进行分类。
AI.result: 在IFND数据集上，所提模型在准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数上均优于以往研究，验证了架构的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 多模态融合结合模糊推理系统能有效提升印度媒体环境下的假新闻检测性能，为区域语言媒体的 misinformation 检测提供了可行方案。

title: Multi-hop Relational Contrastive Learning: Extending Spatial Contrastive Pre-training Beyond Pairwise Relations
summary: Understanding how objects relate to each other in space is fundamental to scene understanding, yet most contrastive pre-training approaches only model pairwise relationships, leaving richer compositional and multi-hop interactions largely unexplored. We introduce Multi-Hop Relational Contrastive Learning (MRCL), a framework that extends spatial contrastive learning to graph-structured scene representations. By tracing k-hop paths through scene graphs built from detected objects, MRCL captures implicit spatial dependencies that go well beyond what direct object pairs can express. We define a multi-level contrastive objective spanning nodes, edges, and multi-hop paths, encouraging embeddings that remain stable across object semantics while staying responsive to spatial layout. On a GQA subset, MRCL produces spatially-aware representations that improve content-based graph retrieval (NDCG@5 = 0.748) and consistently benefit downstream tasks, including spatial relationship recognition and graph-based question answering. Together, these results suggest that multi-hop relational supervision offers substantially richer structural guidance than pairwise-only methods, leading to visual representations that are more robust, compositional, and geometry-aware.

AI.tldr: MRCL通过场景图中的多跳路径扩展了空间对比学习，在GQA子集上实现了更优的空间感知表示（NDCG@5=0.748），并提升了空间关系识别和图问答等下游任务。
AI.motivation: 现有对比预训练方法仅建模物体间的成对关系，无法捕捉丰富的组合性和多跳空间交互，限制了场景理解能力。
AI.method: 提出MRCL框架，追踪场景图中的k跳路径，定义包含节点、边和多跳路径的多级对比目标，使嵌入在保持物体语义稳定性的同时反映空间布局。
AI.result: 在GQA子集上，内容基图检索NDCG@5达到0.748，在空间关系识别和图问答等下游任务中持续提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 多跳关系监督比仅成对方法提供更丰富的结构指导，产生更鲁棒、更具组合性和几何感知能力的视觉表示。

title: NewsLens: A Multi-Agent Framework for Adversarial News Bias Navigation
summary: Media bias detection has predominantly been framed as a classification task: assign a political label to an article or outlet. We argue this framing is too shallow: it identifies that bias exists but not where, how, or crucially, what is structurally omitted. We present NewsLens, a five-agent adversarial pipeline for structured news bias navigation. A Fact Verifier, Progressive Framing Analyst, Conservative Framing Analyst, Propaganda Detector, and Neutral Summarizer collaborate to deconstruct articles into interpretable framing maps, exposing ideological omissions, rhetorical manipulation, and framing boundaries. The system is evaluated on 15 articles across four geopolitical event clusters (India-Pakistan Kashmir, Gaza, Climate Policy, Ukraine) using Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct (4-bit quantised, Google Colab T4), with cross-model validation using Mistral 7B on the Kashmir cluster. Center outlets show the highest mean Perspective Divergence Score (PDS: Qwen 0.907, Mistral 0.729 on Kashmir subset); conservative-framing outlets show the highest mean Manipulation Index (MI: 0.600 across both models). Cross-model comparison shows high consistency for high-propaganda content (Republic World delta-PDS=0.125, MI=0.8 both models) and greater variance for nuanced reporting. Mann-Whitney U tests find no statistically significant between-group differences at n=15, reported honestly as a sample-size limitation confirmed by post-hoc power analysis. A partial ablation removing the Propaganda Detector shows degraded omission precision in the Neutral Summarizer output. The architecture extends prior lexical-geometric bias work to agentic LLM reasoning, and is fully reproducible using open-weight models without API keys.

AI.tldr: NewsLens是一个五智能体对抗流水线，用于结构化新闻偏见分析，通过事实验证者、进步框架分析者、保守框架分析者、宣传检测器和中立摘要者协作，生成可解释的框架图谱，揭示意识形态遗漏、修辞操纵和框架边界。
AI.motivation: 传统的媒体偏见检测局限于分类任务（给文章或媒体打政治标签），无法识别偏见在哪里、如何体现以及结构上遗漏了什么。
AI.method: 提出NewsLens五智能体对抗流水线，包含Fact Verifier, Progressive Framing Analyst, Conservative Framing Analyst, Propaganda Detector, Neutral Summarizer，在15篇覆盖四个地缘政治事件集群（克什米尔、加沙、气候政策、乌克兰）的文章上评估，使用Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct（4-bit量化）和Mistral 7B交叉验证。
AI.result: 中心媒体视角分歧得分(PDS)最高（Qwen 0.907, Mistral 0.729）；保守框架媒体操纵指数(MI)最高（0.600）；跨模型一致性高；Mann-Whitney U检验未发现统计显著差异（样本量限制）；消融实验显示移除宣传检测器后中立摘要遗漏精度下降。
AI.conclusion: NewsLens将基于词汇-几何的偏见分析方法扩展到智能体LLM推理，使用开放权重模型完全可复现，无需API密钥。

title: Latent Heuristic Search: Continuous Optimization for Automated Algorithm Design
comment: Accepted at LION 2026, The Learning and Intelligent Optimization Conference
summary: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into evolutionary frameworks has established a new paradigm for automated heuristic discovery. Despite their promise, these methods typically search in the discrete space of program syntax, relying on stochastic sampling to navigate a highly non-convex optimization landscape. This work proposes a continuous heuristic discovery framework that shifts optimization to a learned latent manifold. We employ an encoder to map discrete programs into continuous embeddings and train a differentiable surrogate model to predict performance, enabling gradient-based search. To regularize the optimization trajectory, an invertible normalizing flow maps these embeddings to a structured Gaussian prior, where we perform gradient ascent. The resulting optimized latent vectors are projected through a learned mapper into soft prompts, which condition a frozen LLM to synthesize novel executable heuristics. We evaluate the proposed method on the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP), the Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), the Knapsack Problem (KSP), and Online Bin Packing (OBP). Empirical results demonstrate that continuous latent-space optimization achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art discrete evolutionary baselines while offering a complementary methodological alternative for automated algorithm design. The implementation code is available at \url{https://github.com/cheikh025/LHS}.

AI.tldr: 本工作提出了一种连续启发式发现框架，将优化从离散的程序语法空间转移到学习的潜在流形上，利用编码器、可微替代模型和归一化流进行梯度搜索，在TSP、CVRP、KSP和OBP问题上取得了与离散进化基线相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有将大语言模型集成到进化框架中的方法通常在离散的程序语法空间中进行搜索，依赖随机采样来导航高度非凸的优化景观，效率有限。本文旨在将优化转移到连续的潜在流形上，以实现更高效的梯度引导搜索。
AI.method: 使用编码器将离散程序映射为连续嵌入，训练可微替代模型预测性能以支持梯度搜索，利用可逆归一化流将嵌入映射到结构化高斯先验上进行梯度上升，最后通过学习映射器将优化的潜在向量投影为软提示，条件化冻结的大语言模型生成可执行启发式算法。
AI.result: 在旅行商问题（TSP）、带容量约束的车辆路径问题（CVRP）、背包问题（KSP）和在线装箱问题（OBP）上的实验表明，连续潜在空间优化达到了与最先进的离散进化基线相竞争的性能。
AI.conclusion: 连续潜在空间优化为自动化算法设计提供了一种有互补价值的方法论选择，代码已开源。

title: Dynamics of collective creativity in AI art competitions
summary: Creativity is a fundamental aspect of how culture evolves, yet the mechanisms by which groups produce novelty are notoriously difficult to infer from the historical record. Iterated learning experiments have shown that cultural transmission reliably distorts artifacts toward the inductive biases of learners, but most of this work uses linear chains between human participants, leaving open how these dynamics play out in the networked, human-AI systems that increasingly shape cultural production. In this study, we leverage one such system, Artbreeder, which hosts daily "remix parties" where users iteratively build on each other's work from a single seed image, producing branching lineages of human-AI co-created images. We analyze a dataset of 130,882 images from 368 remix parties over 13 months and find that images become simpler and converge toward common thematic "attractors" (e.g., steampunk scenes, alien architecture). We also find that while more novel "parent" images produce more novel and complex "children" that attract more likes, users paradoxically prefer to remix images that are less novel and complex. Finally, larger remix parties produce more novelty at the cost of lower complexity.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了Artbreeder平台上13个月内368场"混音派对"中的130,882张图像，发现人类-AI协作创作中图像趋于简化和汇聚到共同主题吸引子，存在新颖性与受欢迎程度之间的矛盾，且大型派对产生更多新颖性但复杂度更低。
AI.motivation: 理解群体如何在网络化的人机协作系统中产生新颖性，以及文化传播的动态机制，因为传统的线性链实验无法揭示网络化人机系统中的文化演化模式。
AI.method: 利用Artbreeder平台的"混音派对"数据，分析130,882张图像（来自368场派对，历时13个月），追踪用户迭代创作的分支谱系，量化图像的复杂度、新颖性和受欢迎程度。
AI.result: 1) 图像随时间趋于简化，并向共同主题吸引子收敛；2) 更新颖的父代图像产生更复杂新颖的子代图像并获更多点赞，但用户却偏好混音更不新颖和复杂的图像；3) 更大的派对产生更多新颖性但复杂度更低。
AI.conclusion: 人机协作的文化传播系统存在新颖性与传播偏好之间的张力：群体层面产生收敛性和简化趋势，而个体层面存在对新颖性的矛盾行为。

title: REC-RL: Referring expression counting via Gaussian and range-based reward optimization
summary: Referring expression counting (REC) is an intention-driven task that requires context-aware visual reasoning. While recent vision-language models incorporate language for visual understanding, most existing REC methods rely on rulebased reinforcement learning with rewards focused primarily on final accuracy, overlooking the quality of intermediate reasoning. We propose REC-RL, a reinforcement learning framework that introduces a think-range-answer paradigm to explicitly optimize the visual reasoning process. RECRL employs Group Relative Policy Optimization and two lightweight rewards: an accuracy reward that combines range-based interval supervision with Gaussian-based precision guidance, and a format reward that enforces structured outputs. By modeling intermediate focus prediction as internal decision-making, REC-RL avoids additional annotations and better aligns with human perception. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines and robust generalization across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: REC-RL提出了一种基于强化学习的框架，通过思考-范围-回答范式显式优化视觉推理过程，引入范围监督和高斯精度引导的奖励机制，无需额外标注即可提升参照表达式计数性能。
AI.motivation: 现有REC方法依赖基于规则的强化学习，奖励只关注最终准确率，忽略了中间推理过程的质量。
AI.method: 提出REC-RL框架，采用Group Relative Policy Optimization算法，设计了两种奖励：准确性奖励（范围监督+高斯精度引导）和格式奖励（强制结构化输出），通过建模中间焦点预测实现思考-范围-回答范式。
AI.result: 在多个基准上取得了对强基线的一致改进，并展现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: REC-RL通过显式优化推理过程的强化学习框架，有效提升了参照表达式计数的准确性和可解释性，且无需额外标注。

title: MiniGPT: Rebuilding GPT from First Principles
summary: This paper presents MiniGPT, a compact from-scratch implementation of GPT-style autoregressive language modeling in PyTorch. The aim is to rebuild the core GPT pipeline from first principles after studying the design of nanoGPT by Andrej Karpathy, while keeping the model and training code independently written in a single notebook. MiniGPT implements token and positional embeddings, causal multi-head self-attention, pre-LayerNorm Transformer blocks, residual connections, feed-forward MLP layers, next-token cross-entropy training (teacher forcing), validation tracking, checkpoint selection, and autoregressive text generation. This paper evaluates the implementation on Tiny Shakespeare dataset using character-level tokenization. A baseline 0.83M-parameter model reaches a validation loss of 1.7236 after 3000 training iterations. A stronger 10.77M-parameter configuration, using a larger context length and improved training settings, reaches a best validation loss of 1.4780 and generates text with recognizable Shakespeare-style dialogue structure. MiniGPT does not introduce a new language-model architecture. Instead, it documents a clear and reproducible implementation path from raw text to trained character-level generation, including design choices, training behavior, generation quality, and practical limitations.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MiniGPT，一个基于PyTorch从零实现的紧凑型GPT风格自回归语言模型，在Tiny Shakespeare数据集上实现字符级文本生成，最佳验证损失1.4780。
AI.motivation: 从第一性原理重建核心GPT流水线，提供清晰可复现的实现路径，帮助理解Transformer语言模型的工作原理。
AI.method: 基于nanoGPT设计，独立实现token/位置嵌入、因果多头自注意力、Pre-LayerNorm Transformer块、残差连接、前馈MLP、交叉熵训练（教师强制）、验证跟踪、检查点选择和自回归文本生成。
AI.result: 0.83M参数模型在3000次迭代后验证损失1.7236；10.77M参数模型最佳验证损失1.4780，能生成具有可识别莎士比亚风格的对话结构文本。
AI.conclusion: MiniGPT虽未提出新架构，但完整记录了从原始文本到训练后字符级生成的可复现路径，涵盖设计选择、训练行为、生成质量及实际局限性。

title: MADP: A Multi-Agent Pipeline for Sustainable Document Processing with Human-in-the-Loop
summary: Document processing automation remains a critical challenge in enterprise environments, where traditional manual approaches are labor-intensive and error-prone. We present MADP, a multi-agent architecture that addresses the challenge of automating document processing in enterprise settings by combining deep learning-based classification and parsing with large language model extraction, while maintaining accuracy through selective human validation. Our system integrates five specialized agents--Classificator, Splitter, Parser, Extraction, and Validator--with a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) mechanism and a novel Prompt Fine Tuning with Feedback Inheritance (PFTFI) approach. The operational analysis on a production use-case scenario of 100,000 invoices per year indicates a potential reduction of Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) requirements by approximately 70%. Production deployment on 955 real-world documents processed through January 2026 achieves a 97.0% full-pipeline automation rate, with only 3% requiring non-AI fallback. Ablation evaluation on a stratified 100-document subset (5 documents per each of 20 supplier/document-type categories) demonstrates that the full MADP configuration with Human-in-the-Loop supervision attains 98.5% document-level accuracy. Additionally, we present a comprehensive sustainability analysis showing that our hybrid AI+HITL approach reduces CO2 emissions by 69%, energy consumption by 69%, and water usage by 63% compared to traditional manual processing. Benchmark comparisons of multiple LLM backends (Granite-Docling, Mistral-Small, DeepSeek-OCR) provide practical insights for deployment in production environments.

AI.tldr: MADP是一个多智能体文档处理架构，结合深度学习分类解析、大语言模型提取和人工验证，在100,000张发票/年的场景下可减少约70%人力需求，实际部署955份文档实现97%全流水线自动化率，准确率达98.5%，同时相比传统人工处理减少69%碳排放、69%能耗和63%用水。
AI.motivation: 企业环境中文档处理自动化仍是关键挑战，传统人工方式劳动密集且易出错，亟需高效的自动化解决方案。
AI.method: 提出MADP多智能体架构，包含五个专用智能体（Classificator, Splitter, Parser, Extraction, Validator），结合Human-in-the-Loop机制和Prompt Fine Tuning with Feedback Inheritance (PFTFI)方法，并对比多种LLM后端（Granite-Docling, Mistral-Small, DeepSeek-OCR）。
AI.result: 生产部署955份真实文档实现97.0%全流水线自动化率，仅3%需非AI回退；在100份分层抽样文档上达到98.5%文档级准确率；相比人工处理减少约70%全职人力需求，降低69%碳排放、69%能耗和63%用水。
AI.conclusion: MADP混合AI+HITL方案在企业文档处理中实现了高自动化率、高准确率和显著的可持续性优势，为实际生产部署提供了实用见解。

title: MHMamba: Multi-Head Mamba for 3D Brain Tumor Segmentation
summary: Brain tumors exhibit high heterogeneity in morphology and multimodal contrast, making manual slice-by-slice de lineation time-consuming and experience-dependent, thus necessitating efficient and stable automated segmentation methods. To address the limitations of CNNs in modeling long-range dependencies, and the heavy computational and memory overhead and inter-block contextual in coherence of Transformers in 3D MRI, this paper proposes Multi-Head Mamba (MHMamba). This method combines a U-shaped architecture with a multi-head state-space model (Mamba), splitting the channel dimension into parallel SSM heads and aggregating them with residuals. This enhances long-range representation and improves the stability of multimodal training while maintaining linear complexity. To further align statistics and enhance lesion response, we designed a channel-space calibration module for multi-head outputs and introduced an adaptive fusion mechanism at skip connections to dynamically connect global semantics with local details, thereby improving boundary consistency and the detection of small-volume lesions. We conducted experiments and ablations on BraTS2021 and BraTS2023. The results showed that MHMamba achieved stable and significant improvements in overall accuracy, boundary smoothness, and sensitivity to tumor core and small-volume enhancement areas, while preserving the linear-complexity advantage of Mamba-based modeling, thus verifying the effectiveness and versatility of the method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MHMamba，一种结合U型架构与多头状态空间模型（Mamba）的3D MRI脑肿瘤分割方法，通过并行SSM头、残差聚合、通道-空间校准模块和自适应跳跃连接融合机制，在保持线性复杂度的同时提升了长程依赖建模能力和多模态训练稳定性，在BraTS2021和BraTS2023上取得了显著的分割精度提升。
AI.motivation: 脑肿瘤在形态和多模态对比度上表现出高度异质性，手动逐层勾画耗时且依赖经验，亟需高效稳定的自动分割方法。现有CNN难以建模长程依赖，而Transformer在3D MRI中存在计算和内存开销大、块间上下文不一致等问题。
AI.method: 提出Multi-Head Mamba (MHMamba)，将U型架构与多头状态空间模型结合，将通道维度拆分为并行SSM头并通过残差聚合；设计通道-空间校准模块用于多头输出对齐，并在跳跃连接中引入自适应融合机制以动态连接全局语义与局部细节。
AI.result: 在BraTS2021和BraTS2023上的实验表明，MHMamba在整体精度、边界平滑度、肿瘤核心和小体积增强区域的检测灵敏度上均取得稳定且显著的提升，同时保持了Mamba的线性复杂度优势。
AI.conclusion: 该方法验证了多头Mamba架构在3D MRI脑肿瘤分割中的有效性和通用性，在保持计算效率的同时显著改善了分割性能。

title: From Imitation to Interaction: Mastering Game of Schnapsen with Shallow Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper investigates whether shallow neural network agents can master the card game Schnapsen and challenge a strong search-based baseline, RdeepBot, which uses Monte Carlo sampling and lookahead search. Guided by a progressively more complex experimental design, we first evaluate a supervised learning agent (MLPBot) trained on replay data and then a reinforcement learning agent (RLBot) with the same shallow architecture trained through asynchronous Monte Carlo updates and experience replay. The results show that supervised imitation does not generalize well enough to defeat strong RdeepBot opponents, whereas reinforcement learning produces substantially stronger agents. In the setting that focuses on the depth parameter of RdeepBot, the best performance is achieved when the learned value function is combined with deeper lookahead during gameplay, allowing RLBot to achieve statistically significant higher winning rates against the strongest evaluated RdeepBot baseline. In the sample-based setting, the gains are more conditional: the strongest performance appears at a relatively lower training num_samples parameter rather than increasing uniformly with stronger sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究浅层神经网络智能体在斯卡普森牌戏中的表现，发现强化学习（RLBot）优于监督学习（MLPBot），且结合更深层搜索的RLBot能显著击败强搜索基线RdeepBot，但在样本设置中优势较为条件性。
AI.motivation: 探索浅层神经网络是否能在斯卡普森牌戏中掌握复杂策略，并挑战基于蒙特卡洛采样和前瞻搜索的强基线模型RdeepBot。
AI.method: 采用渐进式实验设计：先训练监督学习智能体MLPBot（基于回放数据），再训练相同架构的强化学习智能体RLBot（通过异步蒙特卡洛更新和经验回放）。评估两种设置：深度参数调整和样本数调整。
AI.result: 监督学习无法泛化打败强RdeepBot对手；强化学习产生更强智能体。深度设置下，结合更深层搜索的RLBot取得最高胜率；样本设置下，性能在较低训练样本参数时最优，而非随采样增强单调提升。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习结合搜索能有效提升浅层网络在复杂牌戏中的竞争力，但样本依赖性和条件性表现需进一步研究。

title: Mechanistically Interpretable Neural Encoding Reveals Fine-Grained Functional Selectivity in Human Visual Cortex
summary: A central goal in understanding human vision is to uncover the visual features that drive neuronal activity. A growing body of work has used artificial neural networks as encoding models to predict cortical responses to natural images, revealing the visual content that activates category-selective regions. However, existing approaches are largely correlational and treat the encoder as a black box, leaving open which image features drive each voxel's response. We introduce Mechanistically Interpretable Neural Encoding (MINE), a framework that opens this black box by applying mechanistic-interpretability tools to localize the features within natural images that drive millimeter-scale (voxel-level) activity. MINE predicts each voxel's response using language-aligned image representations, and produces semantically interpretable descriptions of the features critical for the voxel's activation. We further generalize these per-image features into per-voxel functional profiles. To validate the per-image descriptions, we show they are sufficient to generate images that elicit voxel responses matching the responses to the original images, more accurately than images generated from random or low-attribution controls. Moreover, counterfactually inserting or removing the predicted features from images shifts activation in the expected direction, providing causal evidence. Counterfactual editing guided by the per-voxel activation profiles produces even stronger activation shifts, indicating that the profiles faithfully capture each voxel's selectivity. Finally, we apply MINE to well-studied category-selective brain regions, showing it recovers their known categorical preferences while revealing fine-grained unique voxel structure within each region. Overall, our results establish mechanistic interpretability as a path to discover and causally validate fine-grained hypotheses about neural function.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MINE框架，利用机械可解释性工具打开编码模型的黑箱，定位自然图像中驱动每个体素响应的视觉特征，并生成语义可解释的描述，通过因果验证表明该方法能忠实捕捉体素选择性，并在已知类别选择区域中恢复了细粒度的体素结构。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将编码器视为黑箱，只能相关性预测皮层响应，无法确定驱动每个体素响应的具体图像特征。
AI.method: MINE框架利用语言对齐的图像表示预测体素响应，应用机械可解释性工具定位关键特征并生成语义描述，再泛化为每个体素的功能画像，通过反事实图像编辑进行因果验证。
AI.result: （1）生成的图像能准确匹配原始图像的体素响应；（2）反事实插入或移除预测特征能按预期方向改变激活；（3）基于体素功能画像的编辑产生更强的激活偏移；（4）在已知类别选择区域中恢复了已知类别偏好并揭示了细粒度的独特体素结构。
AI.conclusion: 机械可解释性为发现和因果验证神经功能的细粒度假设提供了一条可行路径。

title: Beyond Catalogue Counts: the Dataset Visibility Asymmetry in Low-Resource Multilingual NLP
comment: Accepted at the 15th edition of the Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2026)
summary: Multilingual NLP often relies on dataset counts from centralized catalogues to characterize which languages are resource-rich or resource-poor. However, these catalogues record only one layer of dataset visibility: what has been registered or institutionally distributed. They do not necessarily reflect which datasets are created, cited, or reused in the research literature. To examine this gap, we combine a catalogue-based baseline with literature-backed evidence of dataset circulation. We introduce the Resource Density Index (RDI), defined as the number of catalogued datasets per one million speakers, and compute it for the 200 most widely spoken languages in Ethnologue. Among them, 118 languages (59%) have an average RDI of zero across the LRE Map and the Linguistic Data Consortium (LDC), and another 23 fall below 0.1, corresponding to at most one catalogued dataset per ten million speakers. We then apply an LLM-assisted citation-mining pipeline over the Semantic Scholar corpus to these 141 low-visibility languages. After manual validation and consolidation, we identify 609 unique datasets across 53 languages, of which 356 remain openly accessible through working public links. These results reveal a substantial visibility gap: many large-speaker languages appear data-poor in catalogue records yet show clear evidence of dataset activity in the research literature. Our findings suggest that multilingual data scarcity should be understood not only as a production problem, but also as a question of documentation, discoverability, and long-term accessibility. Code and data are publicly available at (https://github.com/zhiyintan/dataset-visibility-asymmetry).

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了多语言NLP中数据集可见性的巨大鸿沟：许多语言在官方目录中显示为资源匮乏，但在研究文献中却有活跃的数据集使用。作者提出了资源密度指数（RDI），并通过LLM辅助的引用挖掘方法，在141种低可见性语言中识别出609个数据集，表明数据稀缺不仅是生产问题，更是文档、可发现性和长期可访问性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有目录只记录了已注册或机构分发的数据集，未反映研究文献中实际创建、引用和复用的数据集情况，导致对语言资源丰富程度的评估存在偏差。
AI.method: 1. 结合目录基线（LRE Map和LDC）与研究文献证据；2. 提出资源密度指数（RDI）= 每百万说话者对应的目录数据集数量；3. 对200种最广泛使用的语言计算RDI；4. 对141种低可见性语言使用LLM辅助的引用挖掘管道分析Semantic Scholar语料库；5. 手动验证和整合结果。
AI.result: 118种语言（59%）在目录中RDI为0，23种语言RDI低于0.1。在141种低可见性语言中识别出53种语言的609个独特数据集，其中356个通过公开链接可访问。
AI.conclusion: 多语言数据稀缺不仅是生产问题，更是文档、可发现性和长期可访问性问题；目录记录与研究文献之间存在着显著的数据集可见性差距。

title: Responsible Agentic AI Requires Explicit Provenance
summary: Agentic AI is rapidly proliferating across diverse real-world domains such as software engineering, yet public trust has not kept pace. The central reason is that responsibility, despite being widely discussed, remains a subjective and unenforced concept, as no current agentic framework produces the quantifiable, traceable, and interventionable provenance needed to assign it when harm emerges from compositions no single party designed. We position that what is missing is not better benchmark-level evaluation but $\textbf{explicit provenance}$ across the full agentic lifecycle, which is the only viable basis for making responsibility computable and actionable. We advance this agenda along four axes: establishing $\textit{why}$ such provenance is a structural necessity by identifying responsibility gaps across sociotechnical dimensions, formalizing $\textit{what}$ it must encode through a causal attribution function and responsibility tensor, discussing $\textit{how}$ it can be made computable across four lifecycle layers with preliminary experiments showing that provenance is estimable and interveneable online before irreversible harm accumulates, and examining $\textit{who}$ bears responsibility through a concrete agentic incident. Explicit provenance is not a discretionary refinement but the necessary condition for responsible agentic AI, and no stakeholder across its ecosystem can afford to treat it as optional.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，当前智能体AI缺乏可量化、可追溯、可干预的显式溯源机制，导致责任无法计算和执行。作者提出，显式溯源是负责任智能体AI的必要条件，并从为何、是什么、如何做、谁负责四个维度展开论证。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI在软件工程等领域快速普及，但公众信任度未能同步提升。核心原因是“责任”概念虽被广泛讨论，却仍主观且无法强制执行——现有框架无法在多方组合造成损害时提供可量化、可追溯、可干预的溯源信息来分配责任。
AI.method: 从四个维度推进：(1) 为何——通过识别社会技术维度的责任缺口，论证溯源的结构必要性；(2) 是什么——通过因果归因函数和责任张量形式化定义溯源应编码的内容；(3) 如何——在四个生命周期层实现可计算溯源，初步实验表明可在不可逆损害累积前在线估计和干预；(4) 谁负责——通过具体智能体事件实例分析责任归属。
AI.result: 初步实验表明，溯源信息是可在线估计和干预的，能够在不可逆损害累积之前进行干预。
AI.conclusion: 显式溯源不是可选的优化，而是负责任智能体AI的必要条件，生态系统中没有任何利益相关者可以将其视为可选项。

title: Visual Agentic Memory: Enabling Online Long Video Understanding via Online Indexing, Hierarchical Memory, and Agentic Retrieval
summary: Long video understanding requires more than large context windows. It also needs a memory mechanism that decides what visual evidence to retain, keeps it searchable over long horizons, and grounds later reasoning in recoverable observations rather than compressed latent state alone. We propose Visual Agentic Memory (VAM), a training-free framework with three components. Online Indexing supports selective evidence retention under streaming constraints. Hierarchical Memory organises retained evidence in a Parallel Representation that aligns temporal context with spatial observations.
