Agentic Retrieval searches, inspects, and verifies candidate evidence before producing a grounded answer. On OVO-Bench, VAM achieves the highest RT+BT average (68.41) across all reported baselines, improving over end-to-end use of the same underlying MLLM (Gemini 3 Flash, 67.46). On the month-scale split of MM-Lifelong train@month (105.6 hours over 51 days), VAM reaches 17.11%, second only to ReMA with GPT-5 (17.62%). These results suggest that long-horizon video understanding benefits from treating visual memory as an explicit, inspectable, and queryable substrate. Code is available at https://github.com/yiliu-li/Visual-Agentic-Memory.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的视觉智能记忆框架（VAM），通过在线索引、分层记忆和智能检索三个组件，使长视频理解不再依赖大上下文窗口，而是将视觉记忆作为可显式查询和验证的媒介，在OVO-Bench和MM-Lifelong基准上取得了领先性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解不仅需要大的上下文窗口，还需要一种记忆机制来决定保留哪些视觉证据、在长时序中保持可搜索性，并基于可恢复的观测（而非仅压缩的潜在状态）进行后续推理。
AI.method: 提出了Visual Agentic Memory (VAM)，包含三个组件：1) Online Indexing——在流式约束下选择性保留视觉证据；2) Hierarchical Memory——以并行表示组织保留的证据，对齐时间上下文与空间观测；3) Agentic Retrieval——在生成基于证据的答案前，对候选证据进行搜索、检查和验证。
AI.result: 在OVO-Bench上，VAM的RT+BT平均分达68.41，超过所有基线；在MM-Lifelong的月尺度划分（51天/105.6小时）上达到17.11%，仅次于使用GPT-5的ReMA（17.62%）。
AI.conclusion: 长时序视频理解应将视觉记忆作为显式、可检查、可查询的媒介来对待，这比仅依赖压缩潜在状态更有优势。

title: CAREBench: Evaluating LLMs' Emotion Understanding by Assessing Cognitive Appraisal Reasoning
summary: Emotion understanding is a core capability for LLMs to interact effectively with humans, yet existing evaluation paradigms rely on discrete emotion label prediction and fail to capture the cognitive processes underlying emotion generation. Grounded in appraisal theory, we introduce CAREBench, the first benchmark with complete inferential chain annotations from both first- and third-person perspectives on real-world narratives, spanning appraisal reasoning, appraisal ratings, and multi-label emotion annotation. We propose a process-level evaluation framework and conduct systematic experiments across six LLMs organized around four research questions. We find that stronger models match or surpass human observers on certain tasks, yet fall short on appraisal reasoning and positive emotion recognition; performance across chain steps and sensitivity to appraisal interventions exhibit dissociations across models; and current models have not internalized the mechanisms needed to capture human subjective heterogeneity. These findings suggest that downstream emotion prediction metrics may overestimate LLMs' true emotion understanding, and CAREBench provides a foundation for more diagnostically informative evaluation of LLMs' affective cognitive capabilities.

AI.tldr: CAREBench是基于评价理论构建的首个包含完整推理链注释（评价推理、评价评分、多标签情感标注）的情感理解基准，从第一和第三人称视角评估LLM。实验发现强模型在某些任务上匹配或超越人类，但在评价推理和积极情绪识别上仍有不足，表明下游情感预测指标可能高估了LLM的真实情感理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有情感理解评估仅依赖离散情感标签预测，未能捕捉情感生成背后的认知过程，缺乏对LLM情感认知能力的诊断性评估工具。
AI.method: 基于评价理论构建CAREBench基准，包含从第一和第三人称视角的完整推理链注释（评价推理、评价评分、多标签情感标注）；设计过程级评估框架，围绕四个研究问题对六个LLM进行系统实验。
AI.result: 强模型在某些任务上匹配或超越人类观察者；但在评价推理和积极情绪识别上表现不足；不同模型在推理链各步骤的表现和评价干预敏感性上存在分离；当前模型未能内化捕捉人类主观异质性的机制。
AI.conclusion: 下游情感预测指标可能高估LLM的真实情感理解能力；CAREBench为更具诊断性的LLM情感认知能力评估提供了基础。

title: SeamCam: Quantifying Seamless Camouflage via Multi-Cue Visual Detectability
summary: Animals are described as effectively camouflaged when they blend seamlessly with their surrounding, yet no standardized quantitative measure of this seamlessness exists. We address this gap by framing camouflage evaluation as a visual localization problem: a well-camouflaged animal is one that remains difficult to detect even when its category is known. We introduce SeamCam (Seamless Camouflage), a metric that quantifies how detectable an animal is from the available visual evidence. Given an image and a target species, SeamCam generates category-conditioned detection proposals, extracts segmentation masks, and identifies the subset whose collective union yields the highest IoU with the ground-truth mask. The SeamCam score is one minus this maximum recoverable localization signal, where a higher score indicates stronger camouflage (i.e., lower detectability). In a human two-alternative forced-choice study with 94 participants and 2,390 comparisons, SeamCam achieves 78.82% agreement with human camouflage difficulty judgments, outperforming state-of-the-art by about 25%. We then demonstrate SeamCam's utility as a preference signal for Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to fine-tune a diffusion-based inpainting model for camouflage generation. This offers an affordable training approach with an objective explicitly suited for camouflage generation, unlike typical diffusion models. To support rigorous benchmarking, we further introduce CamFG-1.5k, a curated dataset of 1,521 high-resolution images in which animals are fully visible prior to camouflage generation, enabling unbiased evaluation by controlling for occlusion artifacts present in existing datasets. https://7amin.github.io/SeamCam/

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SeamCam，一种基于视觉定位的量化动物伪装程度指标，通过检测器在已知类别条件下的定位难度来评估伪装效果，在人类实验中达到 78.82% 一致率，并可用于优化扩散模型生成更逼真的伪装图案。
AI.motivation: 现有对动物伪装效果的评估缺乏标准化的量化指标，通常仅依赖主观视觉判断。研究者希望建立一个客观、可重复的度量标准来衡量动物与背景融合的"无缝"程度。
AI.method: 将伪装评估建模为视觉定位问题：给定图像和目标物种，模型生成类别条件检测提议，提取分割掩码，找出与真实掩码最高 IoU 的集体并集，SeamCam 得分 = 1 - 最大可恢复定位信号（得分越高即伪装越好）。同时构建 CamFG-1.5k 数据集确保评估无偏。
AI.result: 在 94 名参与者、2,390 次比较的人类二选一实验中，SeamCam 与人类判断的一致率达 78.82%，比现有最优方法提升约 25%。
AI.conclusion: SeamCam 可作为偏好信号用于 Direct Preference Optimization（DPO）微调扩散修补模型生成伪装图案，提供了一种低成本且目标明确的训练方案。CamFG-1.5k 数据集为伪装生成提供了更公正的基准。

title: VerifyMAS: Hypothesis Verification for Failure Attribution in LLM Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language model-driven multi-agent systems (LLM-MAS) excel at complex tasks, yet unreliable agents remain a key bottleneck to system-level reliability. Automatic failure attribution is therefore critical, but existing approaches, such as direct prediction of agent-error pairs and agent-first failure attribution, rely on local logs of agents and miss global failures that only manifest over full interaction trajectories, such as cross-step inconsistencies and inter-agent coordination errors. Moreover, directly predicting failures induces a large combinatorial search space, hindering fine-grained attribution. To address these challenges, we propose VerifyMAS, a hypothesis verification framework for agent failure attribution. Instead of directly predicting faulty agents and error types, VerifyMAS formulates and verifies failure hypotheses against full trajectories. This verification-based approach decomposes attribution into trajectory-level error validation and fine-grained agent localization, providing an error-first attribution approach that captures global failure patterns while substantially reducing the search space. We further introduce a hypothesis-based data construction strategy grounded in a structured error taxonomy and fine-tune a specialized LLM verifier model for trajectory-level failure verification and agent attribution. Experiments on Aegis-Bench and Who&When show that VerifyMAS consistently improves diverse backbone models, including open-source Qwen and API-based GPT models, outperforming prior methods without sacrificing inference efficiency for long multi-agent trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出VerifyMAS框架，通过假设验证而非直接预测的方式进行多智能体系统故障归因，先验证轨迹级错误再定位具体智能体，有效捕捉全局故障模式并降低搜索空间。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的多智能体系统中不可靠的智能体是系统可靠性的关键瓶颈，现有方法依赖局部日志，无法捕捉仅在全轨迹中显现的全局故障（如跨步骤不一致、智能体间协调错误），且直接预测故障导致组合搜索空间过大，阻碍细粒度归因。
AI.method: 提出VerifyMAS假设验证框架：将归因分解为轨迹级错误验证和细粒度智能体定位两个阶段，采用"错误优先"的归因策略；引入基于结构化错误分类学的假设数据构建策略；微调专门的LLM验证器模型用于轨迹级故障验证和智能体归因。
AI.result: 在Aegis-Bench和Who&When基准上，VerifyMAS持续改进了包括开源Qwen和基于API的GPT模型在内的多种骨干模型，性能优于之前的方法，且不牺牲长多智能体轨迹的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: VerifyMAS通过假设验证范式有效解决了多智能体系统中的全局故障归因难题，实现了更准确、更高效的故障定位，为提升LLM-MAS系统可靠性提供了新思路。

title: ChemVA: Advancing Large Language Models on Chemical Reaction Diagrams Understanding
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized scientific text processing, they exhibit a significant capability gap when interpreting chemical reaction diagrams. We identify two fundamental bottlenecks restricting current systems: a Visual Deficit, where generic vision encoders struggle to resolve the strict topological connectivity of dense molecular graphs, and a Semantic Disconnect, where standard linear strings, such as SMILES, fail to effectively activate the model's latent chemical reasoning. To bridge these gaps, we propose the Chemical Visual Activation (ChemVA) framework, which employs a Visual Anchor mechanism to ground functional groups via hybrid-granularity detection, followed by a semantic alignment approach that translates visual features into entity names to maximize knowledge activation in LLMs. We evaluate our approach on OCRD-Bench, a newly constructed dataset featuring dense visual-semantic contexts and comprehensive reaction coverage to evaluate the full spectrum from recognition to reasoning. Extensive experiments on OCRD-Bench demonstrate that ChemVA achieves 92.0% structural recognition accuracy. By bridging visual and semantic bottlenecks, our framework delivers a consistent performance gain of approximately 20 percentage points across 9 diverse LLMs, enabling open-weight models to rival proprietary SOTA systems in complex chemical reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChemVA框架，通过视觉锚点机制和语义对齐方法，解决LLM在化学反应图理解中的视觉缺陷和语义断连问题，在OCRD-Bench数据集上实现92.0%结构识别准确率，并在9种LLM上提升约20个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在处理化学反应图示时存在两大瓶颈：通用视觉编码器难以解析密集分子图的严格拓扑连接（视觉缺陷），以及标准线性字符串（如SMILES）无法有效激活模型潜在的化学推理能力（语义断连）。
AI.method: 提出ChemVA框架，包含两个核心模块：1) Visual Anchor机制，通过混合粒度检测定位官能团；2) 语义对齐方法，将视觉特征转化为实体名称，最大化激活LLM中的化学知识。
AI.result: 在OCRD-Bench数据集上，ChemVA实现92.0%的结构识别准确率，在9种不同LLM上一致提升约20个百分点，使开源模型在复杂化学推理任务中达到与专有SOTA系统竞争的水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过弥合视觉和语义瓶颈，ChemVA显著提升了LLM对化学反应图的理解能力，为化学领域的AI应用提供了有效方案。

title: Hybrid Feature Combinations with CNN for Bangla Fake News Classification
comment: Already accepted and presented in the 3rd International Conference on Big Data, IoT and Machine Learning (BIM 2025)
summary: Nowadays, people in Bangladesh frequently rely on the internet and social media for daily news instead of traditional newspapers. However, the spread of false Bangla news through these platforms poses risks and challenges to the credibility of authentic media. Although several studies have been conducted on detecting Bangla fake news, there is still significant room for improvement in this area. To assist people, this research explores the effectiveness of feature selection approaches in identifying appropriate features, such as semantic, statistical, and character-level features, or their combinations, on the BanFakeNews-2.0 dataset for detecting Bangla fake news using a CNN model. In this paper, key findings reveal that combining multiple features significantly improves recall and F1-scores compared to using individual features alone. The code for this research can be availed here, https://github.com/gulzar09/Bn\_FNews\_H.Feature.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索在孟加拉语假新闻检测中，结合多种特征（语义、统计、字符级）比单独使用单一特征能显著提升CNN模型的召回率和F1分数。
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国人们越来越依赖互联网和社交媒体获取新闻，但虚假孟加拉语新闻的传播威胁到了真实媒体的可信度，现有研究仍有改进空间。
AI.method: 在BanFakeNews-2.0数据集上，使用CNN模型，探索不同特征选择方法（语义、统计、字符级特征及其组合）对孟加拉语假新闻检测的效果。
AI.result: 结合多种特征比单独使用单一特征能显著提高召回率和F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 多特征组合策略对于孟加拉语假新闻检测是有效的，代码已开源。

title: Towards Robust Argumentative Essay Understanding via TIDE: An Interactive Framework with Trial and Debate
summary: Argumentative essays serve as a vital medium for assessing critical thinking and reasoning skills, yet there is limited works on accurately understanding and evaluating such texts via prompt. In this work, we propose TIDE, a novel framework designed to improve criteria-based prompt optimization for argument-related tasks by integrating TrIal and DEbate mechanism. Our method addresses key limitations of criteria-based prompt optimizing by mitigating the influence of noisy training data and enhancing optimization stability. We evaluate TIDE on three core tasks: Automated Essay Scoring, Argument Component Detection, and Argument Relation Identification. Results demonstrate that our framework improves performance across tasks. These findings underscore the potential of combining prompt-based methods for advanced argument understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出TIDE框架，通过引入"试验与辩论"机制优化基于标准的提示词，提升议论文理解与评估任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 议论文是评估批判性思维和推理能力的重要媒介，但目前通过提示词准确理解和评估此类文本的工作有限，且现有基于标准的提示词优化方法存在训练数据噪声影响和优化稳定性不足的问题。
AI.method: 提出TIDE框架，采用TrIal and DEbate（试验与辩论）机制改进基于标准的提示词优化方法，减少噪声训练数据的影响并增强优化稳定性。
AI.result: 在自动作文评分、论证成分检测和论证关系识别三个核心任务上，TIDE框架均提升了性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将基于提示的方法与辩论机制相结合，在高级论证理解任务中具有潜力。

title: Residual Semantic Decomposition of Word Embeddings
comment: Short paper; includes appendix. Code and data are not included in the arXiv source package
summary: We introduce Residual Semantic Decomposition (RSD), a neural additive decomposition of word embeddings that balances embedding reconstruction with relational structure preservation. RSD supports recursive binary decomposition: each $K=2$ fit extracts a local semantic axis, while residuals expose information not absorbed by that axis. In manually specified paired-context diagnostics over ambiguous words, RSD separates supplied context anchors above shuffled-label controls, but entropy diagnostics show that ambiguous targets are not uniformly high-entropy boundary points in static GloVe. We therefore treat residual neighborhoods as qualitative diagnostics rather than benchmark sense predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出残差语义分解（RSD），一种神经加性词嵌入分解方法，在重建嵌入与保持关系结构之间取得平衡，支持递归二元分解以提取局部语义轴，并通过残差揭示未被吸收的信息。
AI.motivation: 现有的词嵌入方法在捕捉词语的多义性方面存在局限，难以有效分离和表示词语的不同语义维度。
AI.method: 提出RSD方法，采用神经加性分解方式对词嵌入进行递归二元分解，每次拟合（K=2）提取一个局部语义轴，残差保留未被该轴吸收的信息。
AI.result: 在人工指定的配对上下文诊断中，RSD能够将提供的上下文锚点与打乱标签的对照区分开；但熵诊断显示，歧义词目标在静态GloVe中并非均匀的高熵边界点。
AI.conclusion: 残差邻域更适合作为定性诊断工具，而非基准意义上的词义预测方法。

title: CatalyticMLLM: A Graph-Text Multimodal Large Language Model for Catalytic Materials
summary:
Property prediction and inverse structural design of catalytic materials are typically modeled as two independent tasks: the former predicts target properties from given structures, whereas the latter generates candidate structures according to desired properties. Although the decoupled paradigm facilitates the implementation of a ``generation--evaluation--screening'' workflow, the inconsistency between the generative model and the property prediction model in terms of representation spaces and training objectives can readily introduce data distribution shifts and evaluator bias, thereby limiting the stability of closed-loop optimization.
  In this work, we propose QE-Catalytic-V2, a unified graph--text multimodal large language model for catalytic materials, which integrates property prediction and inverse design within the same model and shared representation space. Under this unified framework, QE-Catalytic-V2 can not only perform reliable property prediction by leveraging three-dimensional structures and textual information, but also generate and screen physically feasible CIF candidates conditioned on target properties, thereby forming a closed-loop optimization workflow of ``inverse design--prediction--screening--redesign.'' Experimental results demonstrate that this unified paradigm outperforms decoupled baselines on both catalytic relaxed-energy prediction and inverse design tasks, validating the effectiveness of jointly modeling property prediction and structure generation within a single multimodal model.

AI.tldr: 提出统一图-文本多模态大模型QE-Catalytic-V2，将催化材料性质预测与逆向结构设计整合在同一模型和共享表示空间中，形成闭环优化流程，性能优于传统解耦方法。
AI.motivation: 传统催化材料性质预测与逆向设计被建模为两个独立任务，生成模型与预测模型在表示空间和训练目标上不一致，导致数据分布偏移和评估偏差，限制了闭环优化的稳定性。
AI.method: 提出QE-Catalytic-V2，一个统一图-文本多模态大语言模型，将性质预测和逆向设计整合在同一模型和共享表示空间中，利用三维结构和文本信息，实现"逆向设计-预测-筛选-重新设计"的闭环优化流程。
AI.result: 在催化弛豫能量预测和逆向设计任务上，该统一范式均优于解耦基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 在单一多模态模型中联合建模性质预测和结构生成是有效的，验证了统一范式在催化材料领域的优越性。

title: Attention-Aware Transformer-Based Aggregation Network for Video Periocular Recognition
comment: Accepted at ICIP 2026. Copyright 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses. DOI to be added upon publication
summary: Video periocular recognition is the task of recognizing an individual's identity based on the region around an individual's eyes. The periocular area is one of the most discriminative regions of the human face, making it suitable for recognition tasks. Its use as a biometric modality has emerged as an alternative, especially in surveillance scenarios where conventional biometric traits such as face or iris recognition become unfeasible due to unconstrained acquisition conditions. This paper proposes an attention-aware approach for video-based periocular recognition in surveillance environments. The framework consists of two main modules: feature embedding and aggregation. The feature embedding module is a deep convolutional neural network that maps periocular data to feature vectors. The aggregation module is an encoder-only transformer that adaptively learns to aggregate frame-level features into a single video representation and a feature vector for the still reference image. Experiments on the publicly available COX Face dataset show the robustness of the proposed method, consistently outperforming naive aggregation schemes. In the best scenario, the approach achieves $99.8\%$ of TPR@$1e^{-1}$ and $96.6\%$ of Rank-5.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于注意力机制的监控场景视频眼周识别方法，通过特征嵌入模块和聚合模块将帧级特征聚合为视频级表示，在COX Face数据集上达到了99.8%的TPR@1e-1和96.6%的Rank-5准确率。
AI.motivation: 在监控场景下，传统生物特征（如人脸或虹膜）因采集条件受限难以应用，眼周区域作为人脸最具区分度的区域之一，成为一种可行的替代方案。现有方法多采用简单的聚合策略，未能充分利用帧间信息，因此需要一种更高效的自适应聚合方法。
AI.method: 提出一个两模块框架：1）特征嵌入模块：使用深度卷积神经网络将眼周数据映射为特征向量；2）聚合模块：采用仅编码器的Transformer架构，自适应学习将帧级特征聚合为单一视频表示，同时生成静态参考图像的特征向量。
AI.result: 在公开COX Face数据集上，该方法一致优于简单聚合方案。最佳场景下，TPR@1e-1达到99.8%，Rank-5达到96.6%。
AI.conclusion: 证明了注意力机制在视频眼周识别中的有效性，为监控场景下的生物特征识别提供了一种鲁棒且高效的解决方案。

title: Mixture of Experts for Low-Resource LLMs
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures enable efficient model scaling, yet expert routing behavior across underrepresented languages remains poorly understood. We analyze routing dynamics in two architecturally distinct MoE models -- a pure Transformer (Qwen3-30B-A3B) and a hybrid Mamba-Transformer (Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B) -- using Hebrew as a morphologically rich, low-resource testbed. Both pre-trained models exhibit \emph{deep-layer routing collapse}: usage entropy drops sharply in final layers and tokens concentrate on a narrow expert subset, a pattern largely absent for English. Continual pre-training (CPT) on balanced bilingual data substantially corrects this imbalance, increasing entropy and shifting routing toward shared, language-agnostic experts; supervised fine-tuning (SFT) alone achieves less complete correction. Extending the analysis to Japanese reveals quantitatively consistent collapse signatures, providing cross-linguistic evidence that the phenomenon is a systematic consequence of pre-training underrepresentation rather than any language-intrinsic property. Routing improvements correlate with consistent downstream benchmark gains, positioning routing entropy and expert specialization as principled diagnostics for multilingual capacity in MoE systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了MoE架构中低资源语言（如希伯来语和日语）的专家路由崩溃现象，发现深层路由熵显著下降，而双语持续预训练能有效改善此问题并提升下游性能。
AI.motivation: MoE架构在低资源语言上的专家路由行为尚不明确，现有研究多聚焦高性能语言，缺乏对代表性不足语言路由动态的系统分析。
AI.method: 在两种MoE模型（纯Transformer Qwen3-30B-A3B和混合Mamba-Transformer Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B）上，以希伯来语为低资源测试语言，分析路由熵、专家专业化等指标，并进行持续预训练（CPT）和监督微调（SFT）干预实验，同时用日语验证跨语言一致性。
AI.result: 发现深层路由崩溃现象：最终层路由熵急剧下降，专家使用集中在少数子集上；CPT能显著纠正此失衡，提升路由熵并转向语言无关的共享专家；SFT效果有限。日语实验证实了跨语言的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 路由崩溃是预训练语言代表性不足的系统性后果，而非语言固有特性；路由熵和专家专业化可作为MoE系统 multilingual 能力的有效诊断指标。

title: CAM-Bench: A Benchmark for Computational and Applied Mathematics in Lean
summary: Formal theorem-proving benchmarks enable mechanically verifiable evaluation of mathematical reasoning in large language models. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on Olympiad-style problems and algebraic domains, leaving computational and applied mathematics underrepresented. We introduce CAM-Bench, a Lean 4 theorem-proving benchmark of 1,000 Lean proof targets in computational and applied mathematics, with coverage spanning optimization, numerical linear algebra, and numerical analysis. These problems are adapted from textbook exercises and often depend on locally introduced definitions, notation, algorithms, and elementary results. To construct CAM-Bench, we develop a dependency-recovery pipeline that reconstructs the local textbook context needed to state each problem faithfully. It then normalizes each problem into a standalone informal theorem and translates it into a Lean target. We validate the resulting formal problems through Lean compilation and semantic review, checking both formal correctness and semantic alignment with the original exercises. For each problem, we release the raw exercise, recovered context, normalized informal theorem, and final Lean target. CAM-Bench complements existing formal mathematics benchmarks by targeting applied mathematics problems that rely on textbook concepts and elementary theorems, many of which are not directly available as standard Mathlib4 lemmas. We evaluate widely used large language models and formalization agents on CAM-Bench, and analyze common failure modes in tracking local assumptions, applying elementary results, decomposing proofs, and maintaining long-horizon control in Lean.

AI.tldr: CAM-Bench 是一个包含1,000个Lean 4定理证明目标的计算与应用数学基准，覆盖优化、数值线性代数和数值分析等领域，旨在填补现有基准对应用数学覆盖不足的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有定理证明基准主要关注奥赛级问题和代数领域，计算数学与应用数学领域代表性不足，因此需要构建一个覆盖这些领域的基准。
AI.method: 开发了依赖恢复管道，重构教科书上下文，将每个问题标准化为独立非正式定理并翻译为Lean 4目标，通过Lean编译和语义审查验证形式化正确性和语义对齐。
AI.result: 构建了1,000个Lean证明目标的基准，并评估了多种大语言模型和形式化代理，分析了常见失败模式。
AI.conclusion: CAM-Bench补充了现有形式化数学基准，聚焦依赖教科书概念和初等定理的应用数学问题，揭示了现有模型在局部假设追踪、初等结果应用、证明分解和长程控制方面的不足。

title: Temporal Decay of Co-Citation Predictability: A 20-Year Statute Retrieval Benchmark from 396M Ukrainian Court Citations
summary: Co-citation structure is widely assumed to provide stable retrieval signal in legal information systems. We test this assumption longitudinally by constructing UA-StatuteRetrieval, a benchmark that measures co-citation predictability across 20 annual snapshots (2007-2026) of 396 million codex citations from 101 million Ukrainian court decisions. Using a leave-one-out protocol over the full bipartite citation graph, we find that Adamic-Adar MRR declines 33% on a fixed set of articles (from 0.43 to 0.29) and 47% under a train/test temporal split (from 0.51 to 0.27) confirming genuine temporal decay rather than compositional shift or evaluation artifact. The decay is non-uniform: criminal procedure maintains stable co-citation patterns (MRR ~0.40), while civil law degrades from 0.35 to 0.15, coinciding with the 2017 judicial reform. Hub articles (>100K citations) resist decay, but mid-frequency articles (1K-10K) -- the practical retrieval frontier lose half their predictability. A BM25 text baseline decays even faster (31%), and embedding drift analysis with E5-large reveals a 4.3% semantic shift in how articles are cited, providing a mechanistic explanation for the observed decay. The benchmark is released at https://huggingface.co/datasets/overthelex/ua-statute-retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建包含20年（2007-2026）乌克兰法律引文数据集的基准测试，发现法律信息系统中的共引结构并非稳定预测信号，其性能随时间显著衰减（Adamic-Adar MRR下降33%-47%），且不同法律领域衰减程度不一。
AI.motivation: 验证法律信息系统中普遍假设的"共引结构提供稳定检索信号"这一观点是否成立。
AI.method: 构建UA-StatuteRetrieval基准数据集，包含1.01亿份乌克兰法院判决中的3.96亿条法典引用（20年年度快照）。采用留一法协议分析完整二分引文图，并引入时间训练/测试分割，同时对比BM25文本基线和E5-large嵌入漂移分析。
AI.result: Adamic-Adar MRR在固定文章集上下降33%（0.43→0.29），在时间分割下下降47%（0.51→0.27）。刑事程序保持稳定（MRR~0.40），民事法从0.35降至0.15。枢纽文章（>10万引用）抗衰减，中频文章（1K-10K）预测性减半。BM25衰减31%，E5-large显示4.3%语义漂移。
AI.conclusion: 共引结构存在显著的时间衰减，且衰减模式非均匀分布，与司法改革等制度变迁相关。语义漂移是衰减的机制性解释。研究对法律信息检索系统的长期可靠性提出质疑。

title: Is VLA Reasoning Faithful? Probing Safety of Chain-of-Causation
comment: Accept (Poster), CVPR 2026 Workshop DriveX NonArchival Track
summary: We present the first systematic study of faithfulness in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) driving models, analyzing 300 Alpamayo-R1-10B inferences across 100 diverse PhysicalAI-AV scenarios. Our main finding is that output natural-language rationales with trajectories may be significantly unfaithful: (i) overall reasoning fidelity is only 42.5%, with Chain-of-Causation matching scene reality less than half the time; (ii) 94 missed pedestrians in one-third of pedestrian-relevant scenes; (iii) 97.7% trajectory fragility under mild visual perturbations; and (iv) only 48.3% mean reasoning-action consistency, with 53.3% of inferences exhibiting low consistency, including 37.9% of stop-claimed cases where the model continues instead. We formalize faithfulness information-theoretically, define entity and action fidelity with verification criteria, and outline a four-component safety architecture aligned with these results.

AI.tldr: 首次系统研究VLA驾驶模型的 faithfulness，发现推理忠实度仅42.5%，存在大量漏检行人、轨迹脆弱性和推理-行动不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 当前VLA驾驶模型虽然能输出自然语言推理过程，但其忠实性（推理是否真实匹配场景）尚未被系统研究，存在安全风险。
AI.method: 分析300个Alpamayo-R1-10B模型推理结果，覆盖100个PhysicalAI-AV驾驶场景；从信息论角度形式化定义忠实度，设计实体忠实度和动作忠实度验证标准。
AI.result: 推理忠实度仅42.5%；1/3行人场景漏检94次；97.7%的轨迹在轻微视觉扰动下脆弱；推理-行动一致性仅48.3%，37.9%的声称停止案例实际仍继续行驶。
AI.conclusion: VLA驾驶模型的推理过程存在显著不忠实问题，需构建包含四个组件的安全架构以应对这些缺陷。

title: Attend Locally, Remember Linearly: Linear Attention as Cross-Frame Memory for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion is a powerful paradigm for streaming and interactive video generation. However, its reliance on softmax self-attention leads to quadratic compute complexity in sequence length and memory usage due to key-value caching, which limits its scalability to long video horizons. Existing remedies (e.g., sparse attention and KV-cache compression) reduce per-step cost but still rely on a linearly growing cache or irreversibly discard past context, and thus fail to address linear memory growth and streaming context management. To address this scalability bottleneck, we propose ARL2 (Attend Locally, Remember Linearly), a hybrid attention module that replaces quadratic cross-frame attention with a fixed-size recurrent state. We decompose self-attention into two branches: an intra-frame softmax branch for spatial detail and local dependencies, and an inter-frame gated recurrent linear branch that maintains a fixed-size state for streaming context. Our key insight is that softmax attention captures fine-grained local interactions, while a recurrent state provides controllable long-range memory. This design achieves linear-time scaling with constant memory while improving temporal consistency over the full-softmax model. To prevent noisy intermediate states from corrupting memory, we update the recurrent state only after the denoised pass. To avoid within-frame information asymmetry, all tokens share the same pre-update state rather than sequential updates. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to convert a pretrained AR video diffusion model into a hybrid linear attention architecture, through an efficient two-stage training scheme for AR video. With 75% of layers replaced by hybrid linear attention, the model achieves up to 2.26 wall-clock speedup and 54% memory reduction, while maintaining comparable quality with improving temporal consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出ARL2混合注意力模块，将二次复杂度的交叉帧自注意力替换为固定大小的循环状态，实现线性时间缩放和恒定内存，在AR视频扩散模型中取得2.26倍加速和54%内存减少。
AI.motivation: AR视频扩散模型依赖softmax自注意力导致计算和内存随序列长度二次增长（O(n²)），现有方法（稀疏注意力、KV缓存压缩）虽降低单步成本但仍存在线性内存增长和流式上下文管理问题，无法真正解决可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出ARL2混合注意力模块：将自注意力分解为帧内softmax分支（捕捉空间细节和局部依赖）和帧间门控循环线性分支（维持固定大小的循环状态管理流式上下文）。仅在去噪完成后的干净传递阶段更新循环状态，并让所有令牌共享同一预更新状态避免信息不对称。采用两阶段训练方案将预训练AR视频扩散模型转换为混合线性注意力架构。
AI.result: 替换75%层为混合线性注意力后，实现2.26倍墙钟加速和54%内存减少，同时保持可比质量并提升时间一致性。
AI.conclusion: 首次将预训练AR视频扩散模型转换为混合线性注意力架构，通过固定大小循环状态有效解决长视频生成的内存和计算可扩展性问题。

title: A2RBench: An Automatic Paradigm for Formally Verifiable Abstract Reasoning Benchmark Generation
summary: Abstract reasoning ability reflects the intelligence and generalization capacity of LLMs to extract and apply abstract rules. However, accurately measuring this ability remains challenging: existing benchmarks either rely on expensive manual annotation, limiting their scale, or risk measuring memorization rather than genuine reasoning. To address this, we introduce an automated pipeline named A2RBench, encompassing generation, expansion, evaluation, and analysis. Specifically, in the generation stage, LLMs create diverse tasks demanding genuine reasoning; in the expansion stage, LLMs reuse validated rules and expand new input spaces to generate task variations, achieving scaling. However, such a process may cause hallucinations. To eliminate it, we further establish a theoretical framework and prove that programmatic verification--testing whether the inverse operation perfectly reverses the forward operation (cycle consistency)--guarantees a unique solution. Through extensive evaluations on mainstream LLMs, we find: (1) Current LLMs exhibit fundamental deficiencies in abstract reasoning, with top models significantly underperforming humans on a representative subset (39.8% vs. 68.5%). (2) Current LLMs fall far short of 2D and 1D in the complexity of generated 3D tasks, revealing their lack of understanding of high-dimensional tasks. (3) Counterintuitively, inputs with higher information complexity can simplify the reasoning process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A2RBench自动化流程，通过循环一致性验证保证抽象推理任务的有效性，实验发现当前LLMs在抽象推理上显著弱于人类（39.8% vs 68.5%），且对高维任务理解不足。
AI.motivation: 现有抽象推理基准要么依赖昂贵的人工标注导致规模受限，要么容易测量记忆而非真正的推理能力，亟需一种自动化、可扩展且能衡量真实推理能力的评测方法。
AI.method: 提出A2RBench自动化流程：1）生成阶段：LLM自动创建多样化推理任务；2）扩展阶段：复用已验证规则并扩展新输入空间生成变体；3）通过理论框架证明程序化验证（循环一致性，即逆操作完美逆转正向操作）可保证解的唯一性，消除幻觉。
AI.result: 1）顶级LLM在代表性子集上仅达39.8%，远低于人类的68.5%；2）LLM在生成3D任务复杂度上远不及2D和1D，表明缺乏高维任务理解；3）信息复杂度更高的输入反而能简化推理过程。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLMs在抽象推理能力上存在根本性缺陷，A2RBench为自动化、可扩展且可靠的抽象推理评测提供了有效框架。

title: ArtMesh: Part-Aware Articulated Mesh Fields with Motion-Consistent Dynamics
summary: We present ArtMesh, a mesh-native method for reconstructing articulated objects explicitly as connected triangle meshes with per-part rigid motion from multi-view images in start and end states. Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting pipelines for articulated reconstruction inherit the unstructured point-based geometry of their splatting base, which provides no surface topology for reasoning about part boundaries or enforcing motion consistency along the object's connectivity. ArtMesh instead builds on a mesh-based differentiable rendering backbone, enabling part-aware dynamics to act directly on the structured topology. To make the topology compatible with articulation, we introduce part-aware restricted Delaunay remeshing, producing connected submeshes whose triangles do not cross semantic part boundaries. The dynamic mesh field then optimizes articulation using bidirectional Vertex-wise Motion Consistency on transported mesh vertices and Pixel-wise Motion Consistency on rendered RGB-D observations. We introduce Articulate-100, a new benchmark of 100 articulated objects spanning 16 PartNet-Mobility categories. On this benchmark, ArtMesh outperforms prior 3DGS-based pipelines in joint parameter estimation and part-level geometric reconstruction, with the largest gains on objects with many movable parts.

AI.tldr: ArtMesh是一种基于网格的显式铰接物体重建方法，通过带部分感知受限Delaunay重网格和双向运动一致性优化，在多视图图像中重建出具有每个部件刚性运动的连接三角网格，在铰接参数估计和部件级几何重建上优于现有3DGS方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3D高斯泼溅的铰接重建方法继承了无结构点云几何，缺乏表面拓扑来推理部件边界或沿物体连接性强制执行运动一致性，无法有效处理铰接物体的结构约束。
AI.method: 1) 基于网格的可微渲染骨干；2) 部分感知受限Delaunay重网格，生成不跨语义部件边界的连接子网格；3) 动态网格场，通过双向顶点级运动一致性和像素级运动一致性优化铰接参数。
AI.result: 在Articulate-100基准（100个铰接物体，16个PartNet-Mobility类别）上，ArtMesh在关节参数估计和部件级几何重建上优于现有3DGS方法，在具有多个可动部件的物体上提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 基于网格的显式表示结合部件感知的拓扑约束和运动一致性损失，是解决铰接物体重建问题的有效途径，显著优于基于点云的方法。

title: Stop When Reasoning Converges: Semantic-Preserving Early Exit for Reasoning Models
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance by generating long chains of thought (CoT), but often overthink, continuing to reason after a solution has already stabilized and thereby wasting tokens and increasing latency. Existing inference-time early-exit methods rely primarily on answer-level signals, such as confidence or trial-answer consistency, to decide when to stop. However, these signals mainly reflect answer readiness rather than reasoning convergence: they may trigger before the model has finished exploring or self-correcting, causing premature exits that can degrade final-answer accuracy and leave the retained reasoning chain semantically incomplete. We identify reasoning-level semantic redundancy as a complementary signal for semantic-preserving early exit: when successive steps no longer add novel progress and instead revisit established conclusions, the reasoning trajectory has likely converged. Building on this insight, we propose PUMA, a plug-and-play framework that combines a lightweight Redundancy Detector with answer-level verification. The detector flags semantically redundant candidate exits, while verification confirms whether stopping is safe, allowing PUMA to remove redundant continuation while preserving both answer accuracy and a coherent reasoning prefix. Across five LRMs and five challenging reasoning benchmarks, PUMA achieves 26.2% average token reduction while preserving accuracy and retained CoT quality. Additional experiments on code generation, zero-shot vision-language reasoning, and learned stopping-policy internalization further demonstrate that reasoning-level redundancy is a robust, transferable, and learnable signal for efficient reasoning. Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/giovanni-vaccarino/PUMA}.

AI.tldr: PUMA是一个轻量级框架，通过检测推理过程中的语义冗余并结合答案验证，实现早停策略，在不损失准确率和推理链完整性的前提下，平均减少26.2%的token消耗。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在生成长思维链时存在“过度思考”问题，即答案已稳定后仍继续推理，浪费token并增加延迟。现有早停方法依赖答案级信号（如置信度），但这类信号反映的是答案就绪程度而非推理收敛性，可能导致过早退出、降低准确率并保留语义不完整的推理链。
AI.method: 提出PUMA框架，包含两个核心组件：1) 轻量级冗余检测器（Redundancy Detector），用于识别语义冗余的候选退出点；2) 答案级验证机制，确认停止是否安全。两者结合实现语义保留的早停。
AI.result: 在5个LRM和5个推理基准上，PUMA平均减少26.2%的token消耗，同时保持准确率和保留的思维链质量。在代码生成、零样本视觉-语言推理以及学习停止策略内化等任务上，验证了推理级冗余作为高效推理信号的鲁棒性、可迁移性和可学习性。
AI.conclusion: 推理级语义冗余是一种有效的补充信号，可用于实现语义保留的早停策略，在减少计算开销的同时保持模型性能。

title: MetaCogAgent: A Metacognitive Multi-Agent LLM Framework with Self-Aware Task Delegation
summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems have shown promise for solving complex tasks through agent collaboration. However, existing frameworks assign tasks based on predefined roles without considering whether an agent can accurately assess its own competence boundaries, leading to overconfident execution on tasks beyond its expertise. Inspired by metacognition theory from cognitive science, we propose MetaCogAgent, a multi-agent LLM framework where each agent is equipped with a Metacognitive Self-Assessment Unit that evaluates task-capability alignment before execution. The framework introduces three contributions: (1) a self-assessment mechanism that estimates per-task confidence by combining verbalized uncertainty with historical capability profiles; (2) an adaptive delegation protocol that routes low-confidence tasks to better-suited agents through cross-agent evaluation; and (3) a capability boundary learning module that iteratively refines each agent's competence model via cybernetic feedback. Experiments on our constructed MetaCog-Eval benchmark (700 tasks across 5 cognitive dimensions) demonstrate that MetaCogAgent achieves 82.4% task accuracy -- 8.7% above the best routing baseline -- while using 5% fewer API calls than AutoGen and 34% fewer than ensemble voting. Ablation studies confirm that each metacognitive component contributes to overall system performance.

AI.tldr: MetaCogAgent是一个基于元认知理论的多智能体LLM框架，每个智能体配备自我评估单元，通过置信度估计、自适应委派和能力边界学习三个模块，在700个任务上达到82.4%准确率，比最优基线高8.7%，同时API调用更少。
AI.motivation: 现有框架根据预定义角色分配任务，未考虑智能体是否能准确评估自身能力边界，导致智能体在超出专业范围的任务上过度自信执行。
AI.method: (1) 自评估机制：结合言语化不确定性和历史能力档案评估任务置信度；(2) 自适应委派协议：低置信度任务通过跨智能体评估路由到更合适的智能体；(3) 能力边界学习模块：通过控制论反馈迭代精炼每个智能体的能力模型。
AI.result: 在MetaCog-Eval基准上（700个任务，5个认知维度），MetaCogAgent达到82.4%任务准确率，比最优路由基线高8.7%；API调用比AutoGen少5%，比集成投票少34%。
AI.conclusion: 元认知组件（自评估、自适应委派、能力边界学习）各自对系统整体性能有贡献，验证了将元认知理论引入多智能体系统的有效性。

title: Controlla: Learning Controllability via Graph-Constrained Latent Geometry
summary: Controllable multimodal generation is commonly formulated as an inference-time conditioning problem using prompts, guidance, or auxiliary modules. While effective, such approaches do not explicitly structure how semantic attributes evolve, which can lead to identity drift and inconsistent cross-modal behavior. We propose Controlla, a modular factorized-control framework that treats controllability as a property of structured latent geometry. Controlla learns identity and attribute factors from multimodal inputs and aligns them with graph priors using graph-constrained optimal transport, encouraging attributes to follow graph-consistent trajectories while preserving reference identity. To evaluate this setting, we construct AffectHuman-43K, a leakage-aware multimodal benchmark for reference-grounded affective control, and introduce geometry-aware metrics for trajectory consistency and latent disentanglement. Experiments show consistent improvements in controllability, identity preservation, and cross-modal alignment, with additional analyses on graph sensitivity, extensibility, and robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出Controlla框架，通过图约束最优传输实现结构化潜在几何控制的多模态生成，解决身份漂移和跨模态不一致问题，并在新基准AffectHuman-43K上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有可控多模态生成方法依赖推理时条件控制（如提示、引导或辅助模块），未能显式结构化语义属性的演化路径，导致身份漂移和跨模态行为不一致。
AI.method: 提出Controlla模块化因子化控制框架：1）从多模态输入中学习身份因子和属性因子；2）利用图约束最优传输将其与图先验对齐，使属性沿图一致轨迹演化，同时保留参考身份。
AI.result: 在可控性、身份保持和跨模态对齐方面取得一致改进，并构建了AffectHuman-43K泄露感知基准和几何感知评估指标。
AI.conclusion: 图约束最优传输有效实现了结构化潜在几何控制，额外分析验证了图敏感性、可扩展性和鲁棒性。

title: Validate Your Authority: Benchmarking LLMs on Multi-Label Precedent Treatment Classification
comment: Accepted for publication at the Natural Legal Language Processing Workshop (NLLP) 2025, co-located with EMNLP
summary: Automating the classification of negative treatment in legal precedent is a critical yet nuanced NLP task where misclassification carries significant risk. To address the shortcomings of standard accuracy, this paper introduces a more robust evaluation framework. We benchmark modern Large Language Models on a new, expert-annotated dataset of 239 real-world legal citations and propose a novel Average Severity Error metric to better measure the practical impact of classification errors. Our experiments reveal a performance split. Google's Gemini 2.5 Flash achieved the highest accuracy on a high-level classification task (79.1%), while OpenAI's GPT-5-mini was the top performer on the more complex fine-grained schema (67.7%). This work establishes a crucial baseline, provides a new context-rich dataset, and introduces an evaluation metric tailored to the demands of this complex legal reasoning task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于法律先例中负面处理分类的鲁棒评估框架，包含专家标注的239个法律引用数据集和新颖的平均严重性误差指标。实验表明Gemini 2.5 Flash在高层次分类任务上最优（79.1%），GPT-5-mini在细粒度分类上领先（67.7%）。
AI.motivation: 法律先例中负面处理的自动分类是高风险NLP任务，标准准确率指标存在缺陷，难以衡量分类错误的实际影响。
AI.method: 1) 构建包含239个真实法律引用、经专家标注的新数据集；2) 提出平均严重性误差(Average Severity Error)指标；3) 对多个现代大语言模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: Gemini 2.5 Flash在高层次分类任务上准确率79.1%；GPT-5-mini在细粒度分类任务上准确率67.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了关键基线，提供了富含上下文的新数据集，并引入了专为复杂法律推理任务设计的评估指标。

title: CyberCorrect: A Cybernetic Framework for Closed-Loop Self-Correction in Large Language Models
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, submitted to IEEE SMC 2026
summary: Large language model (LLM) self-correction -- the ability to detect and fix errors in generated outputs -- remains largely ad hoc, relying on generic prompts such as "please reconsider your answer" without systematic error analysis or convergence guarantees. We propose CyberCorrect, a framework that formalizes LLM self-correction as a closed-loop control system grounded in cybernetic theory. The framework models the LLM generator as the plant and introduces a tri-modal Error Detector (combining self-consistency, verbalized confidence, and logic-chain verification) as the sensor. A type-directed Correction Controller generates targeted repair instructions based on diagnosed error categories, while a Convergence Judge determines iteration termination using stability criteria adapted from control theory. We further introduce three control-theoretic evaluation metrics -- convergence rate, overshoot rate, and oscillation rate -- that capture correction dynamics beyond final accuracy. Experiments on our constructed CyberCorrect-Bench (440 reasoning tasks with annotated error types and correction paths) show that CyberCorrect achieves 79.8% final accuracy, improving upon the best existing self-correction method by 6.2 percentage points, while reducing overshoot (erroneous over-correction) by 41% through its convergence control mechanism.

AI.tldr: 提出CyberCorrect框架，将LLM自我纠错形式化为闭环控制系统，引入三模态错误检测器、类型导向修正控制器和收敛判断器，在440个推理任务上达到79.8%准确率，比现有方法提升6.2个百分点，同时减少41%的过度修正。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM自我纠错方法缺乏系统性的错误分析和收敛保证，依赖通用提示词如"请重新考虑你的答案"，效果不稳定且无法保证纠错过程收敛。
AI.method: 基于控制论构建闭环纠错系统：生成器作为被控对象，三模态错误检测器（自一致性、口头化置信度、逻辑链验证）作为传感器，类型导向修正控制器生成针对性修复指令，收敛判断器基于控制理论稳定性准则决定迭代终止。引入收敛率、过冲率、振荡率三个控制论评价指标。
AI.result: 在440个推理任务上达到79.8%准确率，比最优现有自纠错方法提升6.2个百分点，过冲率（错误过度修正）降低41%。
AI.conclusion: 将控制论引入LLM自我纠错是有效的，系统化的错误检测和收敛控制机制能显著提升纠错效果并减少过度修正问题。

title: Do LLM Agents Mirror Socio-Cognitive Effects in Power-Asymmetric Conversations?
summary: Power differences shape human communication through well documented socio cognitive effects, including language coordination, pronoun usage, authority bias, and harmful compliance. We examine whether large language models (LLMs) exhibit similar behaviors when assigned high or low status personas. Using personas from diverse professions, we simulate multi turn, power asymmetric dialogues (e.g., principal teacher, justice lawyer) and measure (i) linguistic coordination, (ii) pronoun usage, (iii) persuasion success, and (iv) compliance with unsafe requests. Our results show that LLMs show key socio cognitive effects of power, albeit with nuances and variability, linking simulated interactions to both desirable and unsafe behaviors.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨大语言模型在模拟权力不对称对话时，是否表现出与人类相似的权力相关社会认知效应（如语言协调、代词使用、说服成功率和遵从危险请求），结果显示LLM确实展现出这些效应，但存在细微差异和变异性。
AI.motivation: 权力差异通过社会认知效应影响人类沟通，研究者想检验大语言模型在赋予高低权力身份时，是否也会表现出类似的人类社会认知模式。
AI.method: 使用不同职业身份角色，模拟多轮权力不对称对话（如校长-教师、法官-律师），测量四个维度：语言协调、代词使用、说服成功率、对不安全请求的服从。
AI.result: LLM展现出与人类相似的权力相关社会认知效应，但存在细微差别和变异性，模拟互动既产生了理想行为也产生了不安全行为。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在权力不对称情境中会表现出类似人类的社会认知模式，这既可能带来有益互动，也可能导致危险服从行为，需要引起关注。

title: AtlasVid: Efficient Ultra-High-Resolution Long Video Generation via Decoupled Global-Local Modeling
summary: Recent diffusion-based video generators have achieved remarkable visual fidelity and prompt controllability, yet scaling them to ultra-high-resolution (UHR) long videos remains prohibitively expensive. The difficulty is especially pronounced for long single-shot generation where a continuous scene must preserve global temporal coherence, and fine-grained spatial details without relying on clip transitions or autoregressive shot stitching. In this work, we revisit this challenge from the perspective of decoupled modeling. We argue that existing video diffusion models already encode strong local visual priors, while the main bottleneck lies in efficiently extending global spatiotemporal modeling as resolution and duration increase. Based on this insight, we propose AtlaVid, a decoupled global-local framework for efficient UHR long video generation. AtlaVid first generates a low-resolution and low-FPS global semantic proxy via temporally scaled RoPE, thereby extending the temporal horizon without increasing the training token count. Guided by this proxy, a high-resolution detail branch performs joint denoising with hierarchical locality-preserving attention. Reordered spatiotemporal windows preserve geometric locality and asymmetric global-local attention injects aligned semantic guidance and preserves the model's pretrained ability. This design enables resolution-agnostic training: the model is trained only at 720P with lightweight LoRA adaptation, yet generalizes directly to 4K and beyond for longer (>10s) video synthesis. Experiments show that AtlaVid substantially improves the efficiency of ultra-high-resolution long video generation, achieving high-quality UHR long video generation with 60.9x speed up and significantly less training cost and even better performance than native 4K video generators.

AI.tldr: AtlaVid提出了一种解耦的全局-局部框架，通过先生成低分辨率全局语义代理，再在引导下进行高分辨率细节去噪，实现高效的超高清长视频生成，在仅用720P训练的情况下泛化到4K以上，速度提升60.9倍。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散视频生成器在超高清长视频生成上计算成本过高，尤其是需要保持全局时间一致性和精细空间细节的连续单镜头生成任务，主要瓶颈在于高效扩展全局时空建模能力。
AI.method: 采用解耦的全局-局部框架：1) 使用时间尺度缩放的RoPE生成低分辨率、低帧率的全局语义代理；2) 基于该代理，高分辨率细节分支通过层级局部保持注意力进行联合去噪；3) 重排时空窗口保持几何局部性，非对称全局-局部注意力注入对齐的语义引导。
AI.result: 在仅720P分辨率下使用轻量级LoRA微调训练，可直接泛化到4K及以上分辨率、10秒以上视频生成，实现60.9倍速度提升，训练成本显著降低，性能优于原生4K视频生成器。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦全局语义建模与局部细节生成，突破了视频扩散模型在超高清长视频场景下的效率和泛化瓶颈，证明了分辨率无关训练的有效性。

title: Right Predictions, Misleading Explanations: On the Vulnerability of Vision-Language Model Explanations
summary: Explanation mechanisms are increasingly used to support transparency and trust in vision-language models (VLMs), particularly in settings where model decisions require human oversight. However, the robustness of these explanations remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we investigate whether explanation heatmaps in VLMs, particularly CLIP-based models, faithfully reflect model reasoning under adversarial conditions. We show that explanation maps can be systematically manipulated while preserving the model's original prediction, revealing a disconnect between predictive behavior and explanation faithfulness. To study this vulnerability, we introduce X-Shift, a novel grey-box attack that perturbs patch-level visual representations to redirect explanation heatmaps toward semantically irrelevant regions without altering the predicted output. Unlike conventional adversarial attacks that aim to induce misclassification, X-Shift specifically targets the integrity of the explanation process itself. The attack operates without modifying model parameters and generalizes across multiple CLIP architectures and explanation methods. We evaluate the proposed approach on ImageNet-1k, MS-COCO, and Flickr30K, demonstrating consistent degradation in explanation alignment under imperceptible perturbations while maintaining prediction stability. Furthermore, standard prediction-oriented adversarial attacks fail to reproduce the same explanation-shifting behavior even under substantially larger perturbation budgets. Our findings highlight a fundamental limitation of current explanation mechanisms in VLMs and raise concerns about their use as reliable indicators of model trustworthiness in high-impact applications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了视觉-语言模型中解释热力图的可信度问题，提出了一种名为X-Shift的灰盒攻击方法，能在不改变模型预测结果的情况下，将解释热力图引导至语义无关区域，揭示了当前解释机制的根本局限性。
AI.motivation: 解释机制被广泛用于提升视觉-语言模型（尤其是CLIP模型）的透明度和可信度，但这些解释的鲁棒性尚未得到充分研究。现有工作未能系统性地探究解释热力图在对抗条件下是否真实反映模型推理过程。
AI.method: 提出X-Shift灰盒攻击方法，通过扰动patch级视觉表征，在不修改模型参数且不改变预测结果的前提下，将解释热力图重定向至语义无关区域。该方法可泛化至多种CLIP架构和解释方法。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1k、MS-COCO和Flickr30K数据集上，X-Shift在保持预测稳定性的同时，持续降低解释热力图的对齐性。传统面向预测的对抗攻击即使使用更大扰动预算也无法复现同样的解释偏移行为。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉-语言模型中的解释机制存在根本性局限，其作为模型可信度可靠指标的应用值得警惕，特别是在高风险场景中。

title: From Documents to Segments: A Contextual Reformulation for Topic Assignment
summary: Traditional topic modeling assigns a single topic to each document. In practice, however, many real-world documents, such as product reviews or open-ended survey responses, contain multiple distinct topics. This mismatch often leads to topic contamination, where unrelated themes are merged into a single topic, making it difficult to identify documents that truly focus on a specific subject. We address this issue by introducing segment-based topic allocation (SBTA), a reformulation of topic modeling that assigns topics not to entire documents, but to segments: short, coherent spans of text that each express a single theme. By modeling topical structure at the segment level, our approach yields cleaner and more interpretable topics and better supports analysis of multi-theme documents. To support systematic evaluation, we construct a SemEval-STM, a new dataset inspired by aspect-based sentiment analysis. Documents are first decomposed into topical segments using large language models (LLMs), followed by human refinement to ensure segment quality. We also propose a segment-level extension of the word intrusion task, enabling human evaluation of topical coherence at the granularity where topics are actually assigned. Across multiple models and evaluation metrics, we show that SBTA improves clustering quality and interpretability. Overall, this work provides a practical, scalable framework for fine-grained topic analysis in heterogeneous text corpora where documents naturally span multiple topics. URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/LG-AI-Research/SemEval-STM

AI.tldr: 本文提出SBTA方法，将主题建模从文档级别改为段落级别，以解决多主题文档中的主题污染问题，并通过新数据集和评估方法证明了该方法在聚类质量和可解释性上的提升。
AI.motivation: 传统主题建模为每个文档分配单一主题，但真实文档（如产品评论、开放式调查）往往包含多个不同主题，导致主题污染——不相关的主题被合并到一个主题中，难以识别真正关注特定主题的文档。
AI.method: 提出基于段落的主题分配（SBTA），将主题分配给短而连贯的文本段落而非整个文档；利用大语言模型（LLM）将文档分解为主题段落，再经人工精修；构建SemEval-STM数据集；提出段落级别的词入侵任务用于人工评估。
AI.result: 在多个模型和评估指标上，SBTA相比传统方法在聚类质量和可解释性上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: SBTA为异构文本语料库中多主题文档的细粒度主题分析提供了一个实用且可扩展的框架。

title: Multi-Object Tracking Consistently Improves Wildlife Inference
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE 2026 29th International Conference on Information Fusion
summary: Camera traps have become a common tool for wildlife monitoring efforts in ecological research and biodiversity conservation. Wildlife classification models have benefited from the increase in wildlife visual data. These models reach high levels of accuracy on curated, high-quality datasets. However, their performance remains sensitive to real-world environmental constraints. They often produce inconsistent predictions when performing inference on temporally coherent sequences. The predicted label for a single individual shifts rapidly between frames. This study exploits the temporal nature of camera-trap data to augment inferred predictions from a wildlife classification model. Specifically, we adopt several standard Multi-Object Tracking (MOT) models to link detections across consecutive frames. The curated trajectories are used to fuse the softmax class probabilities. The fused probability score produces a single consensus class label estimate that overrides misclassifications caused by noise. The analysis of the experimental results shows that our proposed strategy improves over a standalone classifier over all datasets and for each metric. Specifically, the best-performing MOT models gain a weighted F1-Score of 5.1%, 3.1% and 2.0% over the classifier across three MOT datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用多目标跟踪（MOT）模型融合时序信息，提升相机陷阱中野生动物分类模型的鲁棒性，实验表明在三个数据集上加权F1分数分别提升5.1%、3.1%和2.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有野生动物分类模型在高品质数据集上表现良好，但在真实环境下的时序连续帧中预测不稳定，标签频繁跳变，需要利用时序信息来增强分类一致性。
AI.method: 采用标准多目标跟踪（MOT）模型对连续帧中的检测进行关联，构建轨迹；然后融合各帧的softmax类别概率，通过一致性标签估计覆盖单帧噪声导致的误分类。
AI.result: 在所有数据集和指标上，所提策略均优于单独的分类器；最佳MOT模型在三个数据集上加权F1分数分别提升5.1%、3.1%和2.0%。
AI.conclusion: 利用MOT进行时序概率融合可以有效提升野生动物分类模型在真实场景下的预测稳定性和准确性。

title: ADR: An Agentic Detection System for Enterprise Agentic AI Security
summary: We present the Agentic AI Detection and Response (ADR) system, the first large-scale, production-proven enterprise framework for securing AI agents operating through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). We identify three persistent challenges in this domain: (1) limited observability -- existing Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools see file writes but not the agent reasoning, prompts, or causal chains linking intent to execution; (2) insufficient robustness -- static defenses constrained by pre-defined rules fail to generalize across diverse attack techniques and enterprise contexts; and (3) high detection costs -- LLM-based inference is prohibitively expensive at scale. ADR addresses these challenges via three components: the ADR Sensor for high-fidelity agentic telemetry, the ADR Explorer for systematic pre-deployment red teaming and hard-example generation, and the ADR Detector for scalable, two-tier online detection combining fast triage with context-aware reasoning. Deployed at Uber for over ten months, ADR has sustained reliable detection in production with growing adoption reaching over 7,200 unique hosts and processing over 10,000 agent sessions daily, uncovering hundreds of credential exposures across 26 categories and enabling a shift-left prevention layer (97.2% precision, 206 detected credentials). To validate the approach and enable community adoption, we introduce ADR-Bench (302 tasks, 17 techniques, 133 MCP servers), where ADR achieves zero false positives while detecting 67% of attacks -- outperforming three state-of-the-art baselines (ALRPHFS, GuardAgent, LlamaFirewall) by 2--4x in F1-score. On AgentDojo (public prompt injection benchmark), ADR detects all attacks with only three false alarms out of 93 tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了面向AI Agent的检测与响应系统ADR，已在Uber部署超10个月，覆盖7200+主机，日均处理超10000个Agent会话，在三个基准测试中显著优于现有方案。
AI.motivation: 现有EDR工具无法观测Agent的推理过程和意图链条，静态防御规则泛化能力差，且基于LLM的检测推理成本过高，亟需为MCP协议下的AI Agent提供安全保障。
AI.method: ADR包含三个组件：ADR Sensor采集高保真Agent遥测数据，ADR Explorer进行系统化红队测试与困难样本生成，ADR Detector采用两级在线检测（快速分类+上下文推理）。
AI.result: 在Uber生产环境中实现97.2%精确率，检测到206个凭证泄露；在ADR-Bench上零误报且检测67%攻击，F1分数提升2-4倍；在AgentDojo上检测全部攻击，仅3次误报。
AI.conclusion: ADR证明了大厂级AI Agent安全防护的可行性，通过遥测+红队+两级检测的组合方案，在可扩展性和检测效果上均优于现有方法，并开源了基准测试以推动社区发展。

title: Face inpainting with Identity Preserving Latent Diffusion Models
summary: Face inpainting techniques recover missing or occluded facial regions in a visually realistic manner, but preserving the identity in the final output remains a fundamental challenge. Identity consistency is crucial for downstream applications such as face recognition, digital forensics, and human-computer interaction, where even subtle identity distortions can significantly degrade performance or trust. Although diffusion-based generative models have recently achieved remarkable progress in image inpainting, they often struggle to faithfully retain individual-specific facial characteristics. On the other hand, existing identity-aware methods typically rely on costly fine-tuning, auxiliary supervision, or exhibit limited robustness to diverse occlusions, poses, and facial variations. To address these limitations, we propose ID-ControlNet, an identity-preserving face inpainting framework built upon latent diffusion models. Based on ControlNet architecture, our approach conditions the diffusion process on facial identity embeddings extracted from a pretrained face recognition network. This design enables reconstruction of occluded facial regions while maintaining global facial coherence and identity fidelity. Furthermore, we introduce an identity consistency and triplet loss training strategy that explicitly enforces alignment between the generated face and the target identity representation. Extensive experiments on CelebA-HQ, FFHQ, and on a new E-Mask dataset demonstrate that ID-ControlNet significantly improves identity preservation over standard diffusion-based inpainting methods, achieving performance comparable to SOTA identity-aware approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出ID-ControlNet，一种基于潜在扩散模型的身份保持人脸修复框架，通过ControlNet架构和身份嵌入条件，有效解决人脸修复中的身份一致性问题。
AI.motivation: 现有人脸修复方法在保持身份一致性方面存在挑战，扩散模型难以保留个体面部特征，现有身份感知方法依赖昂贵微调或辅助监督，且对多样遮挡和姿态鲁棒性有限。
AI.method: 基于ControlNet架构，将预训练人脸识别网络提取的身份嵌入作为扩散过程的条件，并引入身份一致性损失和三元组损失训练策略，显式约束生成结果与目标身份表示的对齐。
AI.result: 在CelebA-HQ、FFHQ和新提出的E-Mask数据集上，ID-ControlNet显著优于标准扩散修复方法，性能接近最先进的身份感知方法。
AI.conclusion: ID-ControlNet有效解决了人脸修复中的身份保持难题，为下游应用提供了更可靠的解决方案。

title: Internalizing Tool Knowledge in Small Language Models via QLoRA Fine-Tuning
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as planning components in agentic systems, but current tool-use pipelines often require full tool schemas to be included in every prompt, creating substantial token overhead and limiting the practicality of smaller models. This paper investigates whether tool-use knowledge can be internalized into small language models through parameter-efficient fine-tuning, enabling structured planning without explicit tool descriptions at inference time. Using AssetOpsBench as the primary benchmark, we fine-tune Gemma 4 E4B and Qwen3-4B with 8-bit QLoRA on approximately 1,700 tool-use examples spanning tool knowledge, question-to-plan mappings, and execution-style traces. We evaluate the resulting models under description-free inference, where the prompt omits the tool catalog entirely. The fine-tuned models outperform an informed unfine-tuned baseline that receives full tool descriptions, reducing input length by 82.6\% while improving structural and LLM-judge planning scores. In the best Gemma run, the model achieves an AT-F1 of 0.65 and an overall judge score of 3.88, compared with 0.47 and 2.88 for the informed baseline. Qwen3-4B achieves a strong overall judge score of 3.78 while using 62\% less memory and running 2.5$\times$ faster than Gemma, though it also exhibits greater catastrophic forgetting on general multiple-choice benchmarks. Additional ablations show that LoRA rank controls a quality--retention trade-off, with $r=32$ maximizing planning quality and smaller ranks preserving more general knowledge. These results suggest that, for fixed tool catalogs, QLoRA fine-tuning can shift tool knowledge from prompt context into model weights, substantially reducing inference overhead while maintaining or improving tool-planning quality.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了通过参数高效微调（QLoRA）将工具使用知识内化到小语言模型中，使其在推理时无需显式工具描述即可进行结构化规划。实验表明，微调后的模型在减少82.6%输入长度的同时，规划质量优于包含完整工具描述的非微调基线模型。
AI.motivation: 当前工具使用流程需要将完整工具模式包含在每次提示中，造成大量token开销，限制了小模型的实用性。本文探索是否可以通过参数高效微调将工具使用知识内化到小模型中，从而在推理时无需显式工具描述。
AI.method: 使用AssetOpsBench作为基准，采用8位QLoRA对Gemma 4 E4B和Qwen3-4B进行微调，训练数据约1,700条工具使用示例。在描述无关推理设置下评估模型性能，同时进行LoRA秩的消融实验。
AI.result: 微调后的模型在减少82.6%输入长度的同时，规划评分优于包含完整工具描述的非微调基线。Gemma最佳运行AT-F1为0.65，整体评分3.88；Qwen3-4B整体评分3.78，内存减少62%，速度快2.5倍，但在通用基准上遗忘更严重。LoRA秩$r=32$最大化规划质量，较小秩保留更多通用知识。
AI.conclusion: 对于固定工具目录，QLoRA微调可以将工具知识从提示上下文转移到模型权重中，显著降低推理开销，同时保持或提升工具规划质量。

title: QQJ: Quantifying Qualitative Judgment for Scalable and Human-Aligned Evaluation of Generative AI
summary: The rapid progress of generative artificial intelligence has exposed fundamental limitations in existing evaluation methodologies, particularly for open-ended, creative, and human-facing tasks. Traditional automatic metrics rely on surface-level statistical similarity and often fail to reflect human perceptions of quality, while purely human evaluation, although reliable, is costly, subjective, and difficult to scale. Recent approaches using large language models as evaluators offer improved scalability but frequently lack explicit grounding in human-defined evaluation principles, leading to bias and inconsistency. In this paper, we introduce Quantifying Qualitative Judgment (QQJ), a scalable and human-centric evaluation framework that explicitly bridges the gap between human judgment and automated assessment. QQJ separates the definition of quality from its execution by anchoring evaluation in expert-designed, multi-dimensional rubrics and calibrating large language model evaluators to align with expert reasoning using a small, high-quality annotation set. This design enables consistent, interpretable, and scalable evaluation across diverse generative tasks and modalities. Extensive experiments on text and image generation demonstrate that QQJ achieves substantially stronger alignment with human judgment than traditional automatic metrics and unconstrained LLM-based evaluators. Moreover, QQJ exhibits improved stability across repeated evaluations and superior diagnostic capability in identifying critical failure modes such as hallucination and intent mismatch. These results indicate that structured qualitative judgment can be operationalized at scale without sacrificing interpretability or human alignment, positioning QQJ as a practical foundation for reliable evaluation of modern generative AI systems.

AI.tldr: 提出QQJ框架，通过专家设计的多维评分标准校准LLM评估器，实现可扩展、可解释且与人类判断高度对齐的生成式AI评估。
AI.motivation: 现有自动评估指标仅基于表面统计相似性，无法反映人类对质量的真实感知；纯人工评估成本高、主观性强且难以扩展；LLM评估器缺乏人类评估原则的显式引导，存在偏差和不一致性。
AI.method: 将质量定义与执行分离，通过专家设计的多维评分标准锚定评估，并使用小规模高质量标注集校准LLM评估器，使其对齐专家推理过程。
AI.result: 在文本和图像生成任务上，QQJ与人类判断的一致性显著优于传统自动指标和无约束LLM评估器；在多次评估中表现出更好的稳定性，并能有效识别幻觉和意图不匹配等关键失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的定性判断可以在不牺牲可解释性和人类对齐的前提下实现规模化部署，QQJ可作为现代生成式AI系统可靠评估的实用基础框架。

title: GeoWorld-VLM: Geometry from World Models for Vision-Language Models
summary: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) achieve strong semantic recognition, yet remain brittle on elementary spatial relations such as left of, on, behind, and between. One cause of this failure arises before language reasoning begins: the visual pathway may compress or discard critical 3D structural cues during feature extraction, so the language model receives image representations that are already insufficient for reliable spatial judgment. We introduce GeoWorld-VLM, a VLM-side distillation framework that transfers geometric structure from frozen camera-conditioned video world models into VLMs. GeoWorld-VLM fine-tunes only the image encoder and multimodal projector, aligning post-projector image features with intermediate world-model representations while leaving the main backbone frozen. Given images, a prompt, and a sampled camera trajectory, the world-model teacher converts static visual input into a synthetic multi-view spatial signal. Training combines spatial answer supervision, teacher-student feature alignment, and a preservation anchor to the original VLM. Since the language model remains frozen, GeoWorld-VLM preserves the original model's linguistic capabilities while attributing spatial improvements to the enhanced visual pathway. To evaluate the effectiveness and generality of the proposed method, we apply GeoWorld-VLM to two distinct VLM architectures and observe consistent improvements across both backbones. GeoWorld-VLM improves performance by approximately 4 percent on both the What'sUp and VSR benchmarks, suggesting that world-model-guided visual alignment generalizes across model structures and spatial reasoning datasets.

AI.tldr: GeoWorld-VLM通过将冻结的相机条件视频世界模型中的几何结构蒸馏到VLMs中，仅微调图像编码器和多模态投影器，使后投影图像特征与世界模型表示对齐，从而提升VLM在基本空间关系推理上的表现，在What'sUp和VSR基准上均提升约4%。
AI.motivation: 现代VLMs在语义识别上表现出色，但在"左边"、"上面"、"后面"、"之间"等基本空间关系上仍然脆弱。根本原因在于视觉通路在特征提取阶段可能压缩或丢弃了关键的三维结构线索，导致语言模型接收到的图像表示不足以进行可靠的空间判断。
AI.method: 提出GeoWorld-VLM框架，包含：1) 使用冻结的相机条件视频世界模型作为教师，将静态图像转换为合成的多视角空间信号；2) 仅微调VLMs的图像编码器和多模态投影器，使后投影图像特征与世界模型中间表示对齐；3) 结合空间答案监督、师生特征对齐和原始VLM保留锚点进行训练；4) 保持语言模型冻结以保留原有语言能力。
AI.result: 将GeoWorld-VLM应用于两种不同的VLM架构，在两个骨干网络上均观察到一致的改进。在What'sUp和VSR基准测试上均提升了约4%的性能。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型引导的视觉对齐方法能够跨模型结构和空间推理数据集泛化，通过增强视觉通路而非语言模型来提升空间关系推理能力，同时保持原始VLM的语言能力。

title: Heterogeneous Information-Bottleneck Coordination Graphs for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Coordination graphs are a central abstraction in cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL), yet existing sparse-graph learners lack a theoretically grounded mechanism to decide which edges should exist and how much information each edge should carry. Current methods rely on heuristic criteria that offer no formal guarantee on the learned topology, and no principled way to allocate different communication capacities to structurally different agent relationships. To address this, we propose Heterogeneous Information-Bottleneck Coordination Graphs (HIBCG), which learns a group-aware sparse graph in which both edge existence and message capacity are theoretically justified. With the graph information bottleneck (GIB) serving as the underlying tool, HIBCG first constructs a group-aligned block-diagonal prior that provides a closed-form criterion for edge retention -- determining which edges should exist and at what density per group block -- and then controls per-agent feature bandwidth on the resulting topology, compressing messages to retain only task-relevant content. We prove that the group-aligned prior strictly tightens the variational bound on topology learning, that the objective decomposes per group block, enabling differential edge control, and that capacity allocation follows a water-filling principle.

AI.tldr: 提出HIBCG框架，通过信息瓶颈理论为协作多智能体学习提供可证明的图拓扑与边容量分配机制。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏图学习方法缺乏理论基础来决定边是否存在及其信息容量，仅依赖无形式保证的启发式准则，无法对不同智能体关系分配差异化通信能力。
AI.method: 以图信息瓶颈（GIB）为核心工具，先构建组对齐的块对角先验，提供边保留的闭式准则；再控制每个智能体的特征带宽，压缩消息至仅保留任务相关内容。
AI.result: 组对齐先验严格收紧拓扑学习的变分下界；目标函数在每个组块上可分解，实现差异化边控制；容量分配遵循注水原理。
AI.conclusion: HIBCG首次从理论上同时解决了协作MARL中图拓扑的结构学习和边容量分配问题，提供了形式化保障。

title: MAVEN A Multi-Agent Framework for Multicultural Text-to-Video Generation
comment: [14] pages, [6] figures, [11] tables, appendix included. Preprint
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) generation has rapidly progressed in visual fidelity, yet its ability to faithfully represent multiple cultures within a single prompt remains underexplored. We introduce MAVEN, a multi-agent prompt refinement framework designed to improve cultural fidelity in both mono-cultural and cross-cultural T2V generation. MAVEN decomposes prompts into person, action, and location dimensions, handled by specialized agents operating in parallel or sequentially. To support systematic evaluation, we contribute a new benchmark of 243 culturally grounded prompts and 972 corresponding videos, spanning three cultures (Chinese, American, Romanian), three action categories, and both mono-cultural and cross-cultural scenarios. Evaluations combining CLIP-based metrics, VLM-as-judge assessments, and videoquality measures show that multi-agent refinement, particularly parallel specialization, significantly improves cultural relevance while preserving visual quality and temporal consistency. The dataset and code are available athttps://github.com/AIM-SCU/CRAFT

AI.tldr: MAVEN是一个多智能体提示优化框架，通过将提示分解为人物、动作、地点三个维度，分别由专门智能体处理，显著提升了文生视频在单文化和跨文化场景下的文化保真度。研究提出了包含243个文化提示和972个视频的基准数据集，覆盖中国、美国、罗马尼亚三种文化。
AI.motivation: 现有文生视频技术在视觉保真度上进步迅速，但在单个提示中忠实呈现多元文化的能力尚待探索，缺乏系统的跨文化视频生成评估方法。
AI.method: 提出MAVEN多智能体提示优化框架，将提示分解为人物、动作、地点三个维度，由专门智能体并行或串行处理；构建包含243个文化提示和972个视频的基准数据集，覆盖三种文化和两种场景。
AI.result: 结合CLIP指标、VLM评判和视频质量评估，多智能体优化（尤其是并行专业化）显著提升了文化相关性，同时保持了视觉质量和时间一致性。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体提示优化能有效提升文生视频的文化保真度，为跨文化内容生成提供了可行的技术路径。

title: SocialMemBench: Are AI Memory Systems Ready for Social Group Settings?
summary: Memory systems for AI assistants were built for single-user dialogue and fail characteristically when applied to multi-party social group settings. This gap matters for the social assistants being built today: group-acting agents embedded in chat platforms, and proactive personal-assistant agents whose holistic model of a user must include their social context. Existing memory benchmarks evaluate dyadic or workplace dialogue; none targets multi-party social groups, where memory must anchor facts in shared history rather than professional roles, separate group norms from individual exceptions, and correctly attribute even after member departure. We introduce SocialMemBench, a benchmark of human-verified synthetic social group networks across five archetypes (close friends, family, recreational, interest community, acquaintance network) and three group-size tiers (4-30 members), with 430 personas and 7,355 conversation turns, yielding 1,031 QA pairs across nine question categories. Each category isolates an architectural capability, and the five failure modes (single-stream conflation, temporal-state overwrite, entity merging at scale, missing cross-persona knowledge, norm-individual conflation) are testable hypotheses; our two research probes Subject-Mem and SMG provide evidence on two, three remain open. A full-context Gemini 2.5 Flash reference reaches only 0.721 against a blind-critic reasoning-model mean of 0.98 on small networks, indicating the benchmark is genuinely difficult even with complete access to the conversation. Across all 43 networks, the four open-source memory frameworks evaluated (Mem0, LangMem, Graphiti, Cognee) cluster in the 0.12-0.18 question-weighted range with overlapping 95% CIs, well below an uncompressed retrieval reference of 0.345 and a matched-answerer full-context reference of 0.369 (GPT-4o-mini). Current memory systems show a measurable gap.

AI.tldr: 现有AI记忆系统专为单用户对话设计，在多人群组社交场景中表现失败。本文提出SocialMemBench基准，涵盖5种社交群组类型、3种规模层级、430个人物和7,355轮对话，生成1,031个QA对。测试表明，开源记忆框架性能仅0.12-0.18，远低于全上下文参考模型0.721，揭示当前系统存在显著能力差距。
AI.motivation: AI助手正越来越多地嵌入多人群组社交场景（如聊天平台的群组代理、主动式个人助手），但现有记忆系统仅针对单用户对话设计，在多人群组中会出现五种典型失败模式（单流混淆、时序状态覆盖、大规模实体合并、跨人物知识缺失、规范-个体混淆），缺乏针对性的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建SocialMemBench基准，包含五种群组原型（亲密朋友、家庭、休闲团体、兴趣社群、熟人网络），三种规模（4-30人），430个人物和7,355轮对话，生成1,031个QA对共九类问题。同时设计了Subject-Mem和SMG两个研究探针进行验证。
AI.result: 全上下文Gemini 2.5 Flash参考模型在小型网络上仅达0.721，盲评推理模型平均为0.98。四种开源记忆框架（Mem0、LangMem、Graphiti、Cognee）在43个网络上仅达0.12-0.18，远低于未压缩检索参考值0.345和GPT-4o-mini全上下文参考值0.369。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI记忆系统在多人群组社交场景中存在显著能力差距，现有基准无法覆盖该场景，SocialMemBench为这一方向提供了有效的评测工具和基线。

title: Computational Challenges in Token Economics: Bridging Economic Theory and AI System Design
summary: Token economics has emerged as a useful lens for understanding resource allocation, value creation, and pricing in large language model systems. While recent work has increasingly treated tokens as economic primitives, there remains a substantial gap between high-level economic theory and the computational realities of modern AI infrastructure. This paper identifies and analyzes the key computational challenges that arise when token-economic principles are implemented in real-time inference systems. We argue that computational feasibility is not merely one dimension of token economics, but its governing constraint: these challenges are driven by fundamental tensions among fine-grained valuation, low-latency execution, and allocation optimality under uncertainty. To structure this problem space, we introduce the notion of \textbf{Computational Token Economics} and propose the \textbf{Token Economics Trilemma} -- a conditional no-free-lunch principle that captures the inherent trade-offs among granularity, real-time performance, and optimality. We further categorize the main technical challenges into three areas: real-time value accounting, constrained resource allocation, and economic-aware system architecture. Rather than presenting a complete solution, this paper aims to define a research agenda for bridging token economics and AI system design, highlighting open problems at the intersection of computational economics, machine learning systems, and AI infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"计算代币经济学"概念和"代币经济学三难困境"，分析了在实时推理系统中实现代币经济原理时面临的计算挑战，并定义了连接代币经济学与AI系统设计的研究议程。
AI.motivation: 现有代币经济学研究多停留在高层面经济理论，与AI基础设施的计算现实之间存在显著鸿沟，亟需弥合理论与工程实践之间的差距。
AI.method: 通过分析实时推理系统中代币经济原理实现的计算可行性问题，提出"计算代币经济学"框架和"代币经济学三难困境"概念，并将技术挑战归类为实时价值核算、受限资源分配和经济感知系统架构三个领域。
AI.result: 识别出细粒度评估、低延迟执行与不确定条件下的分配最优性之间的根本矛盾，揭示了计算可行性是代币经济学的首要约束条件。
AI.conclusion: 本文不提供完整解决方案，而是旨在定义连接代币经济学与AI系统设计的未来研究议程，强调计算经济学、机器学习系统与AI基础设施交叉领域的开放问题。

title: Compositional Adversarial Training for Robust Visual Watermarking
summary: Robust watermarking is typically trained with random post-processing augmentation, but random sampling under-covers the combinatorial space of realistic attack pipelines and rarely encounters the rare compositions that actually break detection. This leads to unstable training and poor sample efficiency. We instead formulate watermark robustness as a min-max problem over a structured space of compositional transformations. We propose Compositional Adversarial Training (CAT), a plug-in framework that learns a sequential differentiable adversary that observes the current watermarked image and selects an attack family at each step to maximally disrupt message recovery. CAT combines a straight-through Gumbel-Softmax attack selection with entropy regularization, allowing the backward pass to be end-to-end differentiable and aggregate gradient information across attack families, yielding faster, smoother convergence without collapsing to a single attack mode. We evaluate CAT on post-generation watermarks VideoSeal 0.0, VideoSeal 1.0, and PixelSeal and in-generation WMAR under both single-step and two-step attack suites, on in-distribution and multiple out-of-distribution image and video benchmarks. CAT consistently outperforms random-augmentation baselines trained with the same augmentation budget, with the largest gains on hard composed attacks and OOD evaluations; improving overall watermark capacity by up to $63.5\%$ in the single-step attack setting and $13.0\%$ in the compositional setting. In the autoregressive setting, CAT improves the TPR@FPR$=1\%$ by $12\%$ on average on difficult geometric transformations. These results show that robust visual watermarking benefits from training against adaptive compositional adversaries rather than independent random corruptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出组合对抗训练(CAT)框架，通过可微分的组合攻击选择策略来训练鲁棒水印，相比传统的随机增强方法显著提升了水印在各种攻击下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 传统的鲁棒水印训练使用随机后处理增强，但随机采样难以覆盖现实攻击流水线的组合空间，导致训练不稳定且样本效率低下。
AI.method: 将水印鲁棒性建模为结构化的组合变换空间上的min-max问题，提出CAT框架：通过straight-through Gumbel-Softmax进行可微攻击选择，结合熵正则化实现端到端梯度反传，聚合多种攻击族的梯度信息。
AI.result: 在单步攻击设置下水印容量提升63.5%，组合攻击设置下提升13.0%；自回归设置下TPR@FPR=1%平均提升12%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉水印的鲁棒性训练应从独立随机损坏转向适应性的组合对抗训练。

title: Generating Pretraining Tokens from Organic Data for Data-Bound Scaling
summary: LLM pretraining is shifting from a compute-bound to a data-bound regime, where available human (organic) text falls far short of scaling demands. However, reaching the data-bound regime does not mean the model has fully utilized its organic corpus. In this paper, we introduce SynPro, a synthetic data generation framework that helps LLMs more thoroughly learn from limited organic data. SynPro applies two operations, rephrasing and reformat, that present the same organic source in diverse forms to facilitate deeper learning without introducing external information. Both generators are optimized via reinforcement learning with quality, faithfulness, and data influence rewards, and are continuously updated as pretraining plateaus to target content the model has yet to absorb. We pretrain 400M and 1.1B models with 10% of their Chinchilla-optimal tokens (0.8B and 2.2B) from DCLM-Baseline, reflecting a realistic data-bound regime in frontier pretraining. Our results reveal that organic data is significantly underutilized by standard repetition: SynPro unlocks 3.7-5.2x the effective tokens of repetition, even surpassing the non-data-bound oracle that trains on equivalent unique data at the 1.1B scale. Analyses confirm that faithful, model-aware synthesis sustains data-bound scaling without causing distribution collapse. We open-source our code at https://github.com/cxcscmu/SynPro.

AI.tldr: SynPro 是一个合成数据生成框架，通过改写和重构两种操作，让有限的有机文本以多样化形式呈现，帮助LLM更充分地学习。在数据受限的预训练场景下，SynPro 相比标准重复能产生3.7-5.2倍的有效token，并超越非数据受限的oracle基线。
AI.motivation: LLM预训练正从计算受限转向数据受限，可用的有机文本远无法满足扩展需求。然而，进入数据受限阶段并不意味着模型已充分利用其有机语料，因此需要探索如何让模型从有限数据中更深入地学习。
AI.method: SynPro 框架包含两个核心操作：(1) 改写（rephrasing）和重构（reformat），将同一有机源以多样化形式呈现；(2) 通过强化学习优化生成器，奖励信号包括质量、忠实度和数据影响力；(3) 生成器在预训练停滞时持续更新，以针对模型尚未吸收的内容生成数据。
AI.result: 在400M和1.1B模型上，使用10%的Chinchilla最优token进行预训练，SynPro 相比标准重复解锁了3.7-5.2倍的有效token，在1.1B尺度上甚至超越了使用等量唯一数据的非数据受限oracle。
AI.conclusion: 有机数据在标准重复策略下被严重低效利用。忠实于原意且模型感知的合成数据生成能够在数据受限条件下持续扩展规模，且不会导致分布坍塌。

title: Multi-Party Multi-Objective Optimization as Consensus Search: Runtime Analysis of Cross-Party Recombination
summary: Multi-party multi-objective optimization problems (MPMOPs) require consensus among autonomous decision makers and therefore differ from flattened many-objective formulations. Existing runtime theory for multi-objective evolutionary algorithms is largely tailored to single-party Pareto-front approximation and does not directly explain common-solution search in MPMOPs. We investigate cross-party recombination in two representative settings. On MP-JCG, a pseudo-Boolean benchmark with an explicit gap region, we prove that a payoff-guided mutation baseline faces a gap-crossing bottleneck requiring \(Θ(n^2)\) expected fitness evaluations. In contrast, an analytical CPR-NSGA-II variant discovers both common Pareto-optimal solutions in \(O(n\log n)\) expected evaluations by directly assembling complementary prefix and suffix templates distributed across party populations. Comparing this with the flattened four-objective formulation F-JCG, our full-front coverage analysis illustrates the additional coverage burden introduced by flattening. For BPBOMST, the bi-party, two-objective-per-party specialization of the multi-party multi-objective minimum spanning tree problem, we develop a layered support-cover analysis. For each common Pareto objective vector, the symmetric average projection induces an auxiliary bi-objective MST instance, and suitable support representatives yield a \(2λ\)-common approximation cover with \(λ\in[1,2]\). We further derive an instance-parameterized expected runtime bound for a representative-pool CPR-NSGA-II variant using edge-union recombination and uniform repair. This bound separates the effects of local auxiliary-front filling, cross-party recombination shortcuts, and edge-union repair ambiguity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多目标进化算法在多参与方多目标优化问题中的交叉重组机制，证明了一种CPR-NSGA-II变体能够高效发现共同Pareto最优解，并建立了相应的理论运行时间界。
AI.motivation: 现有MPMOPs的运行时理论主要针对单方Pareto前沿近似，无法直接解释多方共同解搜索过程，亟需建立针对交叉重组机制的理论分析框架。
AI.method: 通过两个代表性问题（MP-JCG和BPBOMST）进行分析：在MP-JCG上对比基于支付的突变基线和CPR-NSGA-II的交叉重组策略；在BPBOMST上发展分层支持覆盖分析，并推导实例参数化的期望运行时界。
AI.result: MP-JCG：突变基线需要Θ(n²)期望评价，而CPR-NSGA-II只需O(n log n)；BPBOMST：建立了2λ-公共近似覆盖（λ∈[1,2]），并推导出可分离局部辅助前沿填充、交叉重组捷径和边-并修复歧义影响的运行时界。
AI.conclusion: 交叉重组能有效突破多方多目标优化中的间隙瓶颈，CPR-NSGA-II的策略显著优于传统突变基线，且扁平化多目标形式会引入额外覆盖负担。

title: DiRotQ: Rotation-Aware Quantization for 4-bit Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) achieve state-of-the-art image generation quality but incur substantial memory and computational costs at inference. While aggressive Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) to 4-bit precision offers significant efficiency gains, it typically results in severe quality degradation. Existing approaches, including smoothing-based methods, mixed-precision schemes, rotation techniques, and low-rank residual methods, partially mitigate this issue but still leave a noticeable gap to FP16/BF16 performance. In this work, we introduce DiRotQ, a W4A4 PTQ framework that mitigates this degradation through rotation-aware activation quantization. DiRotQ identifies a low-rank subspace capturing dominant activation variance via Principal Component Analysis (PCA), preserving coefficients in this subspace at higher precision while quantizing the remaining components to 4-bit. Activations are rotated into the PCA basis at inference time using calibration-derived orthogonal transformations, while the inverse rotation is fused into the layer weights offline. Combined with GPTQ-based weight quantization, DiRotQ achieves an FID (lower is better) of 15.9 and PSNR (higher is better) of 19.1 dB on PixArt-Σ over the MJHQ-30K dataset, outperforming the prior state-of-the-art SVDQuant (FID 18.9, PSNR 17.6) under the same INT W4A4 setting. Beyond standard metrics, we introduce a VLM-as-a-Judge evaluation protocol for diffusion model quantization, the first such evaluation in this setting, providing a more holistic assessment of perceptual quality and prompt alignment under aggressive compression.
