summary: We introduce Graph-Augmented Sequence-to-Sequence (GA-S2S), a novel framework that integrates a T5-small encoder-decoder with a Relational Graph Attention Network (RGAT) to improve link prediction in knowledge graphs. While existing Seq2Seq models rely solely on surface-level textual descriptions of entities and relations and at best, flatten the neighborhoods of a query entity into a single linear sequence, thereby discarding the inherent graph structure, GA-S2S jointly encodes both textual features and the full $k$-hop subgraph topology surrounding the query entity. By integrating raw encoder outputs with RGAT's relation-aware embeddings, our model captures and leverages richer multi-hop relational patterns and textual information. Our preliminary experiments on the CoDEx dataset demonstrate that GA-S2S outperforms competitive Seq2Seq-based baseline models, achieving up to a 19\% relative gain in link prediction accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出GA-S2S框架，将T5-small编码器-解码器与关系图注意力网络(RGAT)结合，通过联合编码文本特征和k跳子图拓扑结构，在CoDEx数据集上的链接预测任务中取得了最高19%的相对性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有Seq2Seq模型仅依赖实体和关系的表层文本描述，且至多将查询实体的邻域展平为线性序列，忽略了知识图谱中固有的图结构信息，导致预测性能受限。
AI.method: 将T5-small编码器-解码器与RGAT相结合，联合编码文本特征和查询实体周围的完整k跳子图拓扑结构，通过融合原始编码器输出与RGAT的关系感知嵌入来捕获多跳关系模式和文本信息。
AI.result: 在CoDEx数据集上的初步实验表明，GA-S2S优于基于Seq2Seq的基线模型，在链接预测准确率上实现了最高19%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: GA-S2S通过显式建模图结构信息有效提升了链接预测性能，验证了融合图神经网络与序列到序列模型在知识图谱推理中的有效性。

title: Divergence-Suppressing Couplings for Rectified Flow
summary: The promise of Rectified Flow rests on producing self-generated couplings whose trajectories are straight, or nearly so. In practice, trajectories generated by the base flow model can bend and intertwine, and the resulting coupling inherits this distortion. In this paper, we identify that such trajectory entanglement is often associated with regions of nonzero divergence in the learned velocity field, where local expansion or contraction distorts trajectories and steers particles away from their ideal endpoints. We then propose divergence-suppressing couplings for Rectified Flow, an offline correction that attenuate the divergent component of the learned velocity during coupling generation. The correction is paid only once per coupling pair and amortized over training, so deployment runs plain Euler at identical wall-clock cost to standard Rectified Flow. Empirically, this offline modification yields consistent improvements on 2D synthetic benchmarks and on image generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过抑制速度场散度来改善Rectified Flow中的轨迹纠缠问题，离线修正耦合生成过程，在保持相同推理成本的前提下提升了生成效果。
AI.motivation: Rectified Flow中基础流模型生成的轨迹常出现弯曲和纠缠，导致耦合质量下降，影响生成效果。
AI.method: 提出散度抑制耦合（divergence-suppressing couplings）方法，在离线阶段对耦合生成过程中的学习速度场进行散度成分衰减，每次耦合对仅计算一次修正成本。
AI.result: 在2D合成基准和图像生成任务上均取得一致改进。
AI.conclusion: 通过离线抑制速度场散度，能有效减轻轨迹纠缠，提升Rectified Flow性能，且不增加部署时的推理成本。

title: Context Memorization for Efficient Long Context Generation
summary: Modern large language model (LLM) applications increasingly rely on long conditioning prefixes to control model behavior at inference time. While prefix-augmented inference is effective, it incurs two structural limitations: i) the prefix's influence fades as generation proceeds, and ii) attention computation over the prefix scales linearly with its length. Existing approaches either keep the prefix in attention while compressing it, or internalize it into model parameters through gradient-based training. The former still attends to the prefix at inference, while the latter is training-intensive and ill-suited to prefix updates. To address these issues, we propose attention-state memory, a training-free approach that externalizes the prefix into a lightweight, lookup-based memory of precomputed attention states between prefix and query tokens. On ManyICLBench with LLaMA-3.1-8B, our method improves accuracy over in-context learning at 1K-8K memory budgets while reducing attention latency by 1.36x at 8K, and surpasses full-attention RAG performance on NBA benchmark using only 20% of its memory footprint.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的注意力状态记忆方法，通过将前缀预计算为轻量级查找表，解决了长前缀推理中的注意力衰减和计算开销问题，在多个基准上提升了准确率并降低了延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有长上下文前缀增强推理存在两个结构性问题：一是前缀的影响随生成过程逐渐衰减，二是对前缀的注意力计算量随其长度线性增长。现有压缩方法仍需要在推理时关注前缀，而基于梯度训练的方法成本高且不利于前缀更新。
AI.method: 提出注意力状态记忆（attention-state memory），一种无需训练的轻量级方法，将前缀与查询之间的注意力状态预先计算并外部化为基于查找的记忆，推理时直接读取而非重新计算。
AI.result: 在ManyICLBench上使用LLaMA-3.1-8B，在1K-8K记忆预算下准确率优于上下文学习，8K时注意力延迟降低1.36倍；在NBA基准上仅用20%记忆开销即超越全注意力RAG性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保持高效推理的同时有效缓解了前缀长度带来的计算负担和影响衰减问题，且支持快速前缀更新，是一种实用的长上下文推理优化方案。

title: Harnessing LLM Agents with Skill Programs
summary: Equipping LLM agents with reusable skills derived from past experience has become a popular and successful approach for tackling complex and long-horizon tasks. However, such lessons are often encoded as textual guidance that remains largely advisory, lacking explicit mechanisms for when and how to intervene in the agent loop. To bridge the gap, we introduce HASP(Harnessing LLM Agents with Skill Programs), a new framework that upgrades skills into executable Program Functions (PFs). Rather than offering passive advice, PFs act as executable guardrails that activate on failure-prone states and modify the next action or inject corrective context. HASP is highly modular: it can be applied at inference time for direct agent-loop intervention, during post-training to provide structured supervision, or for self-improvement by evolving validated, teacher-reviewed PFs. Empirically, HASP drives substantial gains compared to both training-free and training-based methods on web-search, math reasoning, and coding tasks. For example, on web-search reasoning, inference-time PFs alone improve the average performance by 25% compared to (multi-loop) ReAct Agent, while post-training and controlled evolution achieve a 30.4% gain over Search-R1. To provide deeper insights into HASP, our mechanism analysis reveals how PFs trigger and intervene, how skills are internalized, and the requirement for stable skill library evolution.

AI.tldr: HASP将经验技能升级为可执行的程序函数（PFs），在推理时直接干预代理循环、在训练后提供结构化监督，或通过自我进化改进性能，在网页搜索、数学推理和编码任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将经验编码为文本指导，缺乏明确的干预机制，HASP旨在弥合这一差距，将技能转化为可执行的程序函数以主动干预代理行为。
AI.method: HASP将技能升级为可执行的Program Functions（PFs），作为可执行的护栏在失败易发状态激活，修改下一步动作或注入纠正上下文。框架支持推理时干预、训练后结构化监督和自我进化。
AI.result: 在网页搜索推理中，推理时PFs比ReAct Agent提升25%；搜索-R1基础上结合训练后及受控进化提升30.4%。
AI.conclusion: HASP通过可执行程序函数有效桥接了技能指导与实际干预之间的鸿沟，为LLM代理提供了更主动、可控的技能利用机制。

title: Learning Relative Representations for Fine-Grained Multimodal Alignment with Limited Data
summary: Multimodal pre-training demonstrates strong generalization performance, but this paradigm is often impractical in domains where paired data are scarce. A promising alternative is post-hoc multimodal alignment, which aligns separately pre-trained unimodal encoders using a limited number of paired examples. However, existing methods focus primarily on aligning global representations, missing patch-token relations. This may hinder transfer to tasks that require fine-grained cross-modal matching beyond coarse sample-level semantics. To address this issue, we propose a post-hoc alignment method that learns token-level cross-modal structure using relative representations. Specifically, we represent images and texts through their token-level similarities to a set of learnable anchors in each modality space, which are trained to induce consistent cross-modal similarity patterns for matched pairs. Despite learning only the anchors without heavy projection layers, our approach consistently outperforms existing methods in zero-shot classification, cross-modal retrieval, and zero-shot segmentation by a substantial margin. This highlights the importance of modeling fine-grained cross-modal structure for effective post-hoc multimodal alignment with limited paired data.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于相对表示的后对齐方法，通过可学习锚点学习token级跨模态结构，在有限配对数据下显著提升零样本分类、检索和分割性能。
AI.motivation: 现有后对齐方法主要对齐全局表示，忽略了patch-token级别的细粒度关系，限制了需要精细跨模态匹配的任务性能。
AI.method: 利用相对表示，通过图像和文本在各自模态空间中与一组可学习锚点的token级相似性来建模跨模态结构，仅训练锚点而不使用重型投影层。
AI.result: 在零样本分类、跨模态检索和零样本分割任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 建模细粒度跨模态结构对于在有限配对数据下实现有效的后对齐至关重要。

title: SomaliWeb v1: A Quality-Filtered Somali Web Corpus with a Matched Tokenizer and a Public Language-Identification Benchmark
summary: Somali is a Cushitic language of the Horn of Africa with ~25 million speakers, yet no documented dedicated Somali pretraining corpus with a companion tokenizer and language-identification benchmark has been publicly released. Existing Somali text appears either inside multilingual distributions (HPLT v2, CC100, MADLAD-400, OSCAR, mC4) or in small, undocumented Somali-only uploads on Hugging Face. We introduce SomaliWeb v1, a quality-filtered Somali corpus of 819,322 documents (~303M tokens) built from three upstream sources (HPLT v2, CC100, Somali Wikipedia) through a six-stage reproducible pipeline. We release (i) the corpus, (ii) a matched BPE-16K tokenizer, and (iii) the first public side-by-side Somali benchmark of three production language identifiers. Our measurements reveal concrete quality defects in existing distributions: HPLT v2's "cleaned" Somali release retains 17.3% byte-exact duplicates, 56.1% of its documents contain fixable mojibake, and 10.7% of its byte-unique documents are near-duplicates at Jaccard tau=0.80. Our BPE-16K tokenizer emits 40.2% fewer tokens than GPT-4's cl100k_base on FLORES-200 Somali devtest as a tokenizer-level measurement; downstream language-model perplexity comparisons are deferred to a follow-up release.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了首个专门针对索马里语的预训练语料库SomaliWeb v1（约3.03亿token），配套BPE-16K分词器及语言识别基准，并揭示了现有语料库中17.3%的重复、56.1%的乱码等质量问题。
AI.motivation: 索马里语虽有约2500万使用者，但缺乏公开的专用预训练语料库，现有语料分散在多语言数据集中或存在质量问题。
AI.method: 从HPLT v2、CC100和索马里语维基百科三个来源出发，经过六阶段可复现管道进行质量过滤，构建了819,322篇文档的语料库，并训练了BPE-16K分词器。
AI.result: 发现HPLT v2中17.3%字节级重复、56.1%文档存在可修复乱码、10.7%文档为近似重复；BPE-16K分词器比GPT-4的cl100k_base减少40.2%的token数。
AI.conclusion: 发布了索马里语专用语料库、分词器和首个语言识别基准，为索马里语NLP研究提供了基础资源。

title: Thinking with Patterns: Breaking the Perceptual Bottleneck in Visual Planning via Pattern Induction
summary: Planning from raw visual input remains a significant challenge for current Vision-Language Models (VLMs), when the complexity of input is beyond their one-step perception capability. Motivated by recent advances in Thinking with Images (TWI), a reasonable solution is to decompose the perception process into simpler steps by iteratively acquiring and incorporating local visual evidence. However, even though current VLMs are well-trained in general TWI ability, their perceptual bottleneck in the planning domain remains. To tackle this challenge, we formulate TWI as a tool to gradually build and reflect an accurate internal world model. We find that the resulting training-free planning strategy enables VLMs to solve tasks that are far beyond their initial capabilities, at the cost that too many TWI operations would significantly increase the computational overhead. To further improve efficiency, we propose Pattern Inference, a novel TWI strategy enabling VLMs to actively recognize known visual patterns in the new tasks and directly infer local world model structures. To obtain these patterns, we propose Pattern Induction, an online inductive learning strategy treating visual patterns as composite and reusable experts, which are autonomously discovered and optimized from experience. Experimental evaluations in FrozenLake, Crafter and CubeBench domains show that our approaches achieve a desirable balance between accuracy and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于“思维与图像”（TWI）的训练无关规划策略，通过逐步构建和反思内部世界模型，提升VLM在复杂视觉输入下的规划能力，并引入模式推理与归纳机制来平衡准确性与效率。
AI.motivation: 当前VLM在原始视觉输入下的规划能力有限，复杂场景超出其一阶感知能力，而现有TWI虽可分解感知过程，但在规划领域仍存在感知瓶颈。
AI.method: 将TWI作为逐步构建内部世界模型的工具；提出Pattern Inference（模式推理）让VLM主动识别已知视觉模式并推断局部世界模型结构；提出Pattern Induction（模式归纳）作为在线归纳学习策略，将视觉模式视为可组合、可复用的专家进行自主发现与优化。
AI.result: 在FrozenLake、Crafter和CubeBench三个领域验证了该方法在准确性与效率之间达到了理想平衡。
AI.conclusion: 训练无关的TWI规划策略能显著扩展VLM能力边界，但过多TWI操作会带来计算开销；通过模式推理与归纳可在保持性能的同时提升效率。

title: Multilingual jailbreaking of LLMs using low-resource languages
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attempts that circumvent safety guardrails. We investigate whether multi-turn conversations using low-resource African languages (Afrikaans, Kiswahili, isiXhosa, and isiZulu) can bypass safety mechanisms across commercial LLMs. We translated prompts from existing datasets and evaluated ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini, and Grok through automated testing and human red-teaming with native speakers. Single-turn translation attacks proved ineffective, while multi-turn conversations achieved English harmful response rates from 52.7% (Claude 3.5 Haiku) to 83.6% (GPT-4o-mini), Afrikaans from 60.0% (Claude 3.5 Haiku) to 78.2% (GPT-4o-mini), and Kiswahili from 41.8% (Claude 3.5 Haiku) to 70.9% (DeepSeek). Human red-teaming increased jailbreak rates compared to automated methods. Over all evaluated languages, the average jailbreak rate increased from 59.8% to 75.8%, with improvements of +20.0% (Afrikaans), +12.7% (isiZulu), +12.3% (isiXhosa), and +1% (Kiswahili), demonstrating that poor translation quality limits jailbreak success. These findings suggest that vulnerabilities in LLMs persist in multilingual contexts and that translation quality is the critical factor determining jailbreak success in low-resource languages.

AI.tldr: 研究通过多轮对话使用低资源非洲语言（南非荷兰语、斯瓦希里语等）成功绕过商业LLM的安全机制，人类红队测试比自动化方法更有效，翻译质量是决定越狱成功的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）仍然容易受到越狱攻击，而现有的安全护栏在低资源语言场景下的有效性尚未得到充分研究。作者希望通过探索非洲低资源语言的多轮对话来评估和揭示这些漏洞。
AI.method: 从现有数据集翻译提示词，在ChatGPT、Claude、DeepSeek、Gemini和Grok等商业LLM上进行自动化测试和母语者人工红队测试。比较单轮翻译攻击与多轮对话攻击的效果，并评估不同语言间的越狱成功率差异。
AI.result: 单轮翻译攻击无效；多轮对话越狱成功率从41.8%到83.6%不等。人类红队测试将平均越狱率从59.8%提升至75.8%，其中南非荷兰语提升+20.0%，isiZulu提升+12.7%，isiXhosa提升+12.3%，斯瓦希里语提升+1%。
AI.conclusion: LLM在多语言环境下的安全漏洞仍然存在，翻译质量是决定低资源语言越狱成功的关键因素。

title: Surface-Form Neural Sparse Retrieval: Robust Fuzzy Matching for Industrial Music Search
summary: Music search at the scale of Amazon Music presents a unique challenge: queries frequently deviate from indexed metadata due to misspellings, transpositions, and phonetic variations, yet the retrieval system must operate under strict millisecond-level latency constraints. Our existing learning-to-retrieve system, the High Confidence Index (HCI), learns query-entity associations from customer behavior, relying on continual ``exploration'' to choose candidates. Traditional n-gram matching enables this exploration but suffers from poor semantic robustness and high noise, limiting the system's ability to learn from long-tail queries. In this work, we present a \textbf{robust neural sparse retrieval system} designed to maximize exploration efficiency. We adapt a state-of-the-art \textbf{inference-free} sparse retrieval architecture to the music domain, combining it with an effective \textbf{domain-specific granular subword tokenization strategy}. Our approach utilizes short-length token constraints (max 3 chars) to enforce the learning of surface-form robustness over lexical memorization. By pre-computing the neural embeddings and term expansions during the offline indexing phase, online processing is reduced to minimal tokenization and IDF weighting, achieving effectively zero latency overhead for query encoding. Evaluations on a 6M-document production corpus show an aggregate \textbf{91.4\%} recall@10 (vs. \textbf{57.7\%} for trigrams) at comparable throughput. Simulation of the HCI feedback loop demonstrates improved exploration efficiency, with \textbf{+0.8\%} higher stabilized recall than production trigrams. Ablation studies indicate that our sparse training methodology drives the performance gains, while domain-specific pretraining provides a cost-effective alternative to large-scale general-purpose pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种鲁棒的神经稀疏检索系统，用于Amazon Music的大规模音乐搜索。该系统通过推理无关的稀疏检索架构和领域特定的子词分词策略，在毫秒级延迟约束下实现了91.4%的recall@10，相比传统的三元组匹配（57.7%）有显著提升。
AI.motivation: Amazon Music规模的音乐搜索面临查询拼写错误、音位变体等挑战，现有基于n-gram匹配的学习系统（HCI）语义鲁棒性差、噪声高，难以从长尾查询中学习，亟需一种更高效的探索机制。
AI.method: 采用推理无关的稀疏检索架构，结合领域特定的细粒度子词分词策略（最大3字符），在离线索引阶段预计算神经嵌入和词项扩展，在线处理仅需极简的分词和IDF加权，实现零延迟开销。
AI.result: 在600万文档的生产语料上，recall@10达到91.4%（三元组匹配为57.7%），吞吐量相当；HCI模拟显示探索效率提升，稳定召回率比生产三元组高0.8%。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏训练方法是性能提升的关键驱动因素，而领域特定的预训练是大规模通用预训练的经济有效替代方案。

title: Machine Unlearning for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Recent masked diffusion language models (MDLMs), such as LLaDA and Dream, have achieved performance comparable to autoregressive large language models. Unlike autoregressive models, which generate text sequentially, MDLMs generate text by iteratively denoising masked positions in parallel. During fine-tuning, MDLMs learn to recover responses from masked response states conditioned on a prompt, thereby shifting their predictions from a prompt-masked unconditional distribution toward a prompt-conditional distribution. Despite this distinct generative and fine-tuning mechanism, machine unlearning for MDLMs remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we propose Masked Diffusion Unlearning (MDU), the first unlearning framework for MDLMs, by revisiting the process of learning specific knowledge in terms of diffusion. Specifically, MDU minimizes a forward KL divergence from the prompt-conditional prediction to a prompt-masked unconditional anchor at every masked response position, with a temperature scaling parameter to control the privacy-utility trade-off. Our empirical results on standard benchmarks and MDLM backbones show that MDU achieves high unlearning performance compared to existing LLM unlearning methods. Code is available at https://github.com/leegeoru/MDU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个面向掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）的机器遗忘框架MDU，通过最小化前向KL散度并引入温度缩放参数，在标准基准上取得了优于现有LLM遗忘方法的效果。
AI.motivation: MDLM（如LLaDA、Dream）在生成和微调机制上与自回归模型有本质区别，但机器遗忘在这一新兴模型家族中仍是空白，现有LLM遗忘方法不适用于MDLM。
AI.method: MDU通过最小化每个掩码位置上前向KL散度，使模型的条件预测分布趋近于一个基于提示-掩码的无条件锚点分布，并引入温度缩放参数来平衡隐私保护与模型实用性。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试和多种MDLM骨干网络上，MDU相比现有LLM遗忘方法取得了更高的遗忘性能。
AI.conclusion: MDU是首个面向MDLM的机器遗忘框架，为这类新型语言模型的安全可控移除知识提供了有效方案，代码已开源。

title: Entropy-Gradient Inversion: Moving Toward Internal Mechanism of Large Reasoning Models
summary: The advancement of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) has catalyzed a paradigm shift from reactive ``fast thinking'' text generation to systematic, step-by-step ``slow thinking'' reasoning, unlocking state-of-the-art performance in complex mathematical and logical tasks. However, the field faces \textit{the fundamental gap between token-level behavioral analysis and internal reasoning mechanisms, and the instability of reinforcement learning (RL) for reasoning optimization relying on costly external verifiers}. We identify and formally define \textbf{Entropy-Gradient Inversion}, a robust negative correlation between token entropy and logit gradients that acts as a definitive geometric fingerprint for LRM reasoning capability. Building on this, we propose \textbf{Correlation-Regularized Group Policy Optimization (CorR-PO)}, which embeds this inversion signature into RL reward regularization. Extensive experiments on various reasoning benchmarks across multiple model scales show CorR-PO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, confirming that stronger inversion directly correlates with superior reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: 提出熵-梯度反转（Entropy-Gradient Inversion）作为大推理模型（LRM）推理能力的几何指纹，并基于此设计相关性正则化策略优化（CorR-PO），通过将反转特征嵌入RL奖励正则化，显著提升了推理性能。
AI.motivation: 填补当前LRM研究中token级行为分析与内部推理机制之间的鸿沟，以及解决依赖昂贵外部验证器的RL推理优化不稳定性问题。
AI.method: 形式化定义熵-梯度反转（token熵与logit梯度之间的稳健负相关）；提出CorR-PO（Correlation-Regularized Group Policy Optimization），将该反转特征作为正则化项嵌入RL奖励中。
AI.result: 在多种推理基准和多个模型规模上，CorR-PO一致优于现有最先进基线方法；更强的熵-梯度反转直接关联更优的推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 熵-梯度反转是LRM推理能力的内在几何指纹，基于此的CorR-PO方法有效提升了推理优化效果，验证了该特征与推理性能的正相关性。

title: Prefix-Adaptive Block Diffusion for Efficient Document Recognition
summary: Block Diffusion Models (BDMs) support parallel generation, flexible-length output, and KV caching, making them promising for efficient document parsing. However, existing BDMs bind denoising and cache commitment to fixed block boundaries: parallelism shrinks during intra-block denoising, while generated tokens cannot be cached until the whole block is completed. Moreover, intra-block bidirectional denoising conflicts with inter-block autoregression, creating inconsistent information flow that can challenge structure-sensitive recognition. We propose the Prefix-Adaptive Block Diffusion Model (PA-BDM), which replaces intra-block bidirectional denoising with causal denoising from prefix to suffix and treats the block size as a maximum candidate range rather than a fixed commitment unit. PA-BDM uses Confidence-gated Structural Loss (CSL) to build low-entropy prefixes before extending training to longer continuations. During inference, Progressive Prefix Commitment (PPC) then dynamically commits the longest reliable prefix into the KV cache and resets the next candidate range from the updated prefix, restoring a large parallel decoding space at each step. Experiments show that the 3B PA-BDM achieves higher recognition scores on several benchmarks and improves inference throughput by 71.6\% over the 2.5B MinerU-Diffusion.

AI.tldr: PA-BDM通过前缀自适应块扩散模型和置信门控结构损失，解决了现有块扩散模型在文档解析中固定块边界导致的并行性下降和缓存效率低的问题，在多个基准测试上取得更高识别分数，推理吞吐量提升71.6%。
AI.motivation: 现有BDM将去噪和缓存承诺绑定在固定块边界上：块内去噪时并行性收缩，生成的token在整块完成前无法被缓存；此外，块内双向去噪与块间自回归存在冲突，产生不一致的信息流，挑战结构敏感识别任务。
AI.method: 提出PA-BDM，用从前缀到后缀的因果去噪替代块内双向去噪，将块大小视为最大候选范围而非固定承诺单元。使用置信门控结构损失(CSL)先构建低熵前缀，再扩展到更长训练序列。推理时通过渐进式前缀承诺(PPC)动态将最长的可靠前缀提交到KV缓存，并从更新后的前缀重置下一个候选范围，恢复大并行解码空间。
AI.result: 3B参数的PA-BDM在多个基准测试上取得更高识别分数，推理吞吐量比2.5B的MinerU-Diffusion提升71.6%。
AI.conclusion: PA-BDM通过前缀自适应和渐进式提交策略，有效解决了BDM在文档解析中的并行与缓存效率问题，显著提升了识别性能和推理速度。

title: Knowledge-to-Verification: Exploring RLVR for LLMs in Knowledge-Intensive Domains
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated promising potential to enhance the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in domains such as mathematics and coding. However, its applications on knowledge-intensive domains have not been effectively explored due to the scarcity of high-quality verifiable data. Furthermore, current RLVR focuses solely on the correctness of final answers, leading to the limitations of flawed reasoning and sparse reward signals. In this work, we propose Knowledge-to-Verification (K2V), a framework that extends RLVR to knowledge-intensive domains through automated verifiable data synthesis, while enabling verification of the LLM's reasoning process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that K2V enhances the reasoning of LLM in knowledge-intensive domains without significantly compromising the model's general capabilities. This study also suggests that integrating automated data synthesis with reasoning verification is a promising direction to enhance model capabilities in these broader domains. Code is available at https://github.com/SeedScientist/K2V.

AI.tldr: 提出K2V框架，将RLVR扩展到知识密集型领域，通过自动化数据合成和推理过程验证增强LLM推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR主要应用于数学和编程领域，在知识密集型领域缺乏高质量可验证数据；且仅关注最终答案正确性，存在推理缺陷和奖励信号稀疏的问题。
AI.method: 提出Knowledge-to-Verification (K2V)框架，通过自动化可验证数据合成将RLVR扩展到知识密集型领域，同时实现对LLM推理过程的验证。
AI.result: 实验表明K2V增强了LLM在知识密集型领域的推理能力，且未显著损害模型通用能力。
AI.conclusion: 集成自动化数据合成与推理验证是增强模型在知识密集型领域能力的有效方向。

title: STRIDE: A Self-Reflective Agent Framework for Reliable Automatic Equation Discovery
summary: LLM-based equation discovery offers a promising route to recovering symbolic laws from data, but many systems still rely on generation-centered loops that propose candidates, fit parameters, score results, and reuse selected examples. Such loops can misjudge useful skeletons under unreliable fitting, discard near-correct equations that require repair, and accumulate redundant memories that provide limited guidance. We propose STRIDE, a self-reflective agent framework that improves reliability by coordinating data-aware generation, mixed-fitting evaluation, critic--executor repair, and diversity-preserving semantic memory. By turning fitted scores and candidate behavior into shared feedback, STRIDE enables equations to be proposed, assessed, refined, and reused within a closed-loop discovery process. Experiments on representative symbolic-regression benchmarks and LSR-Synth suites show that STRIDE improves accuracy, OOD robustness, and structural recovery across multiple LLM backbones, with ablations and analyses confirming the contribution of its core components.

AI.tldr: 提出STRIDE框架，通过自反思机制协调数据感知生成、混合拟合评估、批评-执行器修复和多样性保持语义记忆，提升符号方程发现的准确性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的方程发现方法存在三个问题：1）在不可靠的参数拟合下误判有用骨架；2）丢弃需要修复的近似正确方程；3）积累提供有限指导的冗余记忆。
AI.method: 提出STRIDE自反思智能体框架，包含四个核心组件：数据感知生成、混合拟合评估、批评-执行器修复、多样性保持语义记忆，通过闭环流程实现方程的建议、评估、精炼和复用。
AI.result: 在代表性符号回归基准和LSR-Synth套件上，STRIDE在多个LLM骨干上提升了准确性、分布外鲁棒性和结构恢复能力。
AI.conclusion: STRIDE通过自反思机制有效提升了符号方程发现的质量，消融实验证实了各核心组件的贡献。

title: Metric-Guided Feature Fusion of Visual Foundation Models for Segmentation Tasks
comment: Accepted to the CVPR 2026 Findings Track
summary: Although large-scale visual foundation models (VFMs) achieve remarkable performance in semantic understanding, they still underperform in instance-aware dense prediction tasks. They exhibit different biases in representation: for instance, promptable segmentation models (e.g., SAM2) focus on fine-grained region boundaries, while self-supervised models (e.g., DINOv3) emphasize object-level structure. This observation highlights the potential of combining complementary features from different VFMs to enhance downstream dense prediction tasks. However, naive multi-VFM fusion seldom leads to reliable gains, and interpretable principles for leveraging their complementary features are still underexplored. In this work, we propose a metric-guided approach that effectively selects and aggregates complementary features from different VFMs based on explicit assessment scores. Specifically, we design a suite of label-free metrics in feature space across two aspects, Structural Coherence and Edge Fidelity, to assess features of VFM encoders. Guided by these scores, we identify complementary edge-strong and structure-strong encoder pairs, and integrate them via a master-auxiliary fusion scheme. This feature fusion requires no complex architectural changes and is trained only in a single stage. Our model shows consistent performance gains across multiple dense prediction tasks compared with the baselines, with better object-level semantics and more accurately localized boundaries. The code is available at {https://github.com/gyc-code/metric-guided-fusion}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于度量的引导方法，通过无标签指标（结构一致性和边缘保真度）评估不同视觉基础模型（VFM）的特征，选择互补的编码器对进行主-辅融合，从而在密集预测任务中提升性能，无需复杂架构改动。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉基础模型在语义理解上表现出色，但在实例感知的密集预测任务中性能不足。不同VFM（如SAM2和DINOv3）在特征表示上存在互补偏差（边界细节 vs. 物体结构），但简单融合多个VFM往往效果不佳，且缺乏可解释的融合原则。
AI.method: 设计一套无标签度量指标（结构一致性Structural Coherence和边缘保真度Edge Fidelity），在特征空间中评估不同VFM编码器的表现；根据评分识别互补的边缘强和结构强编码器对；通过主-辅融合方案（master-auxiliary fusion）进行特征融合，仅需单阶段训练，无需复杂架构修改。
AI.result: 在多个密集预测任务上，该方法相比基线模型取得了一致的性能提升，在物体级语义和边界定位方面均表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 提出的度量引导融合策略能有效利用不同VFM的互补特征，是一种简单、可解释且有效的密集预测性能提升方法。

title: From Volume to Value: Preference-Aligned Memory Construction for On-Device RAG
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026. Code and data are available at https://github.com/UbiquitousAILab/EPIC
summary: With the rapid emergence of personal AI agents based on Large Language Models (LLMs), implementing them on-device has become essential for privacy and responsiveness. To handle the inherently personal and context-dependent nature of real-world requests, such agents must ground their generation in device-resident personal context. However, under tight memory budgets, the core bottleneck is what to store so that retrieval remains aligned with the user. We propose EPIC (Efficient Preference-aligned Index Construction), which focuses on user preferences as a compact and stable form of personal context and integrates them throughout the RAG pipeline. EPIC selectively retains preference-relevant information from raw data and aligns retrieval toward preference-aligned contexts. Across four benchmarks covering conversations, debates, explanations, and recommendations, EPIC reduces indexing memory by 2,404 times, improves preference-following accuracy by 20.17 percentage points, and achieves 33.33 times lower retrieval latency over the best-performing baseline. In our on-device experiment, EPIC maintains a memory footprint under 1 MB with 29.35 ms/query latency in streaming updates.

AI.tldr: EPIC是一种高效的个人化索引构建方法，通过聚焦用户偏好作为核心上下文，在RAG管道中整合偏好信息，实现索引内存减少2404倍、偏好遵循准确率提升20.17个百分点、检索延迟降低33.33倍，且设备端内存低于1MB。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的个人AI代理需要部署在设备端以保证隐私和响应速度，但内存预算紧张。核心瓶颈在于如何存储内容使得检索与用户偏好保持一致，因此需要一种高效且偏好对齐的索引构建方法。
AI.method: EPIC聚焦用户偏好作为紧凑且稳定的个人上下文形式，在RAG全流程中整合偏好信息：从原始数据中选择性保留偏好相关信息，并将检索过程对齐到用户偏好的上下文。
AI.result: 在对话、辩论、解释、推荐四个基准上，EPIC将索引内存减少2404倍，偏好遵循准确率提升20.17个百分点，检索延迟降低33.33倍。在设备端实验中，内存占用低于1MB，流式更新延迟仅29.35ms/query。
AI.conclusion: EPIC通过以用户偏好为核心构建索引，在极低内存占用下实现了显著的性能和效率提升，为设备端个人AI代理的落地提供了有效方案。

title: Accelerating AI-Powered Research: The PuppyChatter Framework for Usable and Flexible Tooling
summary: This research addresses the challenges inherent in developing Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications, particularly those leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs). While AI vendors provide Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and Software Development Kits (SDKs) to facilitate developer interaction, the former often requires intricate manual request construction, and the latter can lead to significant vendor lock-in. Furthermore, existing model abstraction frameworks, though mitigating vendor dependency, introduce an additional layer of complexity and potential security concerns. To reconcile these conflicting factors, the study introduces PuppyChatter, a novel software framework designed to preserve the intuitive simplicity of vendor-specific SDKs while simultaneously adhering to the vendor-neutrality principles characteristic of model abstraction, thereby offering a more streamlined and flexible development paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PuppyChatter框架，在保持厂商SDK易用性的同时实现厂商中立性，解决了AI开发中API构建复杂、SDK锁定和抽象框架冗余的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有AI开发方式存在矛盾：厂商SDK易用但导致供应商锁定；模型抽象框架可解耦但增加复杂性和安全风险。亟需一种兼顾易用性与中立性的新方案。
AI.method: 提出PuppyChatter软件框架，融合厂商SDK的直观简易性与模型抽象的厂商中立原则，提供更简化和灵活的AI开发范式。
AI.result: PuppyChatter框架成功实现了简化开发流程与避免供应商锁定的双重目标，为LLM应用开发提供了更优方案。
AI.conclusion: PuppyChatter有效调和了AI开发中易用性与厂商中立性之间的矛盾，为未来AI应用开发提供了一种更平衡、更高效的新范式。

title: HAD: Hallucination-Aware Diffusion Priors for 3D Reconstruction
summary: Diffusion priors have recently demonstrated strong capability in enhancing the quality of sparse-view 3D reconstruction by augmenting training views at novel viewpoints, but they inevitably introduce hallucinated content -- artifacts inconsistent with the input views -- into the final 3D model. To address this challenge, we propose Hallucination-Aware Diffusion prior (HAD), which estimates pixel-wise hallucination score maps for augmented images by leveraging multi-view reasoning capabilities from a feedforward novel view synthesis (NVS) network pre-trained on large-scale 3D data. These hallucination scores enable selective masking of unreliable pixels during the progressive 3D reconstruction procedure, preventing the introduction of non-existent artifacts into the 3D model. To further enhance performance, we create multiple versions of augmented images at each novel view by conditioning the diffusion prior on different input views, which are then fused into a final image that leverages the broader context across all input views. We show that our method substantially reduces hallucination artifacts in diffusion-assisted 3D reconstruction, thereby achieving state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks on novel view synthesis. Our project are publicly available at \href{https://xiliu8006.github.io/HAD-Project-website/}{project website}.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种幻觉感知扩散先验（HAD），通过估计像素级幻觉得分图来抑制扩散模型在稀疏视图3D重建中引入的伪影，实现了最先进的新视角合成性能。
AI.motivation: 扩散先验在稀疏视图3D重建中增强新视角图像质量时，会不可避免地引入与输入视图不一致的幻觉内容（伪影），影响最终3D模型的准确性。
AI.method: 1) 利用前馈新视角合成网络预训练的跨视图推理能力，估计增强图像的像素级幻觉得分图；2) 利用幻觉得分在渐进式3D重构过程中选择性屏蔽不可靠像素；3) 对同一新视角生成多版本增强图像（基于不同输入视图条件），融合后利用所有输入视图的全局上下文。
AI.result: 在多个新视角合成基准上实现了最先进的性能，显著减少了扩散辅助3D重建中的幻觉伪影。
AI.conclusion: HAD方法有效抑制了扩散先验引入的幻觉伪影，提升了3D重建的保真度。

title: Infini-News: Efficiently Queryable Access to 1.3 Billion Processed Common Crawl News Articles
summary: Large-scale news corpora support a wide range of research in Computational Social Science and NLP, yet access remains constrained: commercial archives impose prohibitive costs and licensing restrictions, while open alternatives like Common Crawl's CC-News require terabyte-scale storage and computationally intensive processing. We present Infini-News, a retrieval toolkit and index for the entire CC-News archive from August 2016 to the latest available snapshot. Our contributions are threefold. First, we extract, clean the text, and parse the structured metadata of over 1.35B articles. Second, we enrich the corpus with language detection using three frontier language classifiers (GlotLID, lingua, and CommonLingua), and with multi-source geographic attribution that resolves a country of origin for 83.4% of articles across 222 countries. Third, we construct Infini-gram indexes: suffix-array structures that let researchers search the full archive for arbitrary text patterns in sub-second time. Together, these resources lower the barrier to longitudinal, cross-national media research.

AI.tldr: Infini-News 是一个面向 CC-News 档案的检索工具包和索引，包含超过 13.5 亿篇文章，支持快速文本模式搜索、语言检测和地理归因，旨在降低大规模新闻语料库的访问门槛。
AI.motivation: 现有大型新闻语料库（如 CC-News）虽然开放，但需要 TB 级存储和大量计算资源；商业档案则成本高昂且存在许可限制，阻碍了计算社会科学和 NLP 研究。
AI.method: 从 2016 年至今的 CC-News 快照中提取、清洗并解析了超 13.5 亿篇文章的元数据；使用 GlotLID、lingua 和 CommonLingua 三种前沿语言分类器进行语言检测；通过多源地理归因方法为 83.4% 的文章标出来源国（覆盖 222 个国家）；构建 Infini-gram 后缀数组索引，支持亚秒级任意文本模式搜索。
AI.result: 构建了包含 13.5 亿篇文章的索引，语言覆盖广泛，83.4% 的文章成功归因到 222 个国家，文本搜索可在亚秒级内完成。
AI.conclusion: Infini-News 大幅降低了纵贯性、跨国家媒体研究的数据获取和计算门槛，为计算社会科学和 NLP 领域提供了高效易用的资源。

title: Zero-Shot Faithful Textual Explanations via Directional-Derivative Influence on Predictions
summary: Zero-shot textual explanations aim to make image classifiers more transparent by probing their internal representations, without relying on task-specific supervision or LVLMs. However, existing methods often miss the features that truly drive the prediction, resulting in limited \textit{faithfulness} to the evidence underlying the model's decision. To address this, we propose FaithTrace. Motivated by the idea that faithful explanations should describe concepts that strongly influence the prediction, FaithTrace directly measures how much the representation induced by the explanation changes the class logit. We introduce an influence score, computed as the directional derivative of the class logit along the text-induced direction in the classifier's feature space, and use it as a proxy for faithfulness. Moreover, we extend this influence score into quantitative evaluation metrics, helping fill the gap in faithfulness evaluation for textual explanations. Experiments show that FaithTrace yields more faithful explanations than baselines, facilitating a more accurate understanding of the model. The code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出FaithTrace方法，通过计算文本诱导方向上的类别对数导数的方向导数作为影响分数，生成更忠实于分类器决策的零样本文本解释。
AI.motivation: 现有零样本文本解释方法常忽略驱动模型预测的真正特征，导致解释与模型决策证据之间的忠实度有限。
AI.method: 提出FaithTrace，核心是引入影响分数——计算类别对数在分类器特征空间中沿文本诱导方向的方向导数，直接衡量解释所诱导的表征对类别对数的改变程度。
AI.result: 实验表明FaithTrace生成的解释比基线方法更忠实于模型决策，能更准确地理解模型。
AI.conclusion: FaithTrace通过直接度量文本解释对模型决策的影响来提升忠实度，并为文本解释的忠实度评估提供了定量指标。

title: Presupposition and Reasoning in Conditionals: A Theory-Based Study of Humans and LLMs
comment: To appear in the Proceedings of CoNLL 2026, colocated with ACL 2026
summary: Presupposition projection in conditionals is central to theories of meaning and pragmatics, yet it remains largely unevaluated in large language models. We address this gap through a parallel behavioral study comparing human judgments and LLM predictions on a normed dataset of conditional sentences that controls the relation between the antecedent and the projected presupposition. We collect likelihood ratings from 120 participants and four LLMs under matched contextual conditions. Results show that humans integrate probabilistic and pragmatic cues in their judgment, whereas LLMs show variable alignment with human patterns. Using a linguistically motivated checklist within an LLM-as-a-Judge framework, we further evaluate model reasoning. We observe models that best match human ratings often lack coherent pragmatic reasoning, while models with stronger reasoning produce less human-like judgments. These findings suggest that LLMs' performance on such tasks may result from surface pattern matching rather than pragmatic competence. Our findings highlight the importance of benchmarks grounded in linguistic theory for comparing humans and models.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过行为实验对比人类与LLM对条件句中预设投射的判断，发现LLM的表面模式匹配能力与人类语用推理存在显著差异。
AI.motivation: 条件句中的预设投射是语义与语用理论的核心问题，但大语言模型在这一任务上的表现尚未得到系统评估，缺乏人机对比的行为证据。
AI.method: 在控制前件与投射预设关系的规范化条件句数据集上，收集120名人类被试和4种LLM的概率评分，并采用LLM-as-a-Judge框架结合语言学启发的检查清单评估模型推理。
AI.result: 人类判断整合了概率和语用线索，而LLM与人类模式的对齐程度不一；与人类评分最匹配的模型往往缺乏连贯的语用推理，而推理能力更强的模型反而产生更不类人的判断。
AI.conclusion: LLM在预设投射任务上的表现可能源于表面模式匹配而非真正的语用能力，强调构建基于语言学理论的基准对比较人机差异的重要性。

title: Interactive Evaluation Requires a Design Science
summary: AI evaluation is undergoing a structural change. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as systems that act over time through tools, environments, users, and other agents, while many evaluation practices still inherit assumptions from response-centered benchmarks (e.g., fixed inputs, isolated outputs, and outcome judgments that can be made from a single response). The field has begun to build interactive benchmarks, but the resulting landscape is fragmented: benchmarks differ in what interaction artifacts they admit, how trajectories are scored, and what claims their results support. This position paper argues that interactive evaluation should be treated as a principled evaluation paradigm, not merely a new family of agent benchmarks. Simply adopting previous evaluation paradigms does not suffice. We define evaluation as an autonomous mapping from evidence to judgments, and show that interactive evaluation changes both sides of this mapping: the evidence becomes interaction-generated trajectories, while the evaluation procedure must assess process, recoverability, coordination, robustness, and system-level performance. Building on this definition, we propose a two-axis taxonomy, derive design principles and reporting standards, examine representative scenarios, and analyze how longstanding evaluation challenges reappear at the trajectory level.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将交互式评估视为一种独立的评估范式，而非仅仅是一类新的智能体基准测试。论文定义了评估是从证据到判断的自主映射，并论证了交互式评估改变了这一映射的两端：证据变为交互生成的轨迹，评估流程需评估过程、可恢复性、协调性、鲁棒性和系统级性能。基于此，提出两轴分类法、设计原则和报告标准。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM评估正从静态响应式基准转向交互式基准，但现有实践碎片化严重：不同基准采用的交互工件、轨迹评分方式和结果支撑的论断各不相同。论文认为，简单沿用传统评估范式不足以应对交互式系统的评估需求，需要将交互式评估视为独立范式。
AI.method: 首先定义评估为从证据到判断的自主映射；然后分析交互式评估如何改变证据（变为交互轨迹）和判断（需评估过程、可恢复性、协调性、鲁棒性、系统性能）两端；在此基础上提出两轴分类法，推导设计原则和报告标准，并分析代表性场景。
AI.result: 提出了一个结构化的交互式评估框架：包含明确评估定义、两轴分类法、设计原则和报告标准，并分析了长时间存在的评估挑战如何在轨迹层面重新出现。
AI.conclusion: 交互式评估应当被当作一个原则性的评估范式，而非仅仅是新的基准测试类别。现有评估实践不足以应对这一转变，需要基于所提出的框架进行系统性重构。

title: Towards Generalized Image Manipulation Localization via Score-based Model
summary: With the rapid evolution of synthetic media, Image Manipulation Localization (IML) has emerged as a critical component in multimedia forensics for ensuring the integrity of digital content. However, generalization remains a core challenge, as existing discriminative methods typically learn a fixed decision boundary that tends to overfit to specific training artifacts and fails to adapt to unseen manipulation types. To address this, we propose DiffIML, a novel framework that introduces score-based generative modeling to IML. Diverging from the direct estimation of hard boundaries, DiffIML approximates the score function, the gradient of the log-likelihood, to capture the intrinsic geometric topology of mask distributions. This paradigm leverages structural priors to iteratively recover coherent masks from noise, thereby circumventing the brittleness associated with discriminative models. Under this formulation, diffusion models serve as an effective numerical solver for the learned score function.To ensure practicality, we respectively resolve the efficiency and stability bottlenecks of standard diffusion by: (1) utilizing a Lightweight Mask-Specific VAE for fast latent-space process and a decoupled architecture with a lightweight denoising UNet, (2) edge supervision and error prior to mitigate error accumulation during sampling. Extensive experiments of two distinct protocols on eight non-generative and three generative benchmarks demonstrate that DiffIML consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, yielding remarkable generalization improvements on diverse unseen datasets. The code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: DiffIML框架将基于得分的生成式建模引入图像篡改定位任务，通过近似得分函数捕获掩码分布的几何拓扑结构，并采用轻量级VAE、解耦架构和边缘监督等技术解决效率和稳定性问题，在多个非生成式和生成式基准上显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有判别式图像篡改定位方法学习固定的决策边界，容易过拟合训练数据中的特定伪影，难以泛化到未见过的篡改类型。作者希望通过引入生成式建模来克服这一泛化瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出DiffIML框架：1) 利用得分函数近似（对数似然的梯度）替代直接估计硬边界，捕获掩码分布的内在几何拓扑；2) 采用扩散模型作为得分函数的数值求解器；3) 使用轻量级掩码专用VAE实现快速潜空间处理；4) 采用解耦架构配合轻量级去噪UNet；5) 引入边缘监督和错误先验来缓解采样过程中的误差累积。
AI.result: 在八种非生成式和三种生成式基准上，按照两种不同协议进行实验，DiffIML一致性地优于现有最先进方法，在多种未见过的数据集上展现出色的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于得分的生成式建模范式能够有效替代传统判别式方法，显著提升图像篡改定位的泛化能力，为多媒体取证领域提供了新的方向。

title: SkillsVote: Lifecycle Governance of Agent Skills from Collection, Recommendation to Evolution
summary: Long-horizon LLM agents leave traces that could become reusable experience, but raw trajectories are noisy and hard to govern. We treat Agent Skills as an experience schema that couples executable scripts, with non-executable guidance on procedures. Yet open skill ecosystems contain redundant, uneven, environment-sensitive artifacts, and indiscriminate updates can pollute future context. We present SkillsVote, a lifecycle-governance framework for Agent Skills from collection and recommendation to evolution. SkillsVote profiles a million-scale open-source corpus for environment requirements, quality, and verifiability, then synthesizes tasks for verifiable skills. Before execution, SkillsVote performs agentic library search over structured skill library to expose instructional skill context. After execution, it decomposes trajectories into skill-linked subtasks, attributes outcomes to skill use, agent exploration, environment, and result signals, and admits only successful reusable discoveries to evidence-gated updates. In our evaluation, offline evolution improves GPT-5.2 on Terminal-Bench 2.0 by up to 7.9 pp, while online evolution improves SWE-Bench Pro by up to 2.6 pp. Overall, governed external skill libraries can improve frozen agents without model updates when systems control exposure, credit, and preservation.

AI.tldr: SkillsVote是一个生命周期治理框架，用于管理LLM代理技能库，通过结构化收集、推荐和演化机制，在无需更新模型的情况下提升冻结代理的性能。
AI.motivation: 长程LLM代理留下的轨迹包含可复用经验，但原始轨迹噪声大且难以管理。现有开源技能生态中存在冗余、质量不均、环境敏感等问题，不加区分地更新会污染未来上下文。
AI.method: 提出SkillsVote框架：1) 分析百万级开源语料，评估环境需求、质量和可验证性；2) 合成可验证技能的任务；3) 执行前通过结构化技能库进行智能检索；4) 执行后将轨迹分解为技能关联子任务，归因结果信号，仅采纳成功且可复现的发现用于证据门控更新。
AI.result: 离线演化在Terminal-Bench 2.0上提升GPT-5.2最多7.9个百分点；在线演化在SWE-Bench Pro上提升最多2.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 受治理的外部技能库可以在不更新模型的情况下提升冻结代理的性能，前提是系统能控制技能暴露、信用分配和持久化保存。

title: Remembering More, Risking More: Longitudinal Safety Risks in Memory-Equipped LLM Agents
summary: Safety evaluations of memory-equipped LLM agents typically measure within-task safety: whether an agent completes a single scenario safely, often under adversarial conditions such as prompt injection or memory poisoning. In deployment, however, a single agent serves many independent tasks over a long horizon, and memory accumulated during earlier tasks can affect behavior on later, unrelated ones. Studying this regime requires evaluation along the temporal dimension across tasks: not whether an agent is safe at any single memory state, but how its safety profile changes as memory accumulates across many independent interactions. We call this failure mode temporal memory contamination. To isolate memory exposure from stream non-stationarity, we introduce a trigger-probe protocol that evaluates a fixed probe set against read-only memory snapshots at varying prefix lengths, together with a NullMemory counterfactual baseline for identifying memory-induced violations. We apply this protocol across three deployment scenarios spanning records, memos, forms, and email correspondence and eight memory architectures, and additionally on Claw-like AI agents, such as OpenClaw, using the platform's native memory mechanism. Memory-enabled agents consistently exceed the NullMemory baseline, and memory-induced violation rates show a robust upward trend with exposure length on both agent classes. Order-randomization experiments indicate that the effect is driven primarily by accumulated content rather than encounter order. Finally, a structural consequence of the event decomposition is that memory-induced risk is detectable from retrieval state before generation, which we confirm with a high-recall diagnostic monitor. Our results argue for treating memory safety as a longitudinal property that requires temporal evaluation, not a single-state property that can be captured by a snapshot.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了配备记忆功能的大语言模型智能体在跨任务时间维度上的安全隐患，发现随着记忆累积，安全违规率呈上升趋势，并提出了一种触发-探测协议来评估这一"时间记忆污染"现象。
AI.motivation: 现有安全评估通常只测量单次任务内的安全性，忽略了智能体在长期部署中，先前任务积累的记忆可能影响后续无关任务行为的安全隐患。
AI.method: 提出触发-探测协议，使用固定探测集对不同前缀长度的只读记忆快照进行评估，并引入NullMemory反事实基线来识别记忆引发的违规行为。在多个部署场景和八种记忆架构上进行了实验。
AI.result: 启用记忆的智能体始终超过NullMemory基线，记忆引发的违规率随暴露长度呈稳健上升趋势。顺序随机化实验表明该效应主要由累积内容驱动，而非遭遇顺序。
AI.conclusion: 记忆安全应被视为一种纵向属性，需要跨时间维度的评估，而非单状态属性。记忆引发的风险在生成前即可从检索状态中检测到。

title: Mind the Gap: Learning Modality-Agnostic Representations with a Cross-Modality UNet
comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Image Processing. See full abstract in the PDF file
summary: Cross-modality recognition has many important applications in science, law enforcement and entertainment. Popular methods to bridge the modality gap include reducing the distributional differences of representations of different modalities, learning indistinguishable representations or explicit modality transfer. The first two approaches suffer from the loss of discriminant information while removing the modality-specific variations. The third one heavily relies on the successful modality transfer, could face catastrophic performance drop when explicit modality transfers are not possible or difficult. To tackle this problem, we proposed a compact encoder-decoder neural module (cmUNet) to learn modality-agnostic representations while retaining identity-related information. This is achieved through cross-modality transformation and in-modality reconstruction, enhanced by an adversarial/perceptual loss which encourages indistinguishability of representations in the original sample space. For cross-modality matching, we propose MarrNet where cmUNet is connected to a standard feature extraction network which takes as inputs the modality-agnostic representations and outputs similarity scores for matching. We validated our method on five challenging tasks, namely Raman-infrared spectrum matching, cross-modality person re-identification and heterogeneous (photo-sketch, visible-near infrared and visible-thermal) face recognition, where MarrNet showed superior performance compared to state-of-the-art methods. Furthermore, it is observed that a cross-modality matching method could be biased to extract discriminant information from partial or even wrong regions, due to incompetence of dealing with modality gaps, which subsequently leads to poor generalization. We show that robustness to occlusions can be an indicator of whether a method can well bridge the modality gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种紧凑的编码器-解码器神经模块（cmUNet），通过跨模态变换和模态内重构学习模态无关且保留身份信息的表征，并在此基础上构建MarrNet进行跨模态匹配，在多个任务上取得了优于现有方法的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有跨模态识别方法存在判别信息丢失或依赖显式模态转换导致性能下降的问题，亟需一种既能消除模态差异又能保留身份判别信息的方法。
AI.method: 提出cmUNet模块，通过跨模态变换和模态内重构学习模态无关表征，并结合对抗/感知损失增强表征的不可区分性；将cmUNet连接到标准特征提取网络构建MarrNet进行跨模态匹配。
AI.result: 在拉曼-红外光谱匹配、跨模态行人重识别及异质人脸识别（照片-素描、可见光-近红外、可见光-热成像）五个任务上，MarrNet均优于现有方法，并发现对遮挡的鲁棒性可作为衡量跨模态方法能力的指标。
AI.conclusion: cmUNet能有效桥接模态间隙并保留判别信息，MarrNet在多个跨模态任务中表现优异，遮挡鲁棒性可作为评估跨模态方法性能的指示器。

title: EvoMemBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory from a Self-Evolving Perspective
summary: Recent benchmarks for Large Language Model (LLM) agents mainly evaluate reasoning, planning, and execution. However, memory is also essential for agents, as it enables them to store, update, and retrieve information over time. This ability remains under-evaluated, largely because existing benchmarks do not provide a systematic way to assess memory mechanisms. In this paper, we study agent memory from a self-evolving perspective and introduce EvoMemBench, a unified benchmark organized along two axes: memory scope (in-episode vs. cross-episode) and memory content (knowledge-oriented vs. execution-oriented). We compare 15 representative memory methods with strong long-context baselines under a standardized protocol. Results show that current memory systems are still far from a general solution: long-context baselines remain highly competitive, memory helps most when the current context is insufficient or tasks are difficult, and no single memory form works consistently across all settings. Retrieval-based methods remain strong for knowledge-intensive settings, whereas procedural and long-term memory methods are more effective for execution-oriented tasks when their stored experience matches the task structure. We hope EvoMemBench facilitates future research on more effective memory systems for LLM-based agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/DSAIL-Memory/EvoMemBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvoMemBench，一个从自我演化视角评估LLM智能体记忆的统一基准，发现当前记忆系统远未达到通用解决方案，长上下文基线仍具竞争力，不同记忆形式在不同场景下各有优劣。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体基准主要评估推理、规划和执行能力，但记忆作为智能体存储、更新和检索信息的关键能力却缺乏系统性评估，存在评估空白。
AI.method: 从自我演化视角构建EvoMemBench，沿记忆范围（情节内vs跨情节）和记忆内容（知识导向vs执行导向）两个轴组织，在标准化协议下比较15种代表性记忆方法与强长上下文基线。
AI.result: 当前记忆系统远非通用解决方案；长上下文基线仍具竞争力；记忆在当前上下文不足或任务困难时帮助最大；没有一种记忆形式在所有设置中一致有效；检索方法在知识密集型场景强，程序性和长期记忆方法在执行导向任务中更有效（当存储经验匹配任务结构时）。
AI.conclusion: EvoMemBench可为未来更有效的LLM智能体记忆系统研究提供参考。

title: KISS - Knowledge Infrastructure for Scientific Simulation: A Scaffolding for Agentic Earth Science
summary: Process-based simulation models encode decades of scientific understanding across the Earth sciences, yet the communities most exposed to climate risk and resource scarcity are the least able to use them. Here, we introduce knowledge infrastructure (KI), an agent-actionable scaffold that externalizes expertise into validated modelling operators, staged domain protocols, and diagnostic recovery mechanisms. Across a 3,000-trial coupled-hydrology benchmark, agents equipped with KI produced physically plausible, verifiable end-to-end simulations in up to 84% of trials, while agents without KI plateaued below 40%. KI generalizes across disciplines. We packaged its construction into a Knowledge Dissection Toolkit (KDT) that autonomously produced KI enabling end-to-end agent execution of 117 additional process-based models across 14 Earth-science domains. Across all 119 KIs, modelling decisions and failure remedies converged despite different underlying physics, showing that operational expertise is structured and extractable rather than ad hoc. Demonstrations show KI-equipped agents lowering both the access barrier between non-specialist users and process-based simulation, and the integration barrier between modelling communities. Through this scaffold, process-based science can then evolve as a living scientific commons, answerable to whoever needs to know and extendable by whoever can contribute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出知识基础设施（KI）框架，使AI代理能够像专家一样执行基于过程的仿真模型。实验表明，配备KI的代理在耦合水文基准测试中成功率达84%（无KI者低于40%），并进一步开发了知识剖析工具包（KDT），自主为117个地球科学模型生成KI，显著降低了非专家使用仿真模型的门槛。
AI.motivation: 基于过程的仿真模型蕴含着数十年的科学理解，但最需要它们应对气候风险和资源短缺的群体却最难使用这些模型。现有方法缺乏将专业操作知识结构化并赋予AI代理的有效途径。
AI.method: 提出知识基础设施（KI）概念，将专家知识外化为三类组件：已验证的建模算子、分阶段领域协议、诊断恢复机制。进一步开发知识剖析工具包（KDT），可自主为任意过程模型生成KI。
AI.result: 在3000次耦合水文基准测试中，KI代理成功率84%（无KI代理低于40%）；KDT成功为117个额外模型生成KI，覆盖14个地球科学领域；不同物理领域的KI在建模决策和故障修复上呈现收敛性。
AI.conclusion: KI框架证明领域操作知识是可结构化和可提取的，而非零散的经验。该方案有望降低仿真模型的使用门槛和跨学科集成壁垒，推动基于过程的科学成为活的、可扩展的科学公共资源。

title: Controlling Decision Drift in Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Missing Modalities
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis relies on textual, acoustic, and visual signals, yet real-world data often suffer from modality missing and quality imbalance. Existing methods generate features for modality missing from available ones, but differences in expression mechanisms and sentiment dynamics across modalities may cause the generated features to deviate from true distributions and mislead prediction. In addition, unreliable modalities may dominate fusion, resulting in representation shift across modality combinations and unstable sentiment representations. To address these challenges, we propose a two-level reference alignment framework. The framework introduces stable references at the feature representation and sentiment decision levels to improve robustness under modality missing. First-level reference alignment leverages complete-modality samples to constrain representations and align different modality combinations into a shared sentiment space. Second-level reference alignment enforces cross-modal consistency at the decision level by suppressing unreliable modalities through prototype retrieval and voting. As a result, the framework maintains stable and reliable sentiment predictions under diverse missing-modality patterns. Experiments on CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI show consistent improvements across various missing-modality settings. Under full-modality input, the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance, with ACC of 86.28% and 85.88%, and F1 of 86.24% and 85.86%.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种两层级参考对齐框架，通过特征表示和情感决策两个层面的稳定参考，解决多模态情感分析中模态缺失和质量不平衡问题，在CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI上取得了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 真实多模态数据常存在模态缺失和质量不平衡问题，现有生成方法因跨模态表达机制和情感动态差异导致生成特征偏离真实分布，且不可靠模态在融合中占主导导致表示偏移。
AI.method: 提出两层级参考对齐框架：(1)第一层利用完整模态样本约束表示，将不同模态组合对齐到共享情感空间；(2)第二层通过原型检索和投票抑制不可靠模态，在决策层强制执行跨模态一致性。
AI.result: 在CMU-MOSI和CMU-MOSEI上，全模态输入下ACC分别达86.28%和85.88%，F1分别达86.24%和85.86%，在各种缺失模态设置下均有一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过两层级参考对齐有效提升了模态缺失下的鲁棒性，保持了稳定可靠的情感预测。

title: From BERT to T5: A Study of Named Entity Recognition
summary: Named entity recognition (NER) has been one of the essential preliminary steps in modern NLP applications. This report focuses on implementing the NER task on finetuning two pretrained models: (i) an encoder-only model (BERT) with a simple classification head, and (ii) a sequence-to-sequence model (T5) with few-shot prompts. Under the original 7-class tag and 3-class simplified tag schemes, BERT is applied a weighted cross-entropy for training loss, and T5 is fine-tuned with two validation strategies. It also conducted an ablation study with different hyperparameters. Moreover, the related analysis provides valuable insights into common errors in BERT and the two models' performance. Based on a bunch of performance metrics, this report aims to compare the above two architectures and explore their abilities in the sequence labelling task, laying the groundwork for further practical use cases.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在两种预训练模型（BERT和T5）上微调实现命名实体识别（NER）任务，比较了编码器模型与序列到序列模型在序列标注中的表现，并进行了超参数消融研究和错误分析。
AI.motivation: NER作为NLP应用中的关键预处理步骤，不同架构（编码器模型与序列到序列模型）在该任务上的能力对比尚需探索，为实际应用奠定基础。
AI.method: 使用BERT（编码器模型+分类头）和T5（序列到序列模型+少样本提示）进行微调；采用7类标签和3类简化标签方案；BERT使用加权交叉熵损失，T5使用两种验证策略；进行超参数消融研究。
AI.result: 通过多项性能指标对比两种架构在NER任务上的表现，并分析了BERT的常见错误类型及两种模型的能力差异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为NER任务中编码器模型与序列到序列模型的选择提供了对比依据，并为后续实际应用场景奠定了基础。

title: PAIR: Prefix-Aware Internal Reward Model for Multi-Turn Agent Optimization
summary: A significant hurdle for current LLMs is the execution of complex, multi-stage tasks. Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has been emerging as a leading choice, but its reliance on sparse outcome rewards severely limits credit assignment across intermediate steps. Existing remedies such as running full rollouts to assign step-level advantages, calling external LLM judges at each step, or computing intrinsic rewards that require ground-truth answers at every evaluation introduce significant costs or practical constraints. We hypothesize that internal correctness probing over LLM hidden states can be repurposed as a step-level reward signal, potentially addressing all of these limitations at once. However, existing probing research assumes clean inputs, and we first show that this assumption breaks down in multi-step settings: hidden-state probes degrade severely under prefix contamination tracking coherence with the (possibly corrupted) prefix rather than grounded correctness, while attention-based features remain robust to contamination but underperform on clean prefixes. Building on this complementary relationship, we propose the Prefix-Aware Internal Reward (PAIR), a two-stage model with a frozen hidden-state probe estimating belief-consistency and a lightweight attention-based head correcting it toward grounded correctness. Experimental results show that PAIR achieves the highest AUROC on contaminated trajectories while operating at negligible inference cost, enabling dense step-level reward signals for GRPO training without external model calls, ground-truth dependencies, or full-trajectory rollouts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAIR方法，利用LLM内部隐藏状态探测作为步骤级奖励信号，解决GRPO在多步任务中信用分配困难的问题，无需外部模型调用或完整轨迹回滚。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在执行复杂多步任务时面临困难，GRPO依赖稀疏结果奖励导致中间步骤信用分配受限，现有解决方案成本高或存在实际约束。
AI.method: 提出Prefix-Aware Internal Reward (PAIR)两阶段模型：冻结的隐藏状态探测器估计信念一致性，轻量级注意力头将其校正为基于事实的正确性。
AI.result: PAIR在受污染轨迹上取得最高AUROC，推理成本极低，可为GRPO训练提供密集步骤级奖励信号。
AI.conclusion: 无需外部模型调用、真实答案依赖或完整轨迹回滚，即可实现有效的步骤级信用分配。

title: Vector RAG vs LLM-Compiled Wiki: A Preregistered Comparison on a Small Multi-Domain Research
summary:
We preregistered a comparison of two ways to help an LLM answer questions over a small research corpus: a single-round Vector RAG system and an LLM-compiled markdown wiki. Both systems answered the same 13 questions over 24 papers using the same answer-generating model, and their answers were scored by blinded LLM judges.
  The wiki scored much better at connecting findings across papers, but its advantage in answer organization was not strong after judge adjustment. RAG met the preregistered test for single-fact lookup questions. The clean query-side cost result went against the expected wiki advantage: under the tested setup, the wiki used far more query tokens than RAG, so it could not recover any upfront build cost through cheaper queries.
  Two exploratory analyses changed how we interpret the result. First, claim-level citation checking favored the wiki: its cited pages more often supported the exact claims being made, even though RAG scored better on the overall groundedness rubric. Second, a decomposition-based RAG variant recovered most of the wiki's advantage on cross-paper synthesis at lower LLM-token cost, but it did not recover the wiki advantage in claim-by-claim citation support.
  The main conclusion is that grounded research synthesis is not a single capability. Systems can differ in how well they organize evidence, how well their citations support each claim, and how much they cost to run. In this study, no architecture was best on all three.

AI.tldr: 比较了单轮向量RAG和LLM编译的Markdown Wiki在小型研究文献库上的问答效果。Wiki在跨论文连接发现上表现更好，但成本更高；RAG在单事实查询上有优势。探索性分析发现两种系统在不同维度上各有优劣，没有一种架构在所有指标上同时最优。
AI.motivation: 探究在小型研究文献库上进行问答时，单轮向量RAG系统与LLM编译的Markdown Wiki系统在答案质量、引用准确性和运行成本上的差异，旨在理解不同检索增强架构的优缺点。
AI.method: 预注册对比实验：让RAG和Wiki两种系统分别回答相同的13个问题（基于24篇论文），使用相同的答案生成模型，并采用盲法LLM评分器对答案进行评分。此外进行了探索性分析，包括引用级检查和解耦式RAG变体实验。
AI.result: Wiki在跨论文连接发现上显著优于RAG，但在答案组织方面的优势经评分器校正后不显著；RAG在单事实查找问题上达到了预注册测试标准。成本方面，Wiki查询端token消耗远高于RAG，无法通过更便宜的查询回收前期构建成本。探索性分析显示，Wiki的引用支持更精确，而解耦式RAG变体在跨论文综合上接近Wiki但无法复现其引用优势。
AI.conclusion: 有依据的研究综合不是单一能力，系统在证据组织、引用支持和运行成本三个维度上表现各异，本研究中没有一种架构同时在这三方面表现最佳。

title: Evaluating Cognitive Age Alignment in Interactive AI Agents
summary: While agentic AI and its core multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable promise in language and visual reasoning across domains ranging from daily life to advanced scientific research, a profound gap remains between artificial and human intelligence. Despite the integration of powerful tools and advanced MLLMs, state-of-the-art AI agents frequently fail at foundational, seemingly simple tasks that a child can resolve with ease. Inspired by the Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children (WISC), we introduce ChildAgentEval, the first psychometrically grounded interactive benchmark for evaluating cognitive age alignment in MLLM-based agents. ChildAgentEval systematically compares the reasoning performance of various MLLM-based interactive agents against age-specific human developmental stages, exposing where current agentic AI systems can and cannot simulate age-specific cognitive behavior.

AI.tldr: ChildAgentEval是一个基于韦氏儿童智力量表(WISC)的心理测量学基准，用于评估多模态大模型(MLLM)驱动的AI代理在认知年龄对齐方面的表现，揭示当前AI代理在模拟特定年龄人类认知行为方面的能力与不足。
AI.motivation: 当前AI代理虽然在许多复杂任务上表现出色，但经常在儿童能轻松解决的简单任务上失败，这说明人工智能与人类智能之间存在显著差距，需要系统性的评估方法来衡量AI代理的认知发展水平。
AI.method: 受韦氏儿童智力量表(WISC)启发，提出了ChildAgentEval——首个心理测量学基础的交互式基准，通过将多种MLLM驱动的交互代理的推理表现与不同年龄阶段的人类发展水平进行系统比较，来评估其认知年龄对齐程度。
AI.result: 揭示了当前最先进的AI代理系统在模拟特定年龄认知行为方面的能力边界，指出了它们可以模拟以及无法模拟哪些年龄阶段的认知行为。
AI.conclusion: 现有的AI代理与人类智能之间在基础认知能力上存在显著差距，ChildAgentEval为量化这一差距提供了系统性的评估框架。

title: LASAR: Towards Spatio-temporal Reasoning with Latent Cognitive Map
summary: A fundamental challenge in embodied AI is verifying if agents build internal models of spatial structure or merely learn to mimic task-specific expert trajectories. This is critical as foundational approaches rooted in action-centric tasks (e.g., VLN) and reasoning-centric tasks (e.g., EQA) often share a common limitation: they lack a learning signal that forces them to encode fine-grained spatial relationships (like topology or distance) over long-range, fragmented experiences. To address this, we first propose LASAR, an architecture featuring a dual-memory system designed to maintain both episodic experiences and a semantic cognitive map. We then introduce Spatio-temporal Contextual Representation Learning (ST-CRL), a contrastive objective designed to train this architecture. ST-CRL leverages spatio-temporal cues from cognitive queries generated through annotated spatio-temporal context in simulation to build sample pairs, thereby forming the internal cognitive map from the agent's experiences. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves 2\%-3.5\% gains in both zero-shot generalization on standard VLN-CE and VSI-Bench benchmarks. We also demonstrate that our proposed cognitive map has high self-consistency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LASAR架构（双记忆系统）和ST-CRL对比学习目标，用于增强具身AI智能体对空间结构的内在认知建模，在VLN-CE和VSI-Bench任务上取得2%-3.5%的零样本泛化提升，并展示了认知地图的高自一致性。
AI.motivation: 具身AI中的智能体往往只是模仿专家轨迹，而非真正构建空间结构的内在模型。现有方法（如VLN和EQA）缺乏迫使智能体编码细粒度空间关系（如拓扑或距离）的学习信号。
AI.method: 提出LASAR架构（双记忆系统：情境记忆+语义认知地图），以及ST-CRL（时空上下文表示学习）对比学习目标，利用模拟环境中带注释的时空上下文生成认知查询来构建样本对，训练智能体形成内在认知地图。
AI.result: 在VLN-CE和VSI-Bench基准上，零样本泛化性能提升2%-3.5%，且认知地图具有高自一致性。
AI.conclusion: 通过双记忆系统和时空上下文对比学习，可以有效促使智能体建立对空间结构的内在认知模型，从而提升具身AI任务的泛化能力。

title: Implicit Hierarchical GRPO: Decoupling Tool Invocation from Execution for Tool-Integrated Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have increasingly leveraged tool invocation to enhance their reasoning capabilities. However, existing approaches typically tightly couple tool invocation with immediate execution. Such immediate tool interaction may disrupt the reasoning coherence of LLMs and constrain their expressivity, ultimately degrading reasoning performance. To this end, for the first time, we propose and formalize the problem of decoupling tool invocation from execution during reasoning, and introduce delayed execution with explicit control to enhance tool-integrated reasoning (TIR). Furthermore, we propose a hierarchical control framework and theoretically derive a surrogate loss that enables an implicitly hierarchical policy to learn behavior equivalent to that of an explicit hierarchical policy, leading to the proposed IH-GRPO algorithm. Extensive experiments on IH-GRPO achieve absolute improvements of 1.87\%, 2.16\%, and 2.53\% on Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-8B across six out-of-domain mathematical reasoning benchmarks over the strongest baseline method, while also yielding consistent performance gains in other domains. Our code is available at https://github.com/Lumina04/IH-GRPO-01.

AI.tldr: 本文提出解耦工具调用与执行的延迟执行策略，并设计隐式分层策略IH-GRPO算法，在多个数学推理基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将工具调用与立即执行紧密耦合，这会打断LLM的推理连贯性并限制其表达能力，从而降低推理性能。
AI.method: 提出延迟执行与显式控制的工具集成推理（TIR）框架；设计分层控制框架，推导替代损失函数使隐式分层策略学习等价于显式分层策略的行为，提出IH-GRPO算法。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B模型上，跨6个域外数学推理基准，较最强基线分别提升1.87%、2.16%、2.53%，并在其他领域也取得一致性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 解耦工具调用与执行能有效提升LLM推理性能，IH-GRPO是一种通用的增强工具集成推理的有效方法。

title: DuIVRS-2: An LLM-based Interactive Voice Response System for Large-scale POI Attribute Acquisition
comment: Accepted to ACL 2026 Industry Track. 14 pages, including appendix
summary: Accurate Point of Interest (POI) attribute acquisition is essential for location-based services, yet traditional modular Interactive Voice Response (IVR) systems suffer from error accumulation and high maintenance overhead. We present DuIVRS-2, a large language model (LLM)-based end-to-end framework designed for large-scale POI attribute acquisition at Baidu Maps. To address the long-tail distribution of real-world interactions, our methodology first employs a finite state machine (FSM)-guided data augmentation strategy to synthesize a balanced and diverse training dataset. We then streamline dialogue management via a selective generation scheme combined with a Chain-of-Thought (CoT) mechanism, which ensures output stability and effectively eliminates hallucinations in industrial settings. To facilitate continuous policy refinement with minimal manual effort, we design a cooperative iterative learning framework that leverages a dual-evaluator voting system. Deployed in production for two months, DuIVRS-2 processed 0.4 million calls daily and achieved a 83.9\% Task Success Rate (TSR), outperforming its predecessor by 4 percentage points while maintaining a low reaction time of 130ms. This work provides a production-proven reference for developing robust, cost-effective LLM agents for large-scale industrial dialogue applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DuIVRS-2，一种基于大语言模型的端到端框架，用于百度地图的大规模POI属性采集。通过FSM数据增强、选择性生成+CoT机制以及双评估器迭代学习框架，在生产环境中日处理40万通电话，任务成功率83.9%，相比前代提升4个百分点，反应时间仅130ms。
AI.motivation: 传统模块化IVR系统存在错误累积和维护成本高的问题，且真实交互数据呈长尾分布，亟需一种鲁棒、低成本的大规模工业级对话解决方案。
AI.method: 1) FSM引导的数据增强策略合成平衡多样化的训练数据集；2) 选择性生成方案结合Chain-of-Thought机制确保输出稳定性并消除幻觉；3) 双评估器投票的协作迭代学习框架，实现最小人工干预下的持续策略优化。
AI.result: 生产部署两个月，日处理40万通电话，任务成功率83.9%，相比前代提升4个百分点，反应时间130ms。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为构建鲁棒、高性价比的大规模工业级LLM对话应用提供了经过生产验证的参考方案。

title: CAR-SAM: Cross-Attention Reconstruction for Post-Training Quantization of the Segment Anything Model
summary: Segment Anything Models (SAMs) are extensively used in computer vision for universal image segmentation, but deploying them on resource-constrained devices is challenging due to their high computational and memory demands. Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) is a widely used technique for model compression and acceleration. However, existing PTQ methods fail to consider the cross-attention architecture in the SAM decoder. This degradation primarily stems from the unique challenges posed by SAMs: (1) Attention dissipation, where the attention information in the decoder, which is crucial for representing segmentation masks, collapses into a diffuse and non-semantic form under low-bit quantization; and (2) Reconstruction oscillation, where bidirectional coupling within the two-way transformer introduces cross-branch error interference and destabilizes convergence. To tackle these issues, we propose CAR-SAM, a unified quantization framework tailored for SAMs. Firstly, to mitigate attention dissipation, we introduce MatMul-Aware Compensation (MAC) mechanism that transfers activation-induced quantization errors from MatMul to preceding linear weights. Secondly, to mitigate oscillation in decoder optimization, we develop a Joint Cross-Attention Reconstruction (JCAR) strategy that jointly reconstructs coupled attention branches, suppressing oscillatory behavior and promoting stable convergence. Extensive experiments show that CAR-SAM robustly quantizes SAM models down to 4-bit precision, surpassing existing methods by 14.6% and 6.6% mAP on SAM-B and SAM-L respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出了CAR-SAM量化框架，通过MatMul感知补偿和联合交叉注意力重建策略，解决了SAM模型在低比特量化下的注意力消散和重建振荡问题，在4-bit精度下显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: SAM模型在资源受限设备上部署困难，现有PTQ方法未考虑SAM解码器中的交叉注意力架构，导致低比特量化时性能严重下降。
AI.method: 提出CAR-SAM统一量化框架，包含两个核心机制：(1) MatMul感知补偿(MAC)，将MatMul引起的激活量化误差转移到前序线性权重；(2) 联合交叉注意力重建(JCAR)，联合重建耦合的注意力分支以抑制振荡。
AI.result: 将SAM模型量化至4-bit精度，在SAM-B和SAM-L上分别比现有方法提升14.6%和6.6% mAP。
AI.conclusion: CAR-SAM有效解决了SAM在低比特量化下的特殊挑战，实现了稳健的量化部署。

title: Ancient Greek to Modern Greek Machine Translation: A Novel Benchmark and Fine-Tuning Experiments on LLMs and NMT Models
comment: 14 pages. Accepted for presentation at the 15th Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC 2026), Palma, Mallorca, Spain
summary: Machine Translation (MT) for Ancient Greek (AG) to Modern Greek (MG) is a low-resource task, constrained by the lack of large-scale, high-quality parallel data. We address this gap by introducing the AG-MG Parallel Corpus, a new resource containing 132,481 sentence-aligned pairs derived from literary, historical, and biblical texts. We present a novel corpus creation pipeline that combines web-scraped, excerpt-level data with a multi-stage sentence-level alignment, and refinement process. Our method uses VecAlign with LaBSE embeddings, which we first fine-tune on a manually-aligned AG-MG subset, followed by an LLM-based error/misalignment correction phase using Gemini 2.5 Flash to ensure high alignment quality. Furthermore, we provide the first comprehensive benchmark of modern MT models on this task, evaluating three fine-tuning strategies across NMT models (NLLB, M2M100) and a Greek LLM (Llama-Krikri-8B). Our experiments show that fine-tuning yields significant improvements over base models, increasing performance by up to +10.3 BLEU points. Specifically, full-parameter fine-tuning of Llama-Krikri-8B achieves the highest overall performance with a BLEU score of 13.16, while the QLoRA-adapted M2M100-1.2B model demonstrates the largest relative gains and highly competitive results. Our dataset and models represent a significant contribution to Greek NLP.

AI.tldr: 本文针对古希腊语到现代希腊语的机器翻译低资源问题，构建了包含132,481个句对的新平行语料库，并提出结合VecAlign与微调LaBSE嵌入及LLM纠错的语料构建流程。实验表明微调方法相比基线模型BLEU提升最高达+10.3，其中全参数微调Llama-Krikri-8B达到13.16 BLEU的最佳性能。
AI.motivation: 古希腊语（AG）到现代希腊语（MG）的机器翻译是一项低资源任务，受限于缺乏大规模、高质量平行数据，现有资源不足以支撑有效的翻译模型训练。
AI.method: 1) 构建AG-MG平行语料库（132,481句对），来源包括文学、历史、圣经文本；2) 提出语料构建流程：网络爬取+多阶段句级对齐（VecAlign+微调LaBSE嵌入）+LLM（Gemini 2.5 Flash）纠错；3) 评估NMT模型（NLLB、M2M100）和希腊语LLM（Llama-Krikri-8B）的三种微调策略。
AI.result: 微调相比基线提升最高+10.3 BLEU；Llama-Krikri-8B全参数微调以13.16 BLEU取得最佳性能；QLoRA适配的M2M100-1.2B相对增益最大且结果极具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的数据集和模型为希腊语NLP做出了重要贡献，填补了古希腊语到现代希腊语机器翻译领域的空白。

title: LAST-RAG: Literature-Anchored Stochastic Trajectory Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Conditioned Degradation Model Selection
summary: Stochastic-process-based degradation modeling is a core approach for estimating the distribution of remaining useful life (RUL); however, the selection of an appropriate stochastic process has not been sufficiently addressed. Existing model selection methods mainly rely on the statistical fit of the observed health indicator (HI) trajectory, but this approach may select a model that is inconsistent with the underlying degradation mechanism when the observation window is short or the signal is highly noisy. To address this issue, this paper proposes Literature-Anchored Stochastic Trajectory Retrieval-Augmented Generation (LAST-RAG). The proposed method uses both the observed HI trajectory and domain-specific context, and hierarchically conditions the candidate degradation model space based on theoretical and mechanical evidence retrieved from a local evidence bank. In addition, Rule-based Confidence Reasoning with Uncertain State (RCRUS) is introduced to prevent candidate models from being prematurely eliminated when hierarchical decisions are uncertain. Simulation-based experiments demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms statistical, prognostic, and uncertainty-aware baselines in both Wiener/gamma family classification and detailed degradation model classification. Ultimately, this study reframes degradation model selection from a purely statistical goodness-of-fit problem into a knowledge-conditioned decision-making problem that integrates observed data with domain knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAST-RAG方法，通过整合观测健康指标轨迹与领域知识（文献证据）进行退化模型选择，并引入RCRUS规则处理层级决策中的不确定性，在维纳/伽马过程分类和细粒度模型分类上优于传统统计方法。
AI.motivation: 现有退化模型选择方法主要依赖健康指标轨迹的统计拟合度，但在观测窗口短或噪声大的情况下，统计拟合可能选出与底层退化机制不一致的模型，亟需一种融合数据与领域知识的方法。
AI.method: 提出LAST-RAG框架，利用局部证据库中的理论/力学证据对候选退化模型空间进行层级条件约束；同时提出RCRUS规则处理层级决策不确定性问题，防止候选模型被过早淘汰。
AI.result: 仿真实验表明，该方法在维纳/伽马过程分类以及细粒度退化模型分类任务中，均优于统计方法、预测方法和不确定性感知基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将退化模型选择从纯统计拟合问题重新定义为知识条件化的决策问题，融合观测数据与领域知识以提升选择可靠性。

title: WOW-Seg: A Word-free Open World Segmentation Model
comment: Accepted by ICLR 2026. Code and benchmark dataset are available at https://github.com/AAwCAA/WOW-Seg-Meta
summary: Open world image segmentation aims to achieve precise segmentation and semantic understanding of targets within images by addressing the infinitely open set of object categories encountered in the real world. However, traditional closed-set segmentation approaches struggle to adapt to complex open world scenarios, while foundation segmentation models such as SAM exhibit notable discrepancies between their strong segmentation capabilities and relatively weaker semantic understanding. To bridge these discrepancies, we propose WOW-Seg, a Word-free Open World Segmentation model for segmenting and recognizing objects from open-set categories. Specifically, WOW-Seg introduces a novel visual prompt module, Mask2Token, which transforms image masks into visual tokens and ensures their alignment with the VLLM feature space. Moreover, we introduce the Cascade Attention Mask to decouple information across different instances. This approach mitigates inter-instance interference, leading to a significant improvement in model performance. We further construct an open world region recognition test benchmark: the Region Recognition Dataset (RR-7K). With 7,662 classes, it represents the most extensive category-rich region recognition dataset to date. WOW-Seg attains strong results on the LVIS dataset, achieving a semantic similarity of 89.7 and a semantic IoU of 82.4. This performance surpasses the previous SOTA while using only one-eighth the parameter count. These results underscore the strong open world generalization capabilities of WOW-Seg. The code and related resources are available at https://github.com/AAwcAA/WOW-Seg-Meta.

AI.tldr: WOW-Seg是一种无需文本提示的开放世界分割模型，通过Mask2Token视觉提示模块和级联注意力掩码技术，在参数仅为此前最优模型八分之一的情况下，实现了更优的开放世界分割与识别性能。
AI.motivation: 传统闭集分割方法无法适应开放世界场景，而SAM等基础分割模型虽分割能力强但语义理解弱，存在能力差距。本文旨在弥合这一差距，实现开放世界图像分割与识别。
AI.method: 提出WOW-Seg模型：(1) Mask2Token视觉提示模块，将图像掩码转化为视觉token并与VLLM特征空间对齐；(2) Cascade Attention Mask级联注意力掩码，解耦不同实例信息以减少干扰。同时构建了包含7,662类别的RR-7K区域识别基准数据集。
AI.result: 在LVIS数据集上，语义相似度达89.7，语义IoU达82.4，超越此前SOTA，且参数量仅为SOTA的八分之一。
AI.conclusion: WOW-Seg展现了强大的开放世界泛化能力，证明了无需文本提示即可实现高效的开放世界分割与识别。

title: Easier to Judge than to Find: Predicting In-Context Learning Success for Demonstration Selection
summary: In-context learning (ICL) is highly sensitive to which demonstrations appear in the prompt, but selecting them is expensive because the space of possible demonstration contexts and combinations is enormous. We argue that demonstration selection is \emph{easier to judge than to find}: predicting whether a specific query--context pair $(q,D)$ will succeed is cheaper and more general than searching for an optimal $D^\star$. Based on this insight, we propose DiSP, a sample-and-judge framework that stratifies queries by difficulty. DiSP runs random demonstration trials to estimate success rate of each training query, trains a lightweight router to predict difficulty from the query, and trains level-specific judges for sampled demonstrations. At inference, DiSP performs stop-on-acceptance judging under an explicit budget, emitting diagnostic risk tags when no suitable context is found. Across five classification datasets with Llama~3--8B and Qwen~2.5--7B, DiSP achieves the best average accuracy, improving over strong learned selection baselines by up to 3.4\%, while achieving up to $23\times$ end-to-end wall-clock speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出了DiSP框架，通过先抽样再判断的方式高效选择上下文学习示例，在五个分类数据集上实现最佳平均准确率（最高提升3.4%）和高达23倍的端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 上下文学习（ICL）对提示中的示例高度敏感，但选择示例的计算成本极高，因为可能的示例上下文和组合空间巨大。
AI.method: 提出DiSP（sample-and-judge）框架，包含：1) 随机演示试验估算每个训练查询的成功率；2) 训练轻量级路由器根据查询预测难度；3) 为不同难度级别训练特定判断器。推理时在显式预算下执行"接受即停止"的判断策略，当找不到合适上下文时发出诊断风险标签。
AI.result: 在五个分类数据集上使用Llama 3-8B和Qwen 2.5-7B，DiSP实现了最佳平均准确率，比强学习选择基线高出最多3.4%，同时实现了高达23倍的端到端墙钟加速。
AI.conclusion: 演示选择"判断比寻找更容易"——预测特定查询-上下文对是否会成功比搜索最优解更廉价且更通用。

title: Agentic Chunking and Bayesian De-chunking of AI Generated Fuzzy Cognitive Maps: A Model of the Thucydides Trap
summary: We automatically generate feedback causal fuzzy cognitive maps (FCMs) from text by teaching large-language-model agents to break the text into overlapping chunks of text. Convex mixing of these chunk FCMs gives a representative cyclic FCM knowledge graph. The text chunks can have different levels of overlap. The chunk FCMs still mix to form a new FCM causal knowledge graph. The mixing technique scales because it uses light computation with sparse causal chunk matrices. The mixing structure allows an operator-level type of Bayesian inference that produces "de-chunked" or posterior-like FCMs from the mixed FCM. These de-chunked FCMs are useful in their own right and allow further iterations of Bayesian updating. We demonstrate these mixing techniques on the essay text of Allison's "Thucydides Trap" model of conflict between a dominant power such as the United States and a rising power such as China. The FCM dynamical systems predict outcomes as they equilibrate to fixed-point or limit-cycle attractors. Seven out of 8 FCM knowledge graphs predicted a type of war when we stimulated them by turning on and keeping on the concept node that stands for the rising power's ambition and entitlement. Gemini 3.1 LLMs served as the chunking AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从文本自动生成因果模糊认知图（FCM）的方法，利用大语言模型将文本分割为重叠片段，通过凸混合技术形成循环FCM知识图谱，并演示了该方法在"修昔底德陷阱"文本上的应用，其中7/8的FCM在刺激"崛起国野心"节点后预测了战争结果。
AI.motivation: 现有FCM构建依赖人工专家或简单关键词提取，缺乏从非结构化文本自动、可扩展生成因果知识图谱的方法，且难以处理循环因果结构和不确定性。
AI.method: 使用大语言模型（Gemini 3.1）将文本拆分为重叠片段，为每个片段构建FCM；通过凸混合（convex mixing）将稀疏因果矩阵组合为全局循环FCM；利用算子级贝叶斯推理实现"去分块"（de-chunked）后验FCM更新。
AI.result: 在Allison的"修昔底德陷阱"文本上，8个FCM知识图谱中有7个在激活"崛起国野心与权利"概念节点后预测了战争类型的吸引子（固定点或极限环）。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的文本分块与FCM混合技术能有效从非结构化文本中提取因果知识，支持循环推理和贝叶斯更新，为分析国际冲突等复杂系统提供了可扩展的计算工具。

title: VGGT-Occ: Geometry-Grounded and Density-Aware Gated Fusion for 3D Occupancy Prediction
